title: Scaling Laws for Multimodal Data Mixtures
comment: Accepted as a spotlight in NeurIPS 2026
summary: Frontier AI systems are increasingly natively multimodal, jointly pretrained on multiple modalities, such as text, vision, and audio. However, the scientific understanding of the multimodal data mixtures used to pretrain these systems --- how much of each modality to mix, and at what potential interference cost to the others --- is largely absent or gatekept. In this work, we derive data mixing scaling laws for three modalities: text, vision, and audio. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly adopt Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, as MoEs scale efficiently and partially limit cross-modal interference. We therefore use MoEs to conduct 268 experiments ranging from 457M to 8.3B parameters, on up to 150 billion tokens. Our work leads to multiple actionable insights into multimodal data mixing for training MLLMs. First, compute optima are modality-specific: audio modality is model-heavy, favoring scaling parameters over tokens, while text and vision require balanced scaling of model size and data. Second, repeating vision or audio data beyond 2x yields negligible benefits. Finally, cross-modal interactions are highly asymmetric: vision strongly interferes with audio, whereas audio's interference with learning text and vision is negligible. Overall, we provide a principled foundation for understanding the multimodal data mixtures needed to train frontier MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过268个MoE实验（457M–8.3B参数、最多150B token）推导了文本、视觉、音频三模态的数据混合缩放定律，揭示了模态特异的计算最优配置、数据重复的收益边界以及高度不对称的跨模态干扰规律。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI系统已原生多模态，多模态联合预训练成为常态，但关于多模态数据混合（各模态配比、潜在干扰代价）的科学认识仍缺乏或未公开，缺少指导MLLM训练的定量理论基础。
AI.method: 针对文本、视觉、音频三种模态，采用Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架构以高效扩展并部分限制跨模态干扰，开展268组实验，模型规模457M至8.3B参数，训练数据最多150B token，据此拟合多模态数据混合的缩放定律。
AI.result: 1）计算最优配置具有模态特异性：音频为"模型重型"，倾向扩展参数而非token；文本与视觉则需模型规模与数据量均衡扩展。2）视觉或音频数据重复超过2倍后收益可忽略。3）跨模态交互高度不对称：视觉对音频干扰强烈，而音频对文本和视觉学习的干扰可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 研究为理解训练前沿MLLM所需的多模态数据混合提供了有原则的理论基础，并给出可操作的数据配比与扩展指导。

title: MemForm: Benchmarking Memory Formation Poisoning in LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to learn from past interactions but exposes memory formation to adversarial influence. Existing studies primarily organize memory poisoning by attack channels, corruption patterns, or lifecycle stages, leaving formation interfaces insufficiently characterized. We formulate Memory Formation Poisoning as adversarial manipulation of the interfaces through which persistent agent memory is produced and committed, and introduce MemForm, a controlled diagnostic benchmark covering five interfaces: Content, Evidence, Scope, Selection, and Path Poisoning. We introduce Selection and Path Poisoning as controlled intervention categories that isolate retention and consolidation order effects, respectively. Each category pairs clean and poisoned conditions with interface-specific controls. Evaluations across six LLMs and two response formats reveal broad susceptibility at all five interfaces under the evaluated memory protocols and implementations. Crucially, authentic experiences with successful outcomes do not guarantee reliable behavior after memory formation: changes to contextual support, retention, or consolidation order can induce undesirable downstream behavior. In particular, consolidation order can alter behavior even with identical retained experiences, depending on the memory formation procedure. Additional analyses show that interface applicability depends on memory architecture and that Path Poisoning susceptibility depends on the updater. The evaluated defenses provide incomplete mitigation that varies by interface. These findings motivate protecting both what is committed to persistent memory and how memory is formed from experiences. Code and data are available at https://github.com/opanhw/memform-code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"记忆形成投毒"（Memory Formation Poisoning）问题，并构建 MemForm 基准，覆盖 Content、Evidence、Scope、Selection、Path 五种形成接口，揭示 LLM 智能体在记忆形成阶段普遍存在脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆使 LLM 智能体能从过往交互中学习，但也使记忆形成过程暴露于对抗性影响之下。现有研究多按攻击通道、破坏模式或生命周期阶段来组织记忆投毒，但对"形成接口"这一环节刻画不足，缺乏系统性的诊断工具。
AI.method: 将记忆形成投毒形式化为对持久化记忆生成与提交接口的对抗性操纵，提出受控诊断基准 MemForm，覆盖五个接口：Content（内容）、Evidence（证据）、Scope（范围）、Selection（选择）与 Path（路径）投毒。其中 Selection 与 Path 为新增的受控干预类别，分别隔离"保留效应"与"固化顺序效应"。每个类别均设置干净条件与投毒条件，并配以接口专属的对照实验。评估涵盖六种 LLM 与两种响应格式。
AI.result: 在所评估的记忆协议与实现下，五个接口均表现出广泛易感性。关键发现：即便经历真实且结果成功的体验，也不能保证记忆形成后行为可靠——上下文支持、保留或固化顺序的改变都会诱发不良下游行为。特别地，在保留体验完全相同的情况下，固化顺序仍能依据记忆形成流程改变行为。进一步分析表明，接口适用性取决于记忆架构，Path 投毒的易感性取决于更新器（updater）。现有防御措施只能提供不完整的缓解，且因接口而异。
AI.conclusion: 需要同时保护"写入持久记忆的内容"与"从经验中形成记忆的方式"，即对记忆的提交内容与形成过程进行双重防护。代码与数据已开源。

title: Design Choices for Multimodal Transformer Learning with Missing and Longitudinal Healthcare Data
summary: Multimodal learning offers the potential to improve predictions by integrating complementary information from heterogeneous data sources. However, multimodal datasets are frequently incomplete, raising important questions about how models should handle missing information. Although recent approaches increasingly rely on Transformer-based architectures for multimodal fusion, incomplete multimodal data introduces challenges such as missing modalities and intra-modal missingness, which motivate key architectural design choices, such as tokenization granularity. In addition, many datasets are longitudinal, with observations collected across multiple time points. The sequential nature of the Transformer architectures provides a natural framework for modeling such data, but introduces additional considerations, such as how temporal information should be represented. In this study, we systematically investigate these design choices using three different cancer datasets. We compare modality-level and feature-level tokenization and evaluate attention masking and imputation as strategies for handling missing information, both naturally occurring in the datasets and synthetically induced. We further investigate approaches for incorporating temporal information in our training process and how to model it. Experiments are conducted with unimodal and multimodal configurations, as well as different levels of missingness for binary survival classification and multiple time encoding strategies for discrete-time survival prediction. Our results show that while multimodal outperforms unimodal results, missing data heavily impacts predictions and thus effective design choices such as tokenization granularity, and intra-missing handling is essential for reliable prediction.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统探究了基于Transformer的多模态学习在缺失数据与纵向数据场景下的关键设计选择，并在三个癌症数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.motivation: 多模态学习可整合异构数据源的互补信息以提升预测性能，但多模态数据集常存在不完整问题（缺失模态与模态内缺失），且许多数据集为纵向数据。尽管Transformer架构被广泛用于多模态融合与序列建模，但缺失信息与时间信息带来了如分词粒度、注意力掩码、插补、时间表示等关键架构设计问题，这些选择尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 使用三个不同的癌症数据集，系统比较模态级与特征级分词（tokenization）；评估注意力掩码与插补两种缺失信息处理策略，涵盖数据集中自然发生的缺失与人工合成的缺失；同时研究训练过程中时间信息的引入方式与建模方法。实验覆盖单模态与多模态配置、不同缺失程度，以及二分类生存预测和离散时间生存预测的多种时间编码策略。
AI.result: 多模态配置优于单模态结果；但缺失数据对预测性能产生严重影响，因此诸如分词粒度及模态内缺失处理等有效设计选择对可靠预测至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 在基于Transformer的不完整纵向多模态学习（如癌症生存预测）中，合理的分词粒度与模态内缺失处理策略是实现可靠预测的必要条件，设计选择需针对缺失性和时间建模进行系统考量。

title: Neither True nor False: Do LLMs Represent Truth-Value Gaps in Plural Predication?
summary: Do Large Language Models (LLMs) genuinely grasp the truth conditions of plural descriptions, or do they force every sentence into true or false? We investigate the Homogeneity Gap, a semantic phenomenon where a plural definite (e.g., the kids laughed) and its negation (the kids didn't laugh) are both neither true nor false when only some of the kids laughed, whereas their quantified counterparts (all, not all) remain strictly bivalent. We introduce HomogeneityNLI, a diagnostic dataset of 1,000 minimal-pair items crossing determiner, polarity, and group composition across ten logical conditions. Evaluating seven open-weight models, we uncover a pervasive Bivalence Bias: models assign plural definites their homogeneous truth conditions, reading the kids as all of them and the kids didn't as none of them, yet collapse the truth-value gap into falsity. In the zero-shot setting, no model recognizes the gap for both polarities in more than 15% of scenarios, and negated definites are judged False in 84% of cases. Explicit linguistic rules, chain-of-thought, and enumeration prompts produce unstable, model-specific effects that often entrench the bias. Taken together, our findings indicate that current open-weight LLMs have acquired the truth conditions of plural predication but not its trivalent logic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HomogeneityNLI诊断数据集，考察LLM对复数定指描述真值条件的掌握，发现普遍存在"双值偏见"：模型习得同质真值条件却将真值间隙坍缩为假。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM是否真正把握复数描述的真值条件，还是将每个句子强行归为真或假。核心语言学现象是Homogeneity Gap（同质性间隙）：当只有部分孩子笑了时，复数定指"the kids laughed"及其否定"the kids didn't laugh"均非真非假，而量化对应词(all/not all)保持严格双值。此前缺乏系统诊断这一三值逻辑能力的评测。
AI.method: 构建HomogeneityNLI诊断数据集，包含1000个最小配对条目，交叉限定词、极性和群体构成，覆盖十种逻辑条件。对七个开放权重模型进行评估，并在零样本设置下测试显式语言规则、思维链(chain-of-thought)和枚举提示的效果。
AI.result: 发现普遍存在的Bivalence Bias（双值偏见）：模型为复数定指赋予同质真值条件（将"the kids"读作全部，将"the kids didn't"读作一个都没有），却把真值间隙坍缩为假。零样本下无模型能在超过15%的场景中同时识别两种极性的间隙；否定定指在84%的情形中被判为False。显式语言规则、思维链和枚举提示产生不稳定且因模型而异的效果，往往反而强化偏见。
AI.conclusion: 当前开放权重LLM已习得复数谓语的真值条件，但未掌握其三值逻辑。模型具备组合语义的部分能力，却缺失同质性所要求的三值真值系统。

title: SceneForesee: Learning Scene Evolution for Spatiotemporal Reasoning
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) need to understand how entities move and interact as a scene develops. This requires following the same entities over time and relating their observed motion to subsequent changes. We formulate Scene Evolution Understanding (SEU), a task for predicting and interpreting this change. Given observed video, a model estimates entity histories and predicts one scene continuation through future trajectories and Events, accompanied by Visual Evidence from observed motion and a scene description. We construct SceneForesee, a benchmark for evaluating entity continuity and scene evolution reasoning through paired observed and future scenes with shared entity identities. It contains 144.57K temporal pairs, 1.05M entity correspondences, and 272.49K Events paired with observed evidence. We propose a spatiotemporal reasoning framework, EvoSee, that learns future geometry and Event semantics through shared candidate states and joint assignment. It selects one continuation per entity from observation and uses the selected changes for entity refinement, retention, and scene representation. On SceneForesee, EvoSee outperforms Qwen3.5-9B by 10.45 points in Combined Point-F1 and 17.24 points in Event Global F1. On the 4D reasoning benchmark Dyn-Bench, it improves question answering accuracy and grounding J&F by 4.8 and 3.58 points over their respective base systems. These results support scene evolution as both a prediction target and a dynamic representation that brings predicted entity changes into spatiotemporal reasoning.The project is available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/SceneForesee-Spatiotemporal-Reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Scene Evolution Understanding（SEU）任务、SceneForesee基准（144.57K时序对、1.05M实体对应、272.49K事件）与EvoSee时空推理框架，通过共享候选状态与联合分配学习未来几何与事件语义，在SceneForesee和Dyn-Bench上均显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型需要理解场景发展中实体如何移动与交互，这要求跨时间跟踪同一实体并将其观测运动与后续变化关联。现有方法缺乏对"场景演化"这一预测与表征目标的系统建模与评测。
AI.method: 1）形式化SEU任务：基于观测视频估计实体历史，预测一个场景延续（未来轨迹与Events），并给出视觉证据与场景描述。2）构建SceneForesee基准，采用共享实体身份的成对观测/未来场景，评估实体连续性与场景演化推理。3）提出EvoSee框架，通过共享候选状态与联合分配学习未来几何与Event语义；为每个实体从观测中选择一个延续，并用所选变化进行实体细化、保留与场景表示。
AI.result: 在SceneForesee上，EvoSee相比Qwen3.5-9B在Combined Point-F1上提升10.45点，在Event Global F1上提升17.24点；在4D推理基准Dyn-Bench上，问答准确率与grounding J&F分别较各自基础系统提升4.8与3.58点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将场景演化同时作为预测目标与动态表征，把预测的实体变化纳入时空推理，从而提升连续性与演化理解能力。项目已开源。

title: Evaluating Semantic Relation Knowledge through Bidirectional Relation Prediction from Gloss Pairs
summary: Semantic relations organise word senses and are fundamental to lexical semantics. In order to evaluate semantic relation knowledge of large language models (LLMs), we propose a challenging task in which an LLM predicts the relation between two glosses (definitions of senses) presented in two different orders. The predictions for the two orders are evaluated for consistency with the symmetry or asymmetry of semantic relations. Our task is designed for both monolingual and cross-lingual evaluation, allowing us to examine whether relation knowledge remains accessible when the same senses are verbalised through glosses in different languages. We construct a dataset of 3,069 sense pairs, with each sense verbalised in English, Greek, Romanian, Turkish, and Japanese. Experiments with 17 LLMs in zero-shot and five-shot settings reveal generally poor performance. In each setting, only eight LLMs achieve a macro-averaged F1 score significantly above a random baseline, and only one (zero-shot) and two (five-shot) significantly outperform a neural baseline. In particular, LLMs often fail to generate bidirectionally consistent predictions for hypernymy and to make correct predictions for holonymy in either direction. Our results suggest limitations in current LLMs' semantic relation knowledge, both in identifying relations and in respecting asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一项双语/跨语言义项关系预测任务，通过交换两个义项释义的顺序并检验预测的一致性来评估大语言模型的语义关系知识，结果显示17个LLM整体表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 语义关系是词汇语义学的核心，用于组织词义。作者希望系统评估大语言模型对语义关系知识的掌握程度，尤其是其能否识别关系并正确处理语义关系的对称性与非对称性，以及这种知识在跨语言义项释义表达下是否仍然可及。
AI.method: 提出一项挑战性任务：让LLM预测两个义项释义（两个不同义项的定义）之间的关系，并将同一对释义以两种不同顺序呈现，通过比较两种顺序下预测结果与语义关系对称或非对称性质的一致性来评估模型。任务同时支持单语和跨语言评测。作者构建了包含3,069个义项对的数据集，每个义项分别用英语、希腊语、罗马尼亚语、土耳其语和日语进行释义表达。实验覆盖17个LLM，设置zero-shot和five-shot两种条件，并与随机基线和神经基线进行比较。
AI.result: 实验显示模型整体表现普遍较差。在每种设置下，仅8个LLM的宏平均F1显著高于随机基线；zero-shot下仅1个、five-shot下仅2个模型显著优于神经基线。模型常无法对上下位关系（hypernymy）给出双向一致的预测，也无法在任一方向上正确预测整体-部分关系（holonymy）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明当前大语言模型在语义关系知识方面存在局限，既体现在关系识别上，也体现在对非对称性的正确把握上；该任务和数据集为单语与跨语言的语义关系评估提供了有效手段。

title: FreeCHROMA: Generative Chroma Keying from Unaligned Background References
summary: In film production, chroma keying composites an approved foreground performance into a new environment, but conventional workflows require coordinated background plates and dedicated harmonization. Recent generative methods often require pre-aligned backgrounds, focus on background-conditioned foreground relighting, or represent the environment only through an edited first frame. These restrictions limit background selection, scene composition, and camera motion while adding preparation or editing effort. We present FreeCHROMA, which adapts a pretrained video diffusion model in a parameter-efficient manner for generative video compositing from one to three unaligned background references. The model integrates the foreground into the referenced environment, preserving foreground identity, motion, and fine visual details while generating a spatiotemporally coherent background. Foreground-background harmonization occurs within the same generation process, without a separate relighting stage. Optional text instructions help disambiguate complex spatial relationships and camera behavior. To train the model, we construct pseudo-paired data from readily available real monocular videos through foreground-background separation and augmentation with existing foundation models. The original videos serve as training targets, while automated processing and quality verification enable scalable data construction. Across reference fidelity, foreground preservation, scene integration, harmonization, and overall video quality, FreeCHROMA consistently outperforms recent compositing and conditional video-generation baselines, with particularly clear gains under camera motion. FreeCHROMA relaxes the constraints of existing tools to enable end-to-end generative chroma keying from unaligned inputs, with exploratory experiments demonstrating its potential in robotics.

AI.tldr: FreeCHROMA：参数高效微调预训练视频扩散模型，实现从1–3张未对齐背景参考的端到端生成式视频抠像合成。
AI.motivation: 传统抠像合成需背景板同步与专门协调；现有生成方法多要求预对齐背景、只做背景条件前景重打光，或仅用编辑后的首帧表示环境，限制了背景选择、场景组合与相机运动，并增加准备/编辑成本。
AI.method: 以参数高效方式适配预训练视频扩散模型，输入前景与1–3张未对齐背景参考；在同一生成过程内完成前后景协调，无需单独重打光阶段；可选文本指令消解复杂空间关系与相机行为。训练数据由现成单目视频经前后景分离与基础模型增强构建伪配对，原视频作为目标，自动处理与质量验证实现可扩展数据构建。
AI.result: 在参考保真度、前景保持、场景融合、协调与整体视频质量上，FreeCHROMA持续优于近期合成与条件视频生成基线，相机运动下增益尤其明显。
AI.conclusion: FreeCHROMA放宽现有工具约束，实现未对齐输入下的端到端生成式抠像合成，并在机器人等探索性实验中展现潜力。

title: Re-executing Coding-Agent Evaluations: Unchanged Decisions and Unresolved Policy Risk
summary: Executable tests grade large language model (LLM) coding-agent patches for leaderboards, rewards and self-improvement. Two preregistered re-execution studies returned negative results. SWE-bench Pro v1's offline option rejected none of 59 accepted Go patches whose grading configuration changed. Their exploratory, unweighted upper confidence limit is 4.95% under candidate independence, leaving a 3% exposed-patch risk unresolved; the preregistered estimator uses inverse sampling-probability weights. An extension was inconclusive. In a selected stratum, a reconstructed module cache built from the reference solution's dependencies rejected accepted alternatives from four models that passed with their own dependencies. Re-executing 1,929 selected agent-version/task evaluations from the Darwin Gödel Machine's archive preserved best-agent selection and system-variant ranking, with search history and scores of evaluations not rerun fixed. Exploratory host, image and adapted-grader comparisons also preserved them. Seven of 23 disagreements with archived verdicts did not recur on a second host; rebuilt images changed 16 three-run majority verdicts (0.83%) under four-CPU execution. We provide an evidence-to-claim summary, lessons for grader audits and an anonymous replication package. These results concern accepted patches and fixed-history decisions; general policy safety and adaptive-learning robustness require broader evaluations.

AI.tldr: 两项预注册的重复执行研究均未复现"执行式测试评分不可靠"的预期负面结果：SWE-bench Pro v1 离线选项未拒绝任何配置变更的已接受补丁，DGM 档案的重新评测也保持了原有选择与排序。
AI.motivation: 可执行测试被广泛用于对 LLM 编码智能体的补丁打分，支撑排行榜、奖励与自我改进。若评分的可重复性不足，将动摇这些下游用途的可靠性，因此作者以预注册方式检验评分是否稳健。
AI.method: 采用两项预注册的重复执行研究：(1) 对 SWE-bench Pro v1 中 59 个已接受 Go 补丁在评分配置变更下进行离线重评，并给出预注册的逆采样概率加权估计量与探索性无权置信上限；(2) 从 Darwin Gödel Machine 档案中抽取 1,929 个"智能体版本×任务"评测重新执行，另做主机、镜像与改造评分器的探索性比较及二次主机复现。
AI.result: SWE-bench Pro v1 离线选项未拒绝任何已接受 Go 补丁，探索性无权置信上限为 4.95%（候选独立假设下），3% 的暴露补丁风险未解决；扩展实验无定论。某选定层中，基于参考解依赖重建的模块缓存拒绝了四个模型以自有依赖通过的替代补丁。DGM 重新执行保持了最优智能体选择与系统变体排序，未重跑评分的搜索历史与分数被固定。23 项与档案结论的分歧中 7 项在第二主机上未复现；四 CPU 下重建镜像改变了 16 个三次多数表决结论（0.83%）。
AI.conclusion: 执行式测试评分在已接受补丁与固定历史决策范围内表现稳健，未支持评分不可靠的假设；但通用策略安全与自适应学习的稳健性仍需更广泛评估。论文提供了证据-主张对照表、评分器审计经验与匿名复现包。

title: Evaluating Bias in Chinese Large Language Models across Tasks and Registers: Task Operationalization Effects and Irony Classification Risks
summary: In Chinese content governance, large language models are increasingly used to identify toxic and discriminatory expressions, yet both task operationalization and ironic expression can alter bias measurement readings. We conducted a preregistered multi-task behavioral audit of multiple Chinese large language models. In the content classification experiment, the core panel's classification error rate rose from 10.9% in the formal register to 23.5% in the yinyang (an echoic-irony register) version, a risk difference of +12.7 percentage points. (95% CI [+9.7, +15.7]). Inter-rater agreement was lower in the yinyang register (majority-vote kappa = 0.299), so the increase contains a component of label uncertainty propagation, but the direction of increase was consistent under both adjudicated and majority-vote reference standards. Explicit irony-aware prompts reduced the intervention panel's error rate by 9.6 percentage points. We operationalized the 29 shared proposition anchors into three task forms: social consensus estimation (Form A), high-stakes decision (Form B), and controlled association rating (Form C); independent manipulation checks found that all 58 A-C comparison units received unanimous agreement, whereas the low A-B convergence was confirmed by calibrated majority adjudication (87.8% supporting the minority judgment); on the irony-probe materials, the interactions of B and C relative to A were +0.577 and +1.121, respectively. Thus, when evaluating large language models for Chinese content governance, the effect of task operationalization on bias readings is an empirical question that requires data to answer, and safety evaluation should incorporate the ironic register as a test condition.

AI.tldr: 该预注册行为审计发现，中文大语言模型在阴阳（反讽）语域下的内容分类错误率显著高于正式语域（10.9%→23.5%，风险差+12.7个百分点），且任务操作化形式会显著改变偏见测量读数，因此安全评测应将反讽语域纳入测试条件。
AI.motivation: 中文内容治理日益依赖大语言模型识别有毒与歧视性表达，但任务的操作化方式与反讽性表达都可能干扰偏见测量结果，需要实证检验这些因素对评测读数的影响。
AI.method: 开展预注册的多任务行为审计：内容分类实验中对比正式语域与阴阳（回声式反讽）语域；采用评判裁定与多数投票两种参照标准；使用显式反讽感知提示进行干预；将29个共享命题锚点操作化为三种任务形式（社会共识估计A、高风险决策B、受控联想评分C），并进行独立操纵检验与校准多数裁定。
AI.result: 分类错误率从正式语域的10.9%升至阴阳语域的23.5%（风险差+12.7个百分点，95% CI [+9.7,+15.7]）；阴阳语域评分者一致性更低（多数投票kappa=0.299），误差上升中部分源于标签不确定性传播，但两种参照标准下方向一致。反讽感知提示使干预组错误率降低9.6个百分点。58个A-C比较单元获全票一致，A-B收敛度低（87.8%支持少数判断）；反讽探针材料中B、C相对A的交互效应分别为+0.577和+1.121。
AI.conclusion: 在评估用于中文内容治理的大语言模型时，任务操作化对偏见读数的影响是一个需由数据回答的实证问题；安全评测应将反讽语域作为测试条件纳入。

title: EdgeLLM-Nano: Auditing Polar-Guided Key-Cache Compression and Consistency-Anchored Pruning on a 33.6 MB On-Device Language Model
summary: Deploying language models (LMs) on the edge presents unique memory, latency, and power challenges absent in high-performance computing. KV-cache compression emerges as a promising approach to address these challenges. However, the effectiveness of current KV-cache compression methods has not been thoroughly examined on edge devices. Moreover, we show that existing evaluation methods do not always involve the KV-cache under test. We propose EdgeLLM-Nano, a measurement study of KV-cache compression using a nano-scale decoder-only LM (transformer) testbed that has 8.39M parameters, i.e., 33.6 MB, to enable end-to-end examination of each backend, seed, and power sample. Our results give a negative verdict for a polar-guided key-cache quantizer (round-to-nearest (RTN) control causes an order of magnitude less damage), as well as a consistency-anchored progressive weight pruner (one-shot magnitude-based pruning performs as well as, if not better). We also introduce Long-Context Decode Fidelity (LCDF) evaluation, a token-by-token examination of teacher-forced log-losses using the KV-cache under test. Unlike perplexity that gives the same 5.461 score to all methods, LCDF distinguishes different KV-cache compression backends thanks to its paired statistics across seeds and effect sizes. Our companion Raspberry Pi 5 measurement shows all compression backends we tested to be less energy-efficient per token compared to uncompressed FP16 inference. Except for KIVI that is close to lossless in terms of LCDF, our findings indicate KV-cache compression can be improved. LCDF offers a simple and effective way of shedding light on KV-cache compression methods, whose negative impacts have been overlooked by perplexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EdgeLLM-Nano 测量研究，用 8.39M 参数的纳米级解码器 LM 测试床端到端评估 KV-cache 压缩，并引入 LCDF 评估指标区分不同压缩后端；结果显示部分压缩器效果不佳，且在 Raspberry Pi 5 上压缩后端每 token 能效均低于未压缩 FP16。
AI.motivation: 边缘部署 LM 面临内存、延迟与功耗挑战，KV-cache 压缩被视为有前景的方案，但其在边缘设备上的有效性缺乏充分检验，且现有评测方法并不总涉及被测的 KV-cache。
AI.method: 构建 EdgeLLM-Nano 纳米级测试床（8.39M 参数、33.6 MB 解码器 LM），实现逐后端、逐种子、逐功率样本的端到端测量；并引入 Long-Context Decode Fidelity（LCDF），基于被测 KV-cache 对 teacher-forced log-loss 做逐 token 配对统计与效应量评估。
AI.result: 极坐标引导的 key-cache 量化器获负面结论（RTN 对照的损伤低一个数量级）；一致性锚定的渐进式权重剪枝也无优势（一次性幅度剪枝相当或更好）。困惑度对所有方法给出相同 5.461 分，而 LCDF 能区分不同 KV-cache 压缩后端；Raspberry Pi 5 测量显示所有被测压缩后端每 token 能效均低于未压缩 FP16，仅 KIVI 在 LCDF 上接近无损。
AI.conclusion: 现有 KV-cache 压缩仍有改进空间，其负面影响被困惑度掩盖；LCDF 是一种简单有效、能揭示压缩方法真实影响的评估手段。

title: Scale, Drivers, and Limits of Representational Alignment Across Large Language Models
summary: Comparing large language models can reveal shared representational structure and systematic differences between them. However, aggregate similarity measures can obscure how agreement varies across geometric scales and which linguistic properties support it. We introduce two complementary methods to resolve where models agree and what supports that agreement. Standard representational similarity analysis (RSA) summarizes similarity across all stimulus pairs, potentially obscuring differences in alignment between nearby and distant inputs. Neighborhood-Weighted RSA (NW-RSA) addresses this limitation by weighting stimulus pairs according to their proximity in representational space, placing alignment from local neighborhoods to global geometry on a common scale. Counterfactual RSA (CF-RSA) tests which linguistic properties support alignment by comparing intact representations in one model with representations under controlled linguistic perturbations in another. Across diverse language models, we find strong agreement in coarse representational geometry but substantial divergence in local neighborhoods. Alignment is observed both across broadly sampled natural text and within linguistic equivalence classes that preserve particular aspects of meaning or structure. Counterfactual analyses reveal selective sensitivity: changes to logical scope reduce alignment substantially more than the tested changes to hierarchical syntax, event roles, or discourse structure. Alignment also decreases when sentence structure or lexical meaning is disrupted in word lists and jabberwocky sentences, suggesting that the regularities of natural language support stronger convergence. These findings refine claims of representational universality by showing that strong overall similarity need not imply agreement in how models represent finer linguistic distinctions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Neighborhood-Weighted RSA与Counterfactual RSA两种互补方法，用于精确定位大语言模型表征在几何尺度上的对齐位置及其语言属性支撑，发现模型在粗粒度几何上高度一致但局部邻域显著分歧。
AI.motivation: 现有聚合式相似度度量（如标准RSA）将相似性在所有刺激对上进行汇总，掩盖了对齐程度如何随几何尺度变化，以及哪些语言属性支撑这种对齐的问题，可能导致对模型表征普遍性的过度概括。
AI.method: 提出Neighborhood-Weighted RSA（NW-RSA），按刺激对在表征空间中的邻近度加权，将局部邻域到全局几何的对齐放在统一尺度上度量；提出Counterfactual RSA（CF-RSA），通过将一个模型的完整表征与另一模型在受控语言扰动下的表征进行比较，检验哪些语言属性支撑对齐。在多种语言模型上，跨自然文本广泛采样及保持特定语义/结构方面的语言等价类内展开分析，扰动涵盖逻辑辖域、层级句法、事件角色、语篇结构，以及词表与jabberwocky句子中的结构与词汇破坏。
AI.result: 多种语言模型在粗粒度表征几何上呈现强一致，但在局部邻域上存在显著分歧。对齐既出现在广泛采样的自然文本中，也出现在保持特定语义或结构的语言等价类内。反事实分析显示选择性敏感：逻辑辖域的改变使对齐下降幅度远大于所测试的层级句法、事件角色或语篇结构改变；词表与jabberwocky句子中句法结构或词汇意义被破坏时对齐也下降。
AI.conclusion: 强整体相似性并不意味着模型在更细粒度语言区分上的表征方式一致；自然语言的规律性支撑更强的表征收敛。该结果修正了关于表征普遍性的论断，强调需在多个几何尺度与受控语言扰动下评估模型间对齐。

title: AphaVoice: Text-to-Speech Model for Aphasia Patient Simulation
comment: Accepted at IEEE Spoken Language Technology (SLT) 2026
summary: While language therapy is the primary treatment for post-stroke aphasia, limited clinical resources often restrict patient access to proper care. Addressing this gap requires reliable training simulations for medical professionals. However, current AI efforts focus almost exclusively on speech processing, leaving speech generation largely unexplored. This study introduces AphaVoice, a novel text-to-speech (TTS) framework explicitly engineered to synthesize highly realistic aphasic speech. Evaluated against state-of-the-art TTS systems, AphaVoice demonstrates a superior ability to capture the clinical feature of dysfluency, outperforming existing models in temporal metrics while consistently maintaining speaker identity. By leveraging latent space shifting, the model also supports multi-speaker generation without sacrificing phonetic realism. Ultimately, AphaVoice provides a scalable, high-fidelity tool for medical training and clinical simulation related to aphasia.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AphaVoice，一个专门用于合成高度逼真失语症语音的文本到语音（TTS）框架，可支持医疗培训与临床模拟。
AI.motivation: 语言治疗是卒中后失语症的主要治疗手段，但临床资源有限，患者难以获得充分照护。弥补这一缺口需要面向医疗专业人员的可靠训练模拟，而现有 AI 研究几乎只聚焦语音处理，语音生成方向尚属空白。
AI.method: 提出 AphaVoice 文本到语音框架，显式建模并合成失语症语音；通过潜在空间偏移（latent space shifting）实现多说话人生成。
AI.result: 与当前最先进 TTS 系统相比，AphaVoice 更能捕捉不流畅性（dysfluency）这一临床特征，在时间相关指标上优于现有模型，同时稳定保持说话人身份；多说话人生成不牺牲语音真实感。
AI.conclusion: AphaVoice 为失语症相关的医疗培训与临床模拟提供了可扩展、高保真的工具。

title: Multi-modal Representation Fusion for Long-term Microsurgical Anastomosis Trajectory Anticipation
summary: Microsurgical anastomosis is one of the most challenging and sophisticated procedures for surgical robotics, requiring accurate manipulation of surgical instruments within a limited space to achieve precise operations. Accurate surgical trajectory anticipation is essential for surgical scene understanding, intraoperative planning, robotic manipulation, and reliable behaviour analysis. However, existing approaches mainly focus on features extracted from surgical videos and historical trajectories, while overlooking rich semantic and motion information that can provide more discriminative multi-modal representations for complex surgical instrument-tissue interactions. In this work, we propose a cross-modal feature fusion framework for long-term 2D and 3D microsurgical anastomosis trajectory anticipation. The proposed framework consists of a multi-modal representation extractor and a cross-modal feature fusion network. Semantic recognition of surgical objects and consecutive motion estimation are incorporated as multi-modal visual cues, providing complementary spatial and temporal guidance for instrument-tissue interaction characterization. A coarse-to-fine progressive fusion strategy with a long-short-term memory mechanism is introduced to capture temporal dependencies step by step. The training and evaluation are conducted on our established robotic platform and a comprehensive dataset containing both phantom and ex-vivo surgical scenarios is constructed. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms existing methods and exhibits improved robustness across different surgical scenes, highlighting its potential for both intelligent robot-assisted and autonomous surgical systems.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态特征融合框架，实现显微外科吻合术长期2D与3D轨迹预测。
AI.motivation: 显微外科吻合术是手术机器人中最具挑战性的操作之一，需在有限空间内精准操控器械。准确的手术轨迹预测对场景理解、术中规划、机器人操作和可靠行为分析至关重要。但现有方法主要依赖手术视频特征与历史轨迹，忽略了可为复杂器械-组织交互提供更具判别性多模态表示的丰富语义与运动信息。
AI.method: 框架包含多模态表示提取器与跨模态特征融合网络：将手术对象的语义识别与连续运动估计作为多模态视觉线索，提供互补的时空引导以刻画器械-组织交互；引入由粗到细的渐进式融合策略并结合长短期记忆机制，逐步捕捉时序依赖。训练与评估基于自建机器人平台及涵盖体模与离体手术场景的综合数据集。
AI.result: 大量定量与定性实验表明，该框架持续优于现有方法，并在不同手术场景下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在智能机器人辅助及自主手术系统方面具有应用潜力。

title: DSR-Net: Learning Dynamic Skeletal Relations for 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: 3D human pose estimation requires accurate modeling of motion-dependent skeletal structures and inter-joint dependencies. Existing methods typically rely on fixed skeletal topologies in Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) or implicitly capture joint relations through attention mechanisms, limiting their adaptability to diverse motion patterns. To address this issue,we proposeDSR-Net, a dynamic structural representation learning framework for 3D human pose estimation. Specifically, a Dynamic Skeletal Relation (DSR) module is introduced to learn adaptive inter-joint dependencies beyond predefined skeletal connections. Based on the learned relations, a hierarchical relation-aware fusion strategy is developed to facilitate effective interaction between structural and temporal representations. In addition, a lightweight Residual Skeletal Recalibration Module (RSRM) is designed to enhance the stability of structure-aware features with minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP demonstrate that DSR-Net achieves MPJPEs of 37.9 mm and 14.9 mm, respectively, consistently improving over strong baselines. The results validate the effectiveness of dynamic skeletal relation modeling for robust 3D human pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出DSR-Net框架，通过动态骨骼关系学习与层次化关系感知融合，提升3D人体姿态估计的自适应性与精度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖GCN中固定的骨骼拓扑或通过注意力隐式建模关节关系，难以适应多样化的运动模式，对运动相关的骨骼结构与关节间依赖建模不足。
AI.method: 提出DSR-Net动态结构表征学习框架。包含：动态骨骼关系（DSR）模块，学习超越预定义骨骼连接的关节间自适应依赖；基于学习到的关系构建层次化关系感知融合策略，促进结构与时序表征的有效交互；设计轻量级残差骨骼重校准模块（RSRM），以极小计算开销增强结构感知特征的稳定性。
AI.result: 在Human3.6M与MPI-INF-3DHP数据集上，DSR-Net分别取得37.9 mm与14.9 mm的MPJPE，持续优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了动态骨骼关系建模对鲁棒3D人体姿态估计的有效性。

title: Spatiotemporal Recognition of Abdominal Wall Layers During Optical Trocar Entry
summary: Objective. To evaluate whether spatial context and temporal modeling improve tissue recognition during optical trocar entry, where multiple abdominal-wall tissues may be visible simultaneously. Methods. We retrospectively analyzed 71 recordings with 1,516 annotated keyframes and 29,151 clinician-annotated sectors. Each frame was divided into 28 polar-grid sectors assigned to nine tissue classes. Color, neighboring-sector, and positional features were used by a gradient-boosted emission classifier. The full pipeline added learned temporal smoothing, spatial regularization, an anatomically ordered hidden Markov model, and posterior blending. Five-fold cross-validation was grouped by recording, with cross-fitting to prevent within-recording leakage. Primary evaluation used clinician-derived targets; ablations assessed classification, probability quality, spatial consistency, and peritoneum-or-deeper onset timing. Results. The complete pipeline achieved accuracy 0.646, macro-F1 0.507, and macro-AUROC 0.882, versus 0.600, 0.440, and 0.861 for emissions alone. Macro-F1 improved by 0.066 across all five folds. Label changes decreased from 66.2 to 19.5 per sector-minute, and median onset error decreased from 15.58 to 2.45 seconds. Frames with a tissue-depth-code span of at least three decreased from 53% to 26%, versus 22% for clinician annotations. Performance remained limited for preperitoneal fat and bowel, and the full model retained a 44% premature-onset proportion. Conclusions. Combining appearance, spatial context, and temporal constraints improved retrospective tissue recognition and onset localization. Tissue-specific limitations, residual timing errors, and reliance on future observations warrant external validation and prospective evaluation of causal models before clinical use.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估空间上下文与时间建模能否提升光学套管针穿刺过程中的组织识别性能，构建了融合表观特征、邻域特征、隐马尔可夫模型与后验混合的完整流水线，在回顾性数据上取得优于单帧发射分类器的识别精度与更准的腹膜起始时间定位。
AI.motivation: 光学套管针穿刺时腹壁多层组织可能同时可见，单帧、无空间与时序约束的分类难以稳定识别组织并定位腹膜（或更深层）起始点，故需验证空间上下文与时序建模的增益。
AI.method: 回顾性分析71段录像，含1,516个标注关键帧与29,151个临床医生标注扇区；每帧划分为28个极坐标网格扇区，对应9类组织。采用颜色、邻域扇区与位置特征的梯度提升发射分类器，并叠加学习式时间平滑、空间正则化、解剖顺序隐马尔可夫模型与后验混合。以录像为单位进行五折交叉验证，交叉拟合避免录像内泄漏。以临床医生标注为目标，开展消融实验评估分类、概率质量、空间一致性及腹膜起始时间。
AI.result: 完整流水线准确率0.646、宏F1 0.507、宏AUROC 0.882，优于仅用发射分类器的0.600、0.440、0.861；宏F1在五折中均提升0.066。标签切换由每扇区分钟66.2降至19.5，中位起始误差由15.58秒降至2.45秒。组织深度编码跨度≥3的帧由53%降至26%（临床医生标注为22%）。腹膜前脂肪与肠管识别仍受限，完整模型仍保留44%的过早起始比例。
AI.conclusion: 结合表观、空间上下文与时间约束可改善回顾性组织识别与起始定位；但存在组织特异性瓶颈、残余时间误差及对后验观测的依赖，临床应用前需外部验证并开展因果模型的前瞻性评估。

title: TartanMatch: Towards Universal Dense Correspondence Across Modalities
summary: Robotic platforms combine multi-modal sensors to operate across diverse conditions, but most dense correspondence methods are limited to RGB-RGB or a small set of modality pairs. Training a model for each modality pair scales poorly with the number of sensors and forgoes potential positive transfer across modality pairs. We introduce TartanMatch, a unified model for dense correspondence across all 25 ordered pairs among RGB, event, thermal, depth, and projected LiDAR. TartanMatch adapts an RGB-pretrained correspondence model to all modality pairs within one shared network using lightweight modality adaptation and a mixture of real and synthetic data. On zero-shot real-world benchmarks, TartanMatch reduces Endpoint Error (EPE) over the strongest baselines by 61.9% for cross-modal matching and 49.6% for same-modal matching. We further show that joint training across all modality pairs improves average matching accuracy over pair-specific training, especially on challenging cross-modal pairs. These results demonstrate that a single model achieves broad multi-modal coverage and state-of-the-art matching accuracy.

AI.tldr: TartanMatch 是首个在 RGB、event、thermal、depth、projected LiDAR 五种模态的全部 25 个有序模态对之间实现统一稠密对应的模型，通过轻量模态适配与真实/合成数据混合训练，在零样本真实基准上显著降低匹配误差。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密对应方法多局限于 RGB-RGB 或少量模态对，逐模态对训练模型无法随传感器数量扩展，且放弃了模态对之间的正迁移潜力。因此需要一个能覆盖多模态组合的统一模型。
AI.method: TartanMatch 以 RGB 预训练对应模型为骨干，在单一共享网络中通过轻量级模态适配（lightweight modality adaptation）支持全部 25 个有序模态对，并采用真实数据与合成数据混合的训练策略。
AI.result: 在零样本真实世界基准上，跨模态匹配的 Endpoint Error (EPE) 较最强基线降低 61.9%，同模态匹配降低 49.6%。
AI.conclusion: 跨全部模态对的联合训练相比逐模态对训练能提升平均匹配精度，尤其在困难跨模态对上更明显，表明单一模型即可实现广泛多模态覆盖与最优匹配精度。

title: Compositional Concepts Erasing: Disentangling Object-Style via Domain Manifold Unlearning
summary: Diffusion models pose significant risks regarding the generation of illicit content and copyright violations. This has catalyzed the development of machine unlearning to erase harmful concepts or copyrighted styles from a model's generative repertoire without compromising its general performance. However, previous unlearning approaches on diffusion models have largely focused on either object-level or style-level removal and failed to address the challenge of object-style combination unlearning. At the same time, multiple unlearning requests often lead to catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU), which uses an EMA-updated feature proxy extracted from intermediate diffusion features to represent the retained target-object direction. As a lightweight estimating representation of an object, DMU enables selective unlearning of domain-specific components in a specific object while preserving other semantic representations, thereby significantly enhancing robustness in multiple combination unlearning scenarios. Extensive experiments show that DMU significantly mitigates catastrophic forgetting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods of batch unlearning and sequential unlearning.

AI.tldr: 提出Domain Manifold Unlearning（DMU），用EMA更新的特征代理表示保留的目标物体方向，实现物体-风格组合场景下的选择性遗忘，缓解灾难性遗忘，优于现有批量与顺序遗忘方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型存在生成非法内容与侵犯版权的风险，需要机器遗忘来移除有害概念或受版权保护的风格且不损害通用性能。但现有扩散模型遗忘方法多聚焦于物体级或风格级的单一移除，未能处理"物体-风格组合"遗忘问题；同时多重遗忘请求易导致灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出Domain Manifold Unlearning（DMU）。从扩散中间特征中提取EMA更新的特征代理（feature proxy），用以表示需保留的目标物体方向；作为物体的轻量估计表示，DMU可在特定物体中有选择地遗忘领域相关组件，同时保留其他语义表征。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DMU显著缓解灾难性遗忘，在批量遗忘与顺序遗忘设置下均优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DMU通过域流形层面的特征代理实现物体-风格组合的选择性遗忘，有效应对多重遗忘请求带来的灾难性遗忘，提升扩散模型遗忘的稳健性。

title: We Have Been Interpreting Diffusion Transformer Backbone Behaviors Wrong
summary: During a network forward call, diffusion backbones naturally produce many intermediate activations. If we evaluate each activation against an identical downstream benchmarking protocol, we can plot an inverted-U-shaped curve as the depth profile: the activation's performance goes up first and then down as we go into deeper layers. This is common knowledge in the diffusion model community, which inspires many applications including the widely-adopted REPA. However, the common interpretation of this depth profile may be inaccurate and incomplete: (i) The cause of this curve has long been treated as signal granularity changing from coarse to fine, but there has been little evidence in DiT backbones. (ii) The community has been mainly studying this phenomenon in a static way, without investigating how it changes across different training setups. In this work, we show a different mechanism picture for the profile, where the prediction target (e.g., $ε$, $u$, $x_0$) sits at the center. The semantically meaningful signal is only an intermediate by-product for predicting the target, while the prediction target is the real goal for the backbone. Furthermore, the choice of prediction targets as part of the training setup can predictably affect the curve's shape. With this updated interpretation, many applications of this depth profile can be better grounded and predicted. As an example, we show how to predict the near-optimal placement of REPA based on the prediction target of the training setup. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-compare.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新解释了扩散骨干网络深度维度上性能先升后降的倒U形曲线，提出预测目标（如ε、u、x₀）才是核心，语义信号只是中间副产物；并证明训练设置中的预测目标选择可预测地影响曲线形状，从而更好地指导REPA等应用的最优层位置选择。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型社区普遍观察到：对前向过程中各中间激活施加相同下游基准评估时，性能随深度呈倒U形曲线，并由此衍生出REPA等应用。但既有解读存在两点不足：(i) 长期将成因归为"信号粒度由粗到细"，却缺乏在DiT骨干上的证据；(ii) 研究多为静态视角，未考察该现象在不同训练设置下如何变化。作者希望给出更准确的机制解释，使相关应用有据可依、可被预测。
AI.method: 作者以预测目标为中心构建新的机制图景：语义可解释信号仅是预测目标的中间副产物，预测目标才是骨干的真正学习目标。并将预测目标的选择视为训练设置的一部分，系统研究其对深度曲线形状的影响，据此分析REPA的近似最优插入位置。代码开源在 https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-compare。
AI.result: 研究发现深度曲线的成因并非"信号粒度由粗到细"，而是由预测目标主导；不同预测目标（ε、u、x₀）作为训练设置的一部分，能够可预测地改变曲线的形状。基于该机制，作者能够依据训练设置中的预测目标预测REPA的近似最优层位置。
AI.conclusion: 对扩散深度维度倒U形曲线给出以预测目标为中心的新解释，替代旧有"粒度"假说，并揭示其对训练设置的依赖性；这一更新使REPA等基于深度曲线的应用获得更扎实的理论依据与可预测性。

title: Query-Adaptive Neuron Steering for LLMs
summary: Effectively eliciting the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) at inference time remains an important challenge. Existing studies address this challenge through context engineering, which shapes user queries, or fixed steering, which directly intervenes in model computation. However, predefined contexts and fixed intervention strategies may not adequately accommodate the diverse knowledge and reasoning requirements of individual queries. This raises a natural question: Can internal steering in LLMs be made query-adaptive? In this work, we investigate whether query-induced internal activations can guide adaptive steering in LLMs. Our pilot studies reveal subject- and layer-dependent neuron activation patterns and show that amplifying subject-relevant neurons can improve model performance. Based on these findings, we propose Q-NeuS, a query-adaptive neuron steering framework that dynamically determines which neurons to modulate and by how much for each input. Specifically, Q-NeuS constructs a compact subject-guided candidate neuron space and employs a lightweight Query-Adaptive Gate to generate neuron-wise modulation coefficients. To learn effective intervention strategies, we introduce Neu-GRPO, which adapts group-relative optimization to train the Query-Adaptive Gate using the relative performance of multiple neuron intervention configurations. The base LLM remains frozen throughout training and inference, and no task or subject labels are required at inference time. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that Q-NeuS consistently improves model performance and exhibits broad applicability across model scales and strong cross-benchmark transferability.

AI.tldr: 提出Q-NeuS，一种查询自适应的神经元干预框架，通过动态决定调制哪些神经元及幅度来提升LLM推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文工程仅塑造用户查询，固定steering直接干预模型计算，但预定义上下文和固定干预策略难以适配单个查询在知识与推理需求上的多样性，因此探究内部steering能否做到查询自适应。
AI.method: 基于预实验发现的主题与层级相关神经元激活模式，构建紧凑的主题引导候选神经元空间；用轻量级Query-Adaptive Gate生成神经元级调制系数；提出Neu-GRPO，利用多种神经元干预配置的相对表现训练该门控。基础LLM在训练与推理全程冻结，推理时无需任务或主题标签。
AI.result: 在多种LLM与基准上的大量实验表明，Q-NeuS持续提升模型性能，并在模型规模上具有广泛适用性，且具备较强的跨基准迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 查询诱导的内部激活可有效指导自适应steering，Q-NeuS验证了查询自适应神经元干预的可行性与通用性。

title: ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research
comment: 17 pages, 17 figures, 19 references. Public-data component audit; recursive improvement is specified as a protocol and not experimentally demonstrated
summary: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.

AI.tldr: 该工作将 ScienceBuddy 的递归设计适配到泛血管介入研究，但仅审计一个固定组件（任务掩码卷积模型+启发式支持门控），在 ARCADE 语法与狭窄任务上报告 Dice、AUROC/AUPRC 及弃权接受率，属公开数据上的组件级可复现审计，未实现递归改进或临床验证。
AI.motivation: 泛血管介入研究需要可测量的证据支持与弃权机制，而完整智能体系统的递归优化与模型学习（含强化学习）尚未执行，因此需要一个可复现的组件级审计协议，为未来协作式智能体研究奠定基础。
AI.method: 采用结构化证据账本、器械-血管本体、弃权契约与保留失败库；递归 harness 优化与外层模型学习仅做规格说明而未执行。使用独立的 ARCADE 语法与狭窄任务数据（各 1,000 训练、200 验证、300 测试图像）。共享任务掩码卷积模型按每种表示设置训练一次，随后固定参数与启发式支持门控，狭窄阈值在验证集上选取，测试集锁定评估。
AI.result: 锁定测试集上，语法 Dice 为 0.475（95% CI 0.459–0.490），狭窄 Dice 为 0.231（95% CI 0.214–0.249）；狭窄像素 AUROC 0.957、AUPRC 0.180（患病率 0.00975）。门控对狭窄帧输出的接受率为 76.7%，而仅分数比较器为 100%。构造的掩码审计中接受 44.3% 参考候选、拒绝 55.7%，暴露弃权的代价。
AI.conclusion: 接受不等于正确，也不代表临床安全。该公开数据组件审计使支持与弃权变得可测量，并提供可复现协议供未来协作式智能体研究使用；但未证明递归改进、患者层面有效性或临床器械建议。

title: LongHisDoc: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chinese Long Historical Document Understanding
summary: Chinese historical documents are invaluable cultural treasures, but their complexity poses significant comprehension challenges for non-specialists. Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in modern document tasks, their capabilities in Long (full-book) Historical Document understanding remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongHisDoc, the first benchmark tailored for long historical document understanding. LongHisDoc comprises 1,012 expert-annotated QA pairs derived from 101 PDF documents, with an average of 85.1 pages and 42,776.4 tokens per document. It spans 10 categories and features four QA types: single-page, cross-page, multi-hop, and unanswerable. Answering these questions requires integrating multimodal evidence from text, layout, and visual elements. Our evaluation reveals that the top-performing LVLM and LLM achieve only 62.9% and 69.9% accuracy, respectively, highlighting a substantial performance gap. Furthermore, we assess various modal retrievers and the end-to-end RAG performance to provide references for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. We believe that LongHisDoc serves as a comprehensive benchmark to catalyze future research in full-book historical document understanding. The benchmark and evaluation code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/qweq12433454/LongHisDoc and https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/LongHisDoc.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 LongHisDoc，这是首个面向长篇（整本书）历史文献理解的多模态基准，包含 1,012 个专家标注的 QA 对，覆盖 101 份 PDF（平均 85.1 页、42,776.4 tokens），并评估了 LLM、LVLM 及 RAG 系统在该任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 中国历史文献是重要文化瑰宝，但其复杂性对非专业读者理解构成显著挑战。尽管 LLM 与 LVLM 在现代文档任务中取得成功，其在长篇历史文献理解方面的能力仍未被充分探索，缺乏相应的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 LongHisDoc 基准，包含 1,012 个专家标注 QA 对，源自 101 份 PDF 文档（平均 85.1 页、42,776.4 tokens/篇），涵盖 10 个类别与 4 种 QA 类型（单页、跨页、多跳、不可回答）；问题需融合文本、版式与视觉多模态证据。同时评估多种模态检索器及端到端 RAG 性能。
AI.result: 最佳 LVLM 与 LLM 的准确率分别仅为 62.9% 和 69.9%，凸显出明显的性能差距；并提供了模态检索器与端到端 RAG 的评测参考。
AI.conclusion: LongHisDoc 可作为全面的基准，推动整本历史文献理解方向的未来研究，基准与评测代码已公开。

title: InfraWorld: Motion-Aware World Modeling for Roadside 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: Roadside 4D occupancy forecasting predicts future semantic occupancy in a fixed infrastructure coordinate system. Roadside scenes are globally structured yet locally evolving, requiring comprehensive scene-level context while precisely modeling sparse localized motion. However, existing forecasting paradigms struggle to tackle both requirements. To address this limitation, we propose InfraWorld, a world model formulating roadside occupancy forecasting as selective state evolution. InfraWorld maintains a dense BEV state for the complete scene and persistent motion queries for moving regions, assigning complementary states to global context and local dynamics. Specifically, we propose Dynamic Query Initiation (DQI) to initialize queries in regions supported by motion in the observed history. During rollout, the dense state is updated through Long--Short Temporal Fusion (LST), which combines short-term adjacent-frame continuity with long-term motion trends to preserve stable context while capturing scene evolution. Motion-Aware Query Injection (MAQI) then refines the queries and injects confidence-weighted query information into corresponding BEV tokens, enabling targeted dynamic updates without perturbing global context. Together, InfraWorld concentrates predictive capacity on evolving traffic regions. Extensive experiments on the InfraOcc and Occ3D--nus datasets demonstrate that InfraWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance for roadside 4D occupancy forecasting while retaining its effectiveness under ego-centric settings. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InfraWorld，将路侧 4D 占据预测建模为选择性状态演化：用稠密 BEV 状态表示全局场景，用持久运动查询表示局部动态区域，并通过 DQI、LST 与 MAQI 实现动态区域的针对性更新。
AI.motivation: 路侧场景具有"全局结构化、局部动态演化"的特点，既需要完整的场景级上下文，又需要精确建模稀疏的局部运动。现有预测范式难以同时满足这两点要求。
AI.method: InfraWorld 维护稠密 BEV 状态与持久运动查询，为全局上下文和局部动态分配互补状态：Dynamic Query Initiation（DQI）在观测历史中存在运动的区域初始化查询；rollout 时通过 Long-Short Temporal Fusion（LST）融合短期相邻帧连续性与长期运动趋势来更新稠密状态；Motion-Aware Query Injection（MAQI）细化查询并将置信度加权后的查询信息注入对应 BEV token，实现有针对性的动态更新且不扰动全局上下文。
AI.result: 在 InfraOcc 和 Occ3D-nus 数据集上的大量实验表明，InfraWorld 在路侧 4D 占据预测任务上达到当前最优性能，同时在自车视角（ego-centric）设定下仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: InfraWorld 通过选择性地将预测能力集中于演化中的交通区域，有效兼顾了全局上下文与局部动态，为路侧 4D 占据预测提供了新的世界模型范式。

title: Adversarial Gradient Forcing for Robust Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video generation models generate videos sequentially, with each new block conditioned on previously generated blocks. By training on the model's own rollouts, Self Forcing and its follow-up methods substantially mitigate exposure bias caused by the mismatch between training- and inference-time history distributions. However, these models still suffer from error accumulation during long-horizon generation. We identify a key underlying limitation: the model remains highly sensitive to errors in its generated history, allowing small deviations to be amplified through subsequent generations. We refer to this underexplored problem as the local history robustness gap. To address this gap, we introduce Adversarial Gradient Forcing (AGF), a framework designed to improve the robustness of few-step autoregressive video models to perturbations and accumulated errors in their own generated histories. AGF uses distribution matching gradients from future block predictions to select adversarial perturbations of self-generated histories. It then jointly trains the generator on the original and perturbed histories to improve the robustness of future generation. Extensive experiments show that AGF achieves the highest VBench Total score on 60-second video generation and the best visual quality on four-minute video generation. Notably, AGF achieves such long-horizon robustness while requiring only 5-second rollouts for training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Adversarial Gradient Forcing (AGF) 框架，通过对抗性扰动自生成历史并结合分布匹配梯度联合训练，提升少步自回归视频模型对历史误差的鲁棒性，缓解长时域生成中的误差累积。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成模型逐块生成，每个新块依赖先前生成块。Self Forcing 及其后续方法通过对模型自身 rollout 训练，缓解了训练与推理时历史分布不匹配导致的暴露偏差，但长时域生成中仍存在误差累积问题。作者识别出其关键限制：模型对自身生成历史中的误差高度敏感，微小偏差会被后续生成放大，并将这一未被充分探索的问题称为"局部历史鲁棒性差距"（local history robustness gap）。
AI.method: AGF 框架旨在提升少步自回归视频模型对自身生成历史中扰动与累积误差的鲁棒性。它利用来自未来块预测的分布匹配梯度，筛选针对自生成历史的对抗性扰动；随后在原始历史与扰动历史上联合训练生成器，以改善未来生成的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，AGF 在 60 秒视频生成上取得最高的 VBench Total 分数，并在四分钟视频生成上取得最佳视觉质量。值得注意的是，AGF 在仅需 5 秒 rollout 进行训练的情况下，即实现了如此长时域的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AGF 通过对抗梯度强制提升了自回归视频生成模型对历史误差的局部鲁棒性，有效缓解长时域误差累积，并在长视频生成任务上取得领先性能，同时显著降低了训练所需的 rollout 长度。

title: FrameFold: Response-Guided KV Cache Consolidation for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
summary: In autoregressive video generation, retaining all historical key-value (KV) states increases memory usage and per-step attention costs as videos grow longer. A fixed cache budget bounds these costs but raises the challenge of preserving historical content that supports consistent, high-quality generation. Existing methods control cache size through history selection or consolidation, yet deciding what to retain and how to limit the loss of useful content remains a shared challenge. Our analysis shows that spatial queries depend on different historical content and that higher current attention coverage does not necessarily yield better long-video quality. We introduce FrameFold, a training-free KV cache consolidation method that compares the content retrieved by the same recent historical queries before and after merging to guide both representative construction and merge selection. Exploiting temporal redundancy between adjacent historical entries, FrameFold merges their KV states into shared representatives while retaining complete spatial grids. It fits value-merging coefficients in closed form by matching conditional attention responses, then selects the merge with the lowest remaining response distortion. Under matched KV cache budgets, experiments on Self Forcing and Causal Forcing at 30 and 60 seconds and on LongLive at 120 seconds demonstrate improved consistency and visual quality. Continuous eight-minute Self Forcing rollouts further show less quality degradation than the baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 FrameFold：一种免训练的视频生成 KV 缓存合并方法，通过对比合并前后近期历史查询检索到的内容，指导代表构建与合并选择，在固定缓存预算下提升长视频生成的一致性与视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成中，保留全部历史 KV 状态会随视频增长而增加显存占用与每步注意力开销；固定缓存预算虽能限制成本，却难以在不损失一致性与高质量生成所需历史内容的前提下决定"保留什么、如何避免有用内容损失"。作者分析发现：空间查询依赖不同的历史内容，且当前更高的注意力覆盖率并不必然带来更好的长视频质量，说明现有历史选择/整合策略存在共同难点。
AI.method: FrameFold 为免训练（training-free）的 KV 缓存整合方法：1）以同一组近期历史查询在合并前后所检索到的内容进行对比，指导代表性构建与合并选择；2）利用相邻历史条目之间的时间冗余，将其 KV 状态合并为共享代表，同时保留完整的空间网格；3）以闭式解拟合 value 合并系数，使条件注意力响应相匹配；4）选择剩余响应失真最低的合并方案。
AI.result: 在匹配 KV 缓存预算下，Self Forcing 与 Causal Forcing 在 30 秒、60 秒以及 LongLive 在 120 秒的实验均显示一致性（consistency）与视觉质量提升；Self Forcing 连续 8 分钟长程 rollout 的质量下降幅度小于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FrameFold 通过在响应匹配目标下进行 KV 缓存合并与选择，在受限缓存预算内更有效地保留对生成有用的历史信息，从而改善长视频自回归生成的质量与一致性，且无需额外训练。

title: Reward-Aligned Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but remains computationally expensive and sample inefficient. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, yet standard OPD distills every token regardless of whether the teacher's preference actually improves task reward. Existing token-selection methods rely on proxies such as uncertainty or teacher--student divergence, which need not identify reward-improving supervision. We introduce Reward-Aligned Distillation (RAD), a bilevel framework that weights distillation signals based on their predicted effect on the student's post-update reward. RAD differentiates through a temporary optimizer step to score each token's supervision, then updates the token weights by projected ascent from the initial token weights. The resulting weights can strengthen, suppress, or reverse individual distillation-gradient contributions. At a matched training-response budget, RAD improves mean accuracy on six competition-math benchmarks over the strongest baselines by 6.5 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and 2.5 points for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. RAD-Simple, a simplified variant, achieves comparable math accuracy at the same training-response budget. On LiveCodeBench-v6, RAD reaches 54.69\% and 58.67\% pass@1 with Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and OLMo3-7B-Instruct, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by 8.7 and 6.4 points. These results support reward-guided weighting of teacher supervision across model families and tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reward-Aligned Distillation（RAD），一种双层框架，依据蒸馏信号对学生更新后奖励的预测影响来加权token级监督。RAD通过临时优化器步进行微分，为每个token监督打分，并沿投影上升更新token权重，使权重能够增强、抑制或反转单个蒸馏梯度贡献。在匹配训练响应预算下，RAD在六个竞赛数学基准上对Qwen3-1.7B提升6.5个百分点、对Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507提升2.5个百分点；在LiveCodeBench-v6上达到54.69%和58.67% pass@1，分别超过最强基线8.7和6.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 带可验证奖励的强化学习虽能提升大模型推理能力，但计算昂贵且样本效率低；在线策略蒸馏（OPD）可从更强教师提供密集的token级监督，然而标准OPD对所有token一视同仁，未考虑教师偏好是否真正提升任务奖励，现有token选择方法依赖不确定性或师生分歧等代理指标，难以准确识别有助于提升奖励的监督信号。
AI.method: RAD是一种双层框架，基于蒸馏信号对学生更新后奖励的预测效果来加权蒸馏信号。具体地，RAD通过一个临时优化器步骤进行微分，为每个token的监督打分，然后从初始token权重出发以投影上升方式更新token权重。所得权重可增强、抑制或反转单个蒸馏梯度的贡献。此外还提出简化变体RAD-Simple。
AI.result: 在匹配训练响应预算下，RAD在六个竞赛数学基准上相较最强基线，Qwen3-1.7B（非思考模式）平均准确率提升6.5个百分点，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507提升2.5个百分点；RAD-Simple在相同预算下数学准确率相当。在LiveCodeBench-v6上，Qwen3-1.7B（非思考模式）与OLMo3-7B-Instruct分别达到54.69%和58.67% pass@1，超过最强基线8.7和6.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，跨模型家族与任务，奖励引导的教师监督加权是有效的，验证了RAD框架及其简化变体的通用性与优越性。

title: Uniform Information Density-Based Preference Optimization
summary: To enable large language models to generate outputs that align with human preferences, optimization algorithms based on the comparison between chosen and rejected output pairs have been developed and been proven effective. Some recent endeavors have utilized certain linguistically-derived assumptions about the preference pairs to guide the design of more precise optimization directions. However, human preferences are complex and hard to measure by simplistic criteria, and it is important to incorporate broader and more sophisticated insights about preferred vs. not-preferred language. In this study, we adopt a well-established psycholinguistic theory, Uniform Information Density, to develop a novel preference optimization algorithm, UIDPO. The basic assumption is that humans prefer to produce language in which information is uniformly distributed, because uniformity induces less cognitive processing effort. To implement this idea into the algorithm, we derive a compound metric for information uniformity by combining the global standard deviation and the local second-order difference, and integrate it to the objective of preference optimization. We compare UIDPO with SimPO, a previous state-of-the-art method, obtaining comparable and sometimes better performance on AlpacaEval2, ArenaHard, and MT-Bench. Additional linguistic analysis on complement clauses also shows that UIDPO can better reflect the tendencies of keeping information uniform in natural language than baselines. Our results show that the subtle human preference over the information rate in language is a helpful source for achieving better human alignment for LLMs. The code repository is published here: https://github.com/CLCS-SUSTech/UIDPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UIDPO，一种基于心理语言学"均匀信息密度"（UID）理论的新型偏好优化算法，通过复合指标衡量信息均匀性并融入偏好优化目标，在多个基准上取得与SimPO相当甚至更优的表现，并能更好反映自然语言中的信息均匀性倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有基于chosen/rejected偏好对的优化算法多依赖简化的语言学假设来设计优化方向，但人类偏好复杂，难以用简单标准衡量，因此需要引入更广泛、更精细的语言偏好理论来指导偏好优化。
AI.method: 采用心理语言学中成熟的"均匀信息密度"（Uniform Information Density）理论，提出UIDPO偏好优化算法。其基本假设是人类倾向于产出信息均匀分布的语言，因为均匀性可降低认知加工负担。算法通过结合全局标准差与局部二阶差分构建信息均匀性的复合度量，并将其整合进偏好优化目标中。
AI.result: 在AlpacaEval2、ArenaHard和MT-Bench上，UIDPO与先前最先进方法SimPO相比取得相当甚至更优的性能；对补语从句的额外语言学分析表明，UIDPO比基线更能反映自然语言中保持信息均匀分布的趋势。
AI.conclusion: 语言信息速率上的细微人类偏好是实现大语言模型更好人类对齐的有效来源，将心理语言学理论融入偏好优化可提升对齐效果。代码已开源。

title: Fine-Tuning Strategy, Not Just Data: A Statistically Rigorous Audit of Gender and Stereotypical Bias in Embedding Models for HR Recommendation Systems
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at RecSys in HR '26 (The 6th Workshop on Recommender Systems for Human Resources)
summary: Embedding models underpin modern job-candidate matching: resumes, job descriptions, and queries are encoded as dense vectors, and recommendations come from nearest-neighbor retrieval over that space. Any social bias in the embeddings therefore feeds directly into HR recommendations. We audit six multilingual sentence-embedding models (LaBSE- and E5-family, both public and custom fine-tuned) using Bias-in-Bios (occupational gender bias) and StereoSet (stereotypes across profession, race, gender, and religion). We treat statistical validity as a first-class concern: we identify a non-independence error in a naive significance test, where pooling non-independent pairwise similarities inflated a trivial 0.0046 mean difference to $p \approx 0$, and replace it with a profession-level paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, individual-resampling bootstrap confidence intervals, and permutation tests for StereoSet. Under the corrected methodology, knowledge-distillation (KD) fine-tuning of E5-Base significantly increases measured bias on Bias-in-Bios ($Δ= -0.177$, $p < 10^{-8}$; more negative means more bias), although this measure is sensitive to global embedding geometry. The KD result is corroborated by pro-stereotype patterns in the StereoSet profession category (uncorrected $p < 0.05$). Binary-classification fine-tuning of the same base model shows no statistically distinguishable change ($p = 0.218$). Fine-tuning strategy is thus an actionable design lever for practitioners building HR recommenders. We also report which benchmark categories are underpowered, and note that two domain-adapted models could not be included in significance testing due to a software-access constraint, which limits our conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了六种多语言句嵌入模型在招聘场景中的社会偏见，重点修正了显著性检验中的非独立性错误，发现知识蒸馏微调会显著加剧职业性别偏见，而二元分类微调无统计学显著变化，表明微调策略是可操作的设计杠杆。
AI.motivation: 嵌入模型是现代职位-候选人匹配的核心，简历、职位描述和查询都被编码为稠密向量并通过最近邻检索进行推荐，因此嵌入中的任何社会偏见都会直接传导至HR推荐结果。作者希望系统性地审计多语言嵌入模型的偏见，并将统计有效性作为首要关切，纠正既有评估方法中的方法学缺陷。
AI.method: 审计六种多语言句嵌入模型（LaBSE族与E5族，含公开版与定制微调版），使用Bias-in-Bios（职业性别偏见）和StereoSet（职业、种族、性别、宗教刻板印象）两个基准。识别出朴素显著性检验中的非独立性错误——将非独立的成对相似度合并使0.0046的均值差异被夸大为p≈0；改用职业层级配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验、个体重采样自助法置信区间，以及StereoSet的置换检验。实验对比了知识蒸馏微调与二元分类微调两种策略。
AI.result: 在修正后的方法学下，E5-Base的知识蒸馏（KD）微调显著增加了Bias-in-Bios上的测量偏见（Δ= -0.177，p < 10⁻⁸；越负表示偏见越大），但该指标对全局嵌入几何敏感。KD结果得到StereoSet职业类别中亲刻板印象模式的支持（未修正p < 0.05）。同一基座的二元分类微调未显示统计学可区分的变化（p = 0.218）。此外报告了哪些基准类别统计功效不足，并指出两个领域适配模型因软件访问限制无法纳入显著性检验，限制了结论的推广。
AI.conclusion: 微调策略是构建HR推荐系统的从业者可操作的设计杠杆：知识蒸馏微调会显著加剧偏见，而二元分类微调则不会。同时强调统计有效性在偏见审计中的重要性，指出现有基准存在功效不足问题，且软件访问限制导致的模型缺失限制了结论范围。

title: Remembering What Matters for Long-Horizon Robotic World Models
summary: Autoregressive robot video world models based on discrete visual tokens remain unreliable over long rollout horizons. Retaining the entire generated history does not necessarily improve prediction quality. We investigate a possible memory-role conflict in Full Context decoding: persistent scene information, recent visual-action states, and stale generated history compete for attention despite their different predictive roles. This perspective motivates ReCAP (Receding Context with Anchor Preservation), a training-free context-scheduling method for long-horizon robot video world models. ReCAP keeps the pretrained tokenizer, world model, and visual decoder frozen. It preserves the initial scene anchor and a contiguous window of recent complete visual-action blocks while evicting older generated history. The schedule preserves within-block structure and temporal order, requires no additional modules or parameter updates, and bounds active-context growth independently of rollout length. We evaluate ReCAP on RT-1, BridgeV2, LIBERO-90, and CALVIN using frozen autoregressive world models. Across evaluated environments and horizons, ReCAP improves visual fidelity, action-conditioned consistency, and robot structure preservation relative to Full Context. On BridgeV2, it reduces LPIPS by 63.3%. In the system benchmark at H=64, it reduces the logical KV footprint by 73.3% and p50 latency by 6.51%. Attention analyses show increased attention to retained recent states, while history interventions associate larger amounts of stale context with higher prediction error. These observations are consistent with the memory-role-conflict hypothesis, although they do not isolate it from context-length and position-handling effects. Our results support inference-time context scheduling as a practical approach to improving long-horizon robot video prediction and computational efficiency without retraining.

AI.tldr: ReCAP是一种免训练的长时程机器人视频世界模型上下文调度方法：保留初始场景锚点与近期完整视觉-动作块，驱逐陈旧生成历史，在提升预测质量的同时降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 基于离散视觉token的自回归机器人视频世界模型在长时程推演中不可靠，保留全部生成历史未必提升预测质量。作者推测Full Context解码中存在"记忆角色冲突"：持续的场景信息、近期视觉-动作状态与陈旧的生成历史虽具不同预测作用，却在注意力上相互竞争。
AI.method: ReCAP（Receding Context with Anchor Preservation）固定预训练tokenizer、世界模型与视觉解码器，仅做推理期上下文调度：保留初始场景锚点与一段连续的近期完整视觉-动作块，驱逐更早的生成历史；保持块内结构与时间顺序，无需额外模块或参数更新，并使活跃上下文增长与推演长度无关。
AI.result: 在RT-1、BridgeV2、LIBERO-90、CALVIN上以冻结自回归世界模型评测，ReCAP在视觉保真度、动作条件一致性与机器人结构保持上均优于Full Context；BridgeV2上LPIPS降低63.3%；H=64系统基准下逻辑KV占用降低73.3%，p50延迟降低6.51%。注意力分析显示对保留近期状态的注意力上升，历史干预表明陈旧上下文越多预测误差越高。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持推理期上下文调度可在不重训练的情况下改善长时程机器人视频预测质量与计算效率；注意力观察与记忆角色冲突假设一致，但尚不能将其与上下文长度及位置处理效应完全区分。

title: Flow-Support-Weighted Proposals for Test-Time Verified VLA Policies
comment: 35 pages, 5 figures, under review in AAAI 2027
summary: Test-time sampling promises to turn one action prediction into a set of distinct executable candidates that a verifier can choose among. Downstream fine-tuning works against that promise. A vision-language-action model trained to solve one task distribution concentrates its flow-matching decoder around the dominant demonstrated action, so repeated samples differ only marginally and the verifier receives many copies of one decision. We call this proposal contraction and identify it as a key constraint on test-time scaling: repeated samples can remain highly redundant as the candidate budget grows. Action Dynamic Sampling (ADS) alleviates the constraint on the proposal side, during training. At each training step, ADS integrates $K$ additional trajectories from the current policy under fresh base noise, scores each by the flow support along its path with a Hutchinson trace estimator, and corrects the policy's local action distribution toward this weighted set through a detached finite-set KL term. Training cost rises; deployment cost is unchanged. Across simulation and four physical-robot tasks, ADS raises proposal spread without the success penalty that Gaussian perturbation incurs, lifts oracle best-of-8 success on RoboCasa from 57.6% to 63.0%, improves fixed verifiers by 2.4 to 4.9 points in simulation, and raises TokenPB by up to 13.0 points on real-world manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"提案收缩"(proposal contraction)现象，指下游微调后的VLA模型在测试时采样高度冗余，限制了测试时扩展的收益；作者提出训练期方法Action Dynamic Sampling (ADS)，通过采样、打分与有限集KL校正扩大提案分布，在不增加部署成本的前提下提升采样多样性与任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 测试时采样本应把一个动作预测转化为多个可执行的候选动作，供验证器择优选择。但下游微调会与这一目标相冲突：针对单一任务分布训练的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，其流匹配解码器会集中于被演示的主导动作，导致重复采样差异极小，验证器只能拿到同一个决策的多份副本。作者将这一现象命名为"提案收缩"，并将其视为制约测试时扩展的关键瓶颈——随着候选预算增加，重复样本可能仍高度冗余。
AI.method: ADS在训练阶段从提案侧缓解该约束。每一步训练中，ADS利用当前策略在新的基础噪声下额外积分K条轨迹，用Hutchinson迹估计器依据轨迹路径上的流支撑度对每条轨迹打分，并通过一个detached的有限集KL项，将策略的局部动作分布朝该加权集合方向校正。该方法增加训练成本，但部署成本不变。
AI.result: 在仿真及四类真实机器人任务上，ADS提升了提案分散度且未带来高斯扰动所导致的成功率损失；将RoboCasa上的oracle best-of-8成功率从57.6%提升至63.0%；在仿真中使固定验证器提升2.4至4.9个百分点；在真实世界操作任务中将TokenPB最多提升13.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ADS通过训练期的分布校正缓解了提案收缩问题，在不增加部署开销的情况下有效提升测试时采样的多样性与下游成功率，为测试时扩展在VLA模型中的应用提供了一条可行路径。

title: Attribute-Centric Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Gait Understanding
summary: Walking sequences reveal human-interpretable attributes related to body structure, posture, and motion. Gait attribute recognition provides a concrete route to fine-grained gait understanding by predicting these attributes. However, existing benchmarks provide limited fine-grained annotations, while classifier-based gait attribute recognition methods typically represent candidate classes through learned output weights rather than directly matching visual evidence with textual class representations. To address the annotation gap, we present RA-GAR, a large-scale, richly annotated multimodal benchmark for gait attribute recognition, containing 1,001 subjects, 242,729 walking sequences, and annotations for 15 static and motion gait attributes. We further propose Gait-VL, an attribute-centric vision-language alignment framework that recognizes gait attributes by matching attribute-specific multi-frame visual evidence with textual class prototypes. On the visual side, attribute-specific learnable queries aggregate RGB features across spatial locations and frames into per-attribute visual embeddings. On the language side, diverse descriptions expanded by a large language model are combined with context about relevant body regions to construct textual class prototypes. Beyond attribute recognition, we evaluate the transferability of the attribute-pretrained visual encoder by using it to replace generic upstream large vision models in identityoriented gait recognition pipelines; attribute pre-training uses no identity classification or metric-learning objectives. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art attribute recognition performance on RA-GAR and consistent improvements in downstream identity recognition across multiple pipelines and benchmarks, supporting the effectiveness and transferability of attribute-centric gait representation learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出大规模多模态步态属性识别基准RA-GAR，以及基于视觉-语言对齐的Gait-VL框架，实现属性识别与下游身份识别的双重提升。
AI.motivation: 现有步态属性识别面临两大瓶颈：一是基准数据集缺乏细粒度属性标注；二是基于分类器的方法通过学习的输出权重表示候选类别，无法直接将视觉证据与文本类别表示进行匹配，限制了细粒度步态理解能力。
AI.method: 构建RA-GAR基准（1,001名受试者、242,729个行走序列、15种静态与运动步态属性标注）。提出Gait-VL属性中心视觉-语言对齐框架：视觉端用属性特定的可学习查询，跨空间位置和帧聚合RGB特征，生成逐属性视觉嵌入；语言端用大语言模型扩展的多样描述，结合相关身体区域上下文，构建文本类别原型，通过匹配视觉证据与文本原型完成识别。
AI.result: 在RA-GAR上取得最先进的属性识别性能；将属性预训练的视觉编码器替换通用上游大视觉模型后，在多种身份步态识别流程和多个基准上均获得一致的下游身份识别提升。
AI.conclusion: 属性预训练不使用身份分类或度量学习目标，仍能有效支持下游身份识别，验证了属性中心步态表征学习的有效性与可迁移性。

title: ToF-Wheel Odometry: Navigating Degeneration of Localization With Limited Sensing Capabilities
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted by IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Wheel odometry provides an efficient motion prior for ground robots but is prone to transient violations such as wheel slip or terrain-induced tilt. In filtering-based odometry, these violations frequently trigger divergence when they coincide with constrained geometric observability (e.g., featureless corridors). We address this challenge by proposing ToF-Wheel Odometry (TWO), a tightly-coupled filtering framework that integrates wheel kinematics with geometric constraints from Time-of-Flight (ToF) cameras. The primary contribution of this work is a degeneracy-aware, directional covariance-shaping strategy that replaces heuristic online covariance tuning with geometry-conditioned inflation. The core idea is to infer process noise from geometric corrections with a strict reliability check. We decompose the posterior-to-prior correction into a wheel-explainable subspace and an orthogonal remainder. The process covariance is anisotropically adjusted according to the observability of the ToF update: if the geometry is degenerate in non-kinematic directions, the remainder is suppressed as sensor noise; if the geometry is distinct, it is admitted as a valid kinematic violation. Additionally, we introduce an intra-frame feedback loop that retrospectively repairs the process covariance within the current frame to reduce structural lag during bursty disturbances. Extensive experiments on challenging scenarios demonstrate that TWO improves trajectory accuracy and robustness compared to static and adaptive Gaussian filtering, robustly navigating the trade-off between kinematic reliability and limited sensing capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TWO（ToF-Wheel Odometry），一种紧耦合滤波框架，将轮式运动学与ToF相机几何约束结合，通过退化感知的方向性协方差整形策略，提升轮式里程计在打滑、地形倾斜等扰动下的精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 轮式里程计为地面机器人提供高效的运动先验，但在轮子打滑、地形倾斜等瞬态扰动下容易失效；在滤波式里程计中，这些扰动若与几何可观性受限（如无特征走廊）同时发生，常引发状态估计发散。现有启发式在线协方差调参缺乏可靠性保证，难以在运动学可靠性与有限感知能力间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出TWO紧耦合滤波框架，核心是退化感知的方向性协方差整形策略：以几何修正推断过程噪声并进行严格可靠性检查。将后验到先验的修正分解为"轮式可解释子空间"与正交余量，依据ToF更新的可观性对各向异性调整过程协方差——若几何在非运动学方向上退化，则把余量作为传感器噪声抑制；若几何信息充分，则将余量接纳为有效的运动学扰动。此外引入帧内反馈回路，在当前帧内回溯修正过程协方差，以缓解突发扰动下的结构性滞后。
AI.result: 在多项具有挑战性的场景实验中，TWO相较静态与自适应高斯滤波方法提升了轨迹精度与鲁棒性，能够稳健地权衡运动学可靠性与有限感知能力之间的冲突。
AI.conclusion: 将过程噪声推断与几何可观性绑定、并以方向性协方差整形替代启发式调参，是应对轮式里程计瞬态扰动与几何退化耦合问题的有效途径，帧内反馈进一步增强了突发扰动下的响应能力。

title: Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers for Multimodal Anomaly Detection
summary: The effective integration of features derived from RGB images and 3D point clouds presents a substantial challenge in the field of multimodal anomaly detection (MAD). Existing MAD methods typically rely on static fusion paradigms built upon frozen pre-trained encoders. While these frameworks facilitate spatial alignment, they lack the mechanism to establish latent semantic correspondence, thereby inducing cross-modal interference that degrades anomaly discriminability. To mitigate these limitations, this study proposes a Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers (BAT) framework, which constructs comprehensive and semantically aligned multimodal representations by leveraging complementary attributes across modalities. The BAT framework introduces a Bidirectional Feature Alignment (BFA) module, which employs a mutual predictive mechanism to bridge the gap between 2D textural patterns and 3D geometric structures. This bidirectional interaction explicitly enhances the textural granularity of point cloud descriptors while augmenting the spatial contextual awareness of RGB features. To ensure that the latent representations possess sufficient informational density for alignment, BAT incorporates a parameter-efficient adaptation architecture. By utilizing lightweight image and point cloud adapters, the framework facilitates specialized fine-tuning of pre-trained models, mitigating the information loss inherent in frozen encoders. Extensive experiments conducted on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies confirm that BAT achieves state-of-the-art anomaly detection performance, significantly outperforming existing MAD methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向自适应Transformer（BAT）框架，通过双向特征对齐与参数高效适配解决多模态异常检测中的跨模态干扰问题，在MVTec 3D-AD与Eyecandies上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态异常检测（MAD）方法多基于冻结预训练编码器的静态融合范式，虽能实现空间对齐，但缺乏建立潜在语义对应的机制，导致跨模态干扰并削弱异常判别能力。
AI.method: 提出BAT框架：1）双向特征对齐（BFA）模块，采用互预测机制弥合2D纹理模式与3D几何结构之间的差距，双向交互增强点云描述子的纹理粒度，并提升RGB特征的空间上下文感知；2）参数高效适配架构，通过轻量级图像与点云适配器对预训练模型进行专用微调，缓解冻结编码器带来的信息损失，保证潜在表示具备足够的信息密度以支撑对齐。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD与Eyecandies数据集上的大量实验表明，BAT取得最先进的异常检测性能，显著优于现有MAD方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过双向语义对齐与参数高效微调构建语义一致的多模态表示，可有效抑制跨模态干扰并提升多模态异常检测的判别能力，BAT为该问题提供了有效范式。

title: Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning
summary: Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. FASD separates these goals into two complementary channels. The behavior channel distills appropriate refusals from an ignorance-prompted copy of the model itself. Crucially, target tokens are masked from the teacher distribution to avoid accidentally reteaching the forgotten concepts. Simultaneously, the knowledge channel directly suppresses ground-truth answer spans independently of the model's generated responses. Experiments demonstrate that FASD successfully unlearns target knowledge, prevents information leakage in open-ended tasks, and preserves performance on retained data. The resulting model not only forgets the specified information but accurately recognizes the boundaries of its own knowledge. Code and data will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出Forget-Aware Self-Distillation（FASD），通过行为与知识双通道实现"诚实无知"，既真正遗忘目标知识又能准确识别自身知识边界。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态遗忘评估仅关注模型是否停止输出目标信息，这一表层标准掩盖了两类关键失效模式：(1)知识抑制技术常引发虚构，使模型对已遗忘主题产生幻觉；(2)拒绝训练只改变可观察行为而未真正抹除底层知识，模型可能在开放式查询中拒绝但在多项选择探测下仍能识别正确答案。因此需要实现"诚实无知"，即模型真正失去目标知识并学会承认其缺失。
AI.method: FASD将目标拆分为两个互补通道：行为通道从经无知提示的模型自身副本中蒸馏恰当的拒绝行为，并在教师分布中屏蔽目标token以避免意外重新教授被遗忘概念；知识通道独立于模型生成响应，直接抑制真实答案span。二者结合实现诚实无知。
AI.result: 实验表明FASD成功遗忘目标知识，防止开放式任务中的信息泄漏，并保持对保留数据的性能。所得模型不仅遗忘指定信息，还能准确识别自身知识边界。
AI.conclusion: FASD通过行为与知识双通道的自蒸馏框架实现了"诚实无知"，克服了知识抑制引发虚构与拒绝训练仅改变行为而不抹除知识的两大局限，为多模态遗忘提供了更严格的评估与解决方案。代码与数据将在发表后公开。

title: EviScene: Beyond "Is It AI?" for Agentic Image Factuality Assessment
summary: Determining whether an image is AI-generated does not establish whether the situation it depicts is factually supported. We formulate Image Factuality Assessment: given an image and a generic verification instruction, a system returns a supported or refuted verdict with an evidence-grounded explanation. Without a supplied textual claim, the system must progressively refine factual questions during investigation and align external evidence with the specific situation depicted. We introduce EviLens, an expert-reviewed benchmark of 10,174 supported and refuted images from controlled construction and web collection, covering twelve factual error types and evaluating both verdict accuracy and evidence sufficiency. We develop EviScene, a multimodal ReAct agent that interleaves visual inspection, external retrieval, and evidence analysis, using new findings to refine its questions and revisit relevant image details. We train a compact policy with supervised fine-tuning on reviewed teacher trajectories, followed by privileged on-policy self-distillation applied to verified decisions from the policy's own investigations. On the 1,527-image test set, the trained Qwen3.5-9B agent achieves 79.05% balanced accuracy and a Strict Evidence Sufficiency Rate (SESR) of 52.26%, improving over the same-backbone base agent by 6.71 and 9.37 percentage points, respectively. Its SESR is the highest among the evaluated agents.Code, models, and data will be released at https://github.com/wangzian828/EVISCENE and https://huggingface.co/ZiAnwang/EviScene.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"图像事实性评估"任务，要求系统在无文本声明的情况下判断图像所描绘情景是否有事实依据并给出证据支撑的解释；同时发布专家审核基准EviLens及多模态ReAct智能体EviScene，通过监督微调与特权在线自蒸馏训练紧凑策略，在测试集上取得79.05%平衡准确率与52.26%严格证据充分率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于判定图像是否为AI生成，但"是否AI生成"并不等同于"图像所描绘的情景是否有事实依据"。此外，真实场景往往不提供文本声明（claim），系统需自主提出并逐步细化事实性问题，并将外部证据与图像中具体情景对齐，这一能力此前缺乏任务定义与评测基准。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"图像事实性评估"任务：输入图像与通用验证指令，输出supported/refuted判定及基于证据的解释。2) 构建EviLens基准：10,174张图像，来自受控构造与网络采集，涵盖12类事实错误类型，同时评测判定准确率与证据充分性。3) 提出EviScene多模态ReAct智能体：交替进行视觉检查、外部检索与证据分析，并利用新发现细化提问、回访图像细节。4) 训练紧凑策略：先在教师轨迹上做监督微调，再对策略自身调查中经验证的决策进行特权在线自蒸馏（privileged on-policy self-distillation）。
AI.result: 在1,527张图像的测试集上，基于Qwen3.5-9B训练得到的智能体达到79.05%平衡准确率与52.26%严格证据充分率（SESR），相较同骨干的基座智能体分别提升6.71与9.37个百分点；其SESR在所有受评智能体中最高。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将图像真实性研究从"生成来源检测"拓展到"事实性支撑评估"，明确了任务定义、构建了多类型错误覆盖的专家审核基准，并验证了ReAct式调查与自蒸馏训练在紧凑模型上的有效性；代码、模型与数据将开源。

title: EarthAlign: Learning Language-Aligned Representations of Earth System Data
summary: Interpreting Earth system conditions is central to understanding environmental risks and informing decisions across weather- and climate-sensitive sectors. Existing multimodal weather systems primarily target task-specific prediction, generation, or question answering, while general-purpose alignment between Earth system data and language remains underexplored due to the limited availability of diverse language supervision grounded in meteorological conditions.
