To fill this gap, we introduce EarthAlign, a large-scale dataset with broad geographic coverage spanning 2000-2024 that combines 10 expert-curated natural event and disaster data sources with climatology-derived normal-weather samples. Each sample includes temporal and geospatial information and four grounded caption styles aligned with 63-variable ERA5 meteorological data. Building on EarthAlign, we introduce MeteoLIP, a dual-encoder framework for learning aligned meteorology-language representations. MeteoLIP incorporates MetTok, which uses a geolocation- and time-conditioned query to aggregate variable-specific patch embeddings into a compact sequence of meteorology tokens. To comprehensively assess Earth system multimodal representations, we introduce three downstream tasks: cross-modal retrieval, weather-condition classification, and physical variable estimation. Our experiments show that MeteoLIP improves upon the corresponding CLIP and SigLIP baselines across these tasks. Further analyses highlight the importance of meteorological input, temporal and geospatial conditioning, and multi-style supervision for meteorology-language alignment. Thus, EarthAlign and MeteoLIP provide a foundation for learning and evaluating language-aligned representations of Earth system data. Our code, dataset, and weights are publicly available at https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/EarthAlign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出地球系统数据集 EarthAlign 与多模态对齐框架 MeteoLIP，实现气象数据与语言的对齐表征学习，并在三项下游任务上超越 CLIP/SigLIP 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有气象多模态系统多针对特定任务（预测、生成、问答），由于缺乏基于气象条件的多样化语言监督，地球系统数据与语言的通用对齐研究不足。
AI.method: 构建 EarthAlign 大规模数据集（2000–2024，覆盖广泛地理区域，整合 10 个专家整理的自然事件与灾害数据源及气候态常态天气样本，每样本含时空信息和四种接地描述风格，对齐 63 变量 ERA5 数据）；提出双编码器框架 MeteoLIP 学习气象—语言对齐表征，其 MetTok 模块利用地理位置与时间条件查询，将变量特定的 patch 嵌入聚合为紧凑气象 token 序列；并设计跨模态检索、天气状态分类、物理变量估计三项下游任务进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明 MeteoLIP 在三项下游任务上均优于对应的 CLIP 与 SigLIP 基线；消融分析证实气象输入、时空条件化及多风格监督对对齐全的重要性。
AI.conclusion: EarthAlign 与 MeteoLIP 为地球系统数据的语言对齐表征学习与评估提供了基础，代码、数据集与权重已公开。

title: DuSRFlow: Dual-Lens Super-Resolution via Parallax-Aware Flow Estimation and Complementary Reference Warping
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
summary: Dual-lens super-resolution (DuSR) aims to enhance a wide-angle low-resolution (LR) image by exploiting a telephoto reference (Ref) image. A central challenge in DuSR is reliable reference utilization under large parallax, occlusion, and cross-camera imaging discrepancies. Existing methods often employ off-the-shelf monocular optical flow models to provide geometric priors. However, their assumptions of photometric consistency and smooth motion are violated in dual-lens scenarios, leading to unreliable alignment and degraded reference-based reconstruction. To address these issues, we propose DuSRFlow, a dual-lens super-resolution framework that improves reference utilization from both correspondence learning and reference aggregation. First, we introduce DuFlowNet, a dedicated dual-lens flow estimator for robust cross-view alignment. To train DuFlowNet without ground-truth flow annotations, we develop a real--synthetic data fusion strategy that composites synthetic foreground objects onto real dual-lens image pairs, generating controllable large-parallax samples while preserving realistic cross-camera imaging characteristics. Second, we observe that reference reliability is highly spatially uneven in DuSR, where unreliable local reference responses may suppress the utilization of reliable cues. We therefore propose a Complementary Reference Warping strategy that coordinates patch-based warping and kernel-free-guided deformable warping according to local reference reliability, producing a more reliable reference representation before LR--Ref fusion. In addition, we construct DuSR-RealV2, a challenging real-world benchmark with complex depth variations, large parallax, and occlusion. Extensive experiments on multiple DuSR benchmarks demonstrate that DuSRFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstruction quality, perceptual quality, and cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出 DuSRFlow 双镜头超分框架，从对应学习与参考聚合两方面提升参考图像利用可靠性，实现 SOTA 重建与泛化性能。
AI.motivation: DuSR 需在大视差、遮挡和跨相机成像差异下可靠利用长焦参考图；现有方法直接套用单目光流模型，其光度一致性与平滑运动假设在双镜头场景中不成立，导致对齐不可靠、参考重建退化。
AI.method: 1) 提出 DuFlowNet，专用双镜头光流估计器实现鲁棒跨视角对齐；采用真实-合成数据融合策略，将合成前景目标合成到真实双镜头图像对上，在保持真实跨相机特性的同时生成可控大视差样本，从而无需光流真值标注即可训练。2) 观察到参考可靠性在空间上高度不均匀，提出互补参考变形策略，依据局部参考可靠性协调基于块（patch-based）的变形与无核引导可变形（kernel-free-guided deformable）变形，在 LR–Ref 融合前生成更可靠的参考表示。3) 构建 DuSR-RealV2 真实世界基准，包含复杂深度变化、大视差与遮挡。
AI.result: 在多个 DuSR 基准上的大量实验表明，DuSRFlow 在重建质量、感知质量与跨数据集泛化方面均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过专用双镜头光流估计与可靠性自适应的参考聚合，有效解决双镜头大视差下的参考对齐与利用问题，并配合更挑战性的真实基准验证了方法的有效性与泛化能力。

title: The Company a Question Keeps: Auditing Open Jev-Style Models for Retrieval
summary: Jev's documented interface evaluates typed questions independently against shared evidence. We audit request independence in seven open Jev-style checkpoints on 276 constructed three-passage states from 92 TREC retrieval queries. Paired interventions separately change requested questions, displayed evidence, and candidate eligibility. Request expansion induces strict binary flips in 9.1%/8.0% of Nimble's judgments and changes 21.4%/18.9% of selection-or-abstention actions in TREC DL2019/2020 under a threshold of 0.5 fixed before inference. Correct-action rates change by 0.0/+8.2 percentage points, respectively, with 95% query-bootstrap intervals of [-6.0,6.0] and [3.8,12.6]. Field masking traces all 70 request-set flips to the schema fields serialized into each scoring prompt. In Von, fixing a shared separator's position eliminates two eligibility-induced preference flips in selected diagnostic states. Laya-typed's default CUDA path produces five passage swaps without strict binary flips, and both yearly action-change intervals include zero; in an FP32 rerun, its probability movement vanishes at the model's four-decimal reporting resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了七个开放Jev风格检查点中"请求独立性"（request independence）是否成立：在92个TREC查询构造的276个三段落状态上，通过成对干预分别改变请求问题、展示证据与候选资格，发现请求扩张可诱发严格二值翻转并改变选择/弃权动作，字段掩码可追溯至评分提示中序列化的schema字段。
AI.motivation: Jev的文档化接口假设typed questions是针对共享证据独立评估的，即请求独立性应成立。然而这一假设缺乏实证检验，若被违反，则评分结果会受无关请求集合的干扰，导致选择与弃权决策不可靠。作者因此系统审计多个开源Jev风格检查点，检验请求、证据与候选资格三者的相互影响。
AI.method: 在92个TREC检索查询上构造276个三段落状态，对七个开放Jev风格检查点进行成对干预实验：分别改变请求问题（request expansion）、展示证据、候选资格，观察判断是否发生严格二值翻转及选择/弃权动作变化。推理前固定阈值0.5，并采用95% query-bootstrap区间评估正确动作率变化。进一步用字段掩码（field masking）定位序列化入评分提示的schema字段，并考察共享分隔符位置对资格诱发偏好翻转的影响，同时在不同数值精度（默认CUDA路径与FP32重跑）下比较概率移动的分辨率。
AI.result: 在TREC DL2019/2020上，请求扩张使Nimble的判断发生9.1%/8.0%的严格二值翻转，并使选择/弃权动作变化21.4%/18.9%；正确动作率变化分别为0.0/+8.2个百分点，95% query-bootstrap区间为[-6.0,6.0]与[3.8,12.6]。字段掩码将全部70次请求集翻转追溯到序列化入评分提示的schema字段。在Von中，固定共享分隔符位置消除了选定诊断状态下两次资格诱发的偏好翻转。Laya-typed默认CUDA路径产生五次段落交换但无严格二值翻转，且两年动作变化区间均包含零；FP32重跑中其概率移动在四位小数报告分辨率下消失。
AI.conclusion: 请求独立性在多个开放Jev风格检查点中并不普遍成立：请求扩张与字段序列化可系统性改变判断与选择/弃权动作，且部分效应依赖于模型实现细节（分隔符位置、数值精度）。因此以typed questions独立评估为核心的接口设计需重新审视，评分提示的字段构造与实现级细节应作为可靠性审计的关键对象。

title: Automatic assembly modeling through attention-based assembly feature mate prediction and assembly feature pattern recognition
summary: Assembly modeling plays an important role in constructing product models, yet it is still mainly performed via interactive operations that are experience-dependent and labor-intensive. Data-driven strategies hold promise for automating this process; however, existing approaches either predict poses that cannot directly generate editable B-Rep assembly constraints or require prescribed part pairs or predefined assembly faces. To reduce the large candidate space of constraint prediction without predefined assembly faces, we propose a data-driven framework based on assembly feature mate prediction. The framework performs automatic assembly modeling from unassembled B-Rep parts, using assembly features to group the geometric entities of local mating interfaces and restrict candidate formation. Given the lack of suitable assembly feature annotations in existing datasets, we construct a large-scale dataset through an automatic annotation pipeline. Using the annotated dataset, we train an attention-based network to predict assembly feature mates, with Engineering Compatibility Fusion (ECF) incorporating explicit engineering compatibility into learned matching scores. To improve the accuracy of automatic assembly modeling, we use assembly feature patterns (AFPs) to guide the matching process. Finally, a post-processing search selects assembly feature mate and AFP mate candidates, whose associated constraints are generated and solved to complete assembly modeling. Experimental results show that the framework achieves assembly constraint accuracies of 74.79% on the six-assembly comparison set and 64.09% on the extended test set of 16 assemblies, which includes the comparison set. With ground-truth face labels supplied as additional input, the corresponding accuracies increase to 81.78% and 80.93%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于装配特征配合预测的数据驱动框架，实现从非装配B-Rep零件自动生成可编辑装配约束与装配建模，并构建大规模自动标注数据集。
AI.motivation: 装配建模目前主要依赖交互式操作，依赖经验且耗时费力；现有数据驱动方法或只能预测无法直接生成可编辑B-Rep装配约束的位姿，或需要预先指定零件对/装配面，导致约束预测候选空间过大。
AI.method: 以装配特征配合预测为核心：用装配特征对局部配合界面的几何实体分组并限制候选生成；通过自动标注流水线构建大规模数据集；训练基于注意力的网络预测装配特征配合，并用工程兼容性融合（ECF）将显式工程兼容性引入学习到的匹配分数；用装配特征模式（AFP）引导匹配；最后通过后处理搜索选择装配特征配合与AFP配合候选，生成并求解相应约束以完成装配建模。
AI.result: 在六装配对比集上装配约束准确率为74.79%，在包含该对比集的16装配扩展测试集上为64.09%；当额外提供真实面标签作为输入时，准确率分别提升至81.78%和80.93%。
AI.conclusion: 装配特征配合预测能有效缩小约束候选空间，在无需预定义装配面的情况下实现较高精度的自动装配建模；引入真实面标签可进一步提升精度。

title: PVFH-Bench: Benchmarking Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, object hallucination remains a persistent challenge, undermining model reliability in applications such as visual question answering, embodied agents, and human-AI decision support systems. In this paper, inspired by cognitive science studies on perceptual bias, we investigate a new failure mode termed Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination (PVFH). Specifically, PVFH refers to a premise-induced reasoning error in which models become anchored to visually confusable evidence, accept a false textual premise, and subsequently generate responses about an absent yet visually plausible object. To systematically study this phenomenon, we introduce PVFH-Bench, a benchmark that automatically constructs visually confusable but absent targets and pairs the core hallucination setting with diagnostic subsets to trace how models move from object recognition to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Experimental results on 10 state-of-the-art LVLMs demonstrate that all evaluated models are highly vulnerable to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Moreover, we find that explicit chain-of-thought reasoning can further exacerbate this failure mode by encouraging models to overinterpret weak visual cues as supporting evidence for hallucinated objects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究了一种新的大视觉语言模型失败模式——前提诱导的视觉固着幻觉（PVFH），并构建了 PVFH-Bench 基准来系统评估该现象。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态任务上进展显著，但物体幻觉始终是持续存在的难题，损害了其在视觉问答、具身智能体和人机决策支持等应用中的可靠性。作者受认知科学中知觉偏差研究启发，希望探究一种新的幻觉失败模式。
AI.method: 作者定义了 PVFH：一种前提诱导的推理错误，模型被视觉上易混淆的证据锚定，接受错误的文本前提，进而对实际不存在但视觉上合理的物体生成回答。为系统研究该现象，构建了 PVFH-Bench 基准，自动构造视觉上易混淆但实际缺失的目标，并将核心幻觉设置与诊断子集配对，以追踪模型从物体识别走向 PVFH 的过程。
AI.result: 在 10 个最先进 LVLMs 上的实验表明，所有被评估模型都极易受到 PVFH 影响。此外，显式的思维链（chain-of-thought）推理会进一步加剧该失败模式，促使模型将微弱的视觉线索过度解读为幻觉物体的支持证据。
AI.conclusion: PVFH 是 LVLMs 中普遍且严重的幻觉失败模式，思维链推理可能放大而非缓解该问题，提示需针对前提诱导的视觉固着现象设计更稳健的缓解策略。

title: Can Synthetic UAV Benchmarks Be Trusted? Real-Synthetic Validation for UAV Model Selection
summary: Synthetic UAV imagery can expand pre-deployment test evidence when task-specific Real data are scarce, but visual plausibility or semantic label alignment alone does not establish validity for model selection. We study when Synthetic evaluation preserves the model-selection conclusions obtained from Real UAV data through two complementary cases under fixed evaluation protocols. In a requirement-specific road-debris benchmark, four language-conditioned perception systems obtain lower absolute F1 on Synthetic data, yet the point-estimate ordering and top-ranked model are preserved; bootstrap analysis yields no supported pairwise reversal, and size-matched resampling preserves the top-model decision. In contrast, a closed-set stress test on a separately materialized business corpus, using four VisDrone-compatible detectors over eight empirically supported classes, changes the point-estimate top-ranked detector and reverses three of six pairwise point-estimate preference directions. A complementary audit of five UAV business scenarios further reveals substantial Real-Synthetic mismatch in class composition, object density, and target scale, including systematic under-representation of small targets. These results show that Synthetic UAV benchmark trust is conditional: semantic coverage is insufficient, and validity must be established empirically for the task, operating regime, and model panel of interest.

AI.tldr: 合成无人机图像可补充真实数据稀缺时的评估证据，但其有效性是有条件的：一项道路碎片基准中合成数据保留了模型选择结论，而一项闭集压力测试中则改变了首选检测器并反转了部分成对偏好，且真实-合成数据在类别构成、目标密度与目标尺度上存在显著失配。
AI.motivation: 任务相关的真实无人机数据稀缺，合成图像可扩展部署前测试证据；但仅凭视觉合理性或语义标签对齐不足以确立合成的有效性，需明确合成评估在何种条件下能保持基于真实数据的模型选择结论。
AI.method: 在固定评估协议下开展两个互补案例研究：(1) 需求特定的道路碎片基准，使用四个语言条件感知系统，结合 bootstrap 分析与规模匹配重采样检验点估计排序与首选模型；(2) 在单独构建的业务语料上进行闭集压力测试，使用四个与 VisDrone 兼容的检测器和八个经验支持的类别，比较点估计排序与成对偏好方向。此外对五个无人机业务场景进行真实-合成失配审计。
AI.result: 案例一：合成数据上四个系统的绝对 F1 更低，但点估计排序与首选模型保持一致，bootstrap 未支持任何成对反转，规模匹配重采样亦保持首选决策。案例二：首选检测器发生改变，六个成对点估计偏好方向中有三个反转。审计发现真实与合成数据在类别构成、目标密度和目标尺度上存在显著失配，包括小目标的系统性欠表示。
AI.conclusion: 合成无人机基准的可信度是有条件的：语义覆盖并不充分，其有效性必须针对具体任务、运行工况和模型集合进行经验性验证。

title: TAG: Calibrating SAM3 for Universal Image Segmentation without Dense Supervision
summary: The recent Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) extends powerful promptable segmentation from spatial cues to concepts, raising the prospect of a single foundation model for universal image segmentation. However, this promise often fails to translate into reliable performance on downstream segmentation tasks. In this work, we empirically identify concept recognition, rather than mask quality, as the primary bottleneck: SAM3 accurately delineates the objects it recognizes yet struggles to robustly determine which concepts are present. Driven by this, we present \textit{\underline{T}ext \underline{A}nchor re-\underline{G}rounding (\TAG{})}, a simple yet effective framework that rectifies the concept recognition of SAM3 on the target domain without dense annotations. Specifically, \TAG{} introduces an \textit{Anchor Residual Pathway} comprising image-conditioned, low-rank adapters to re-ground text anchors in the target distribution and modulate subsequent text-conditioned interactions. Guided solely by image-level category labels, \TAG{} jointly optimizes binary cross-entropy with \textit{Soft Boundary Ranking} objectives to calibrate presence confidence and distinguish present concepts from confusable negatives. Building upon this, we devise \textit{Confidence-Weighted Distillation} to couple rich semantic context of a multimodal large language model with fine-grained spatial priors of SAM3, thereby achieving effective calibration in the absence of manual annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \TAG{} unlocks SAM3's segmentation potential with only 3.1M trainable parameters, achieving impressive performance across diverse scenarios, and notably, even surpassing leading mask-supervised methods on several metrics. \href{https://github.com/MiSsU-HH/TAG_SAM3}{Our code will be publicly available at GitHub \faGithub}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAG框架，实证发现SAM3在下游分割任务中的主要瓶颈是概念识别而非掩码质量，通过文本锚点重定位在无密集标注条件下修正概念识别，仅用3.1M可训练参数显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: SAM3将可提示分割从空间线索扩展到概念层面，但这一能力在下游任务中往往无法转化为可靠性能。作者希望通过实证分析找出真正的性能瓶颈所在，以针对性改进。
AI.method: 实证分析定位瓶颈为概念识别；提出TAG框架，引入锚点残差通路（图像条件的低秩适配器）在目标分布上重定位文本锚点并调制后续文本条件交互；仅用图像级类别标签，联合优化二元交叉熵与软边界排序目标以校准存在置信度并区分易混负类；进一步设计置信度加权蒸馏，耦合多模态大语言模型的语义上下文与SAM3的细粒度空间先验。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TAG仅用3.1M可训练参数即可释放SAM3的分割潜力，在多样化场景中取得优异性能，在若干指标上甚至超越领先的掩码监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 概念识别是SAM3下游应用的核心瓶颈，通过轻量化的文本锚点重定位与蒸馏策略可有效校准概念存在性判断，从而在无密集标注条件下显著提升通用分割性能，为基座模型下游适配提供了高效途径。

title: Prospective Forcing: Learning to Look Ahead for Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos through chunk-wise rollouts, yet they are typically trained to predict only the immediate future. This limited prediction horizon makes it challenging to maintain video quality over extended rollouts. To address this problem, we introduce Prospective Forcing, a multi-head prediction framework that injects long-range predictive signals into autoregressive video representations. Built on a rolling-window generator, Prospective Forcing attaches lightweight, offset-specific heads that share the same conditioning information and independently predict chunks at different future temporal offsets. By extending supervision beyond the next chunk, these heads encourage the shared history representation to retain information useful for longer-horizon prediction, supporting temporally consistent generation. At inference time, we accelerate sampling by using accepted future-chunk predictions to skip full-window backbone executions. We equip the head with learnable embeddings to generate multiple candidates for the next chunk, and a learned verifier either selects a candidate or rejects all and falls back to standard autoregressive generation.

AI.tldr: 提出Prospective Forcing，通过多头部预测框架为自回归视频生成注入远距离预测信号，提升长视频生成的时间一致性，并利用未来块预测加速推理。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成器通过分块展开合成视频，但训练时仅预测紧邻的未来（next chunk），预测视野受限，导致在长时间展开中难以维持视频质量。
AI.method: 在滚动窗口生成器基础上，附加轻量级、偏移特定的多个预测头，共享相同条件信息，分别独立预测不同未来时间偏移处的chunk；将监督扩展到下一个chunk之外，促使共享历史表示保留有利于更长视野预测的信息。推理时，为头部配备可学习嵌入以生成下一个chunk的多个候选，并用学习到的验证器选择候选或拒绝全部并回退到标准自回归生成；利用被接受的未来chunk预测跳过完整窗口主干执行以加速采样。
AI.result: 通过扩展监督范围增强共享历史表示的长时预测能力，支持时间一致性生成；推理阶段借助接受的未来块预测跳过完整窗口主干执行，实现采样加速。
AI.conclusion: Prospective Forcing为自回归视频生成提供了一种兼顾长时一致性与推理效率的多头预测框架。

title: TGuide: Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Historical Trajectory Guidance
summary: Can autoregressive video diffusion be accelerated further when only four denoising steps remain? Existing feature caching approaches struggle in this regime, as large feature changes between denoising timesteps undermine both direct reuse and lightweight predictors. We observe that features across video chunks remain strongly correlated at matching denoising timesteps, offering a complementary source of guidance. Building on this insight, we introduce TGuide, a framework that accelerates autoregressive video diffusion through a lightweight Anchor-Transport-Correct (ATC) predictor guided by historical sampling trajectories. Our ATC combines two complementary references: the current chunk's preceding-step features preserve its spatial structure, while the previous chunk's same-timestep features provide information at the target denoising stage. By integrating these references through spatial retrieval and adaptive correction, ATC improves velocity prediction accuracy despite the large gaps between denoising steps. To mitigate error accumulation across both denoising steps and video chunks, we train the predictor on its own autoregressive rollouts, allowing it to adapt to states shaped by its own earlier predictions. An optional confidence-aware scheduler further adjusts the quality-efficiency trade-off. Experiments on Self Forcing, Causal Forcing, and HY-WorldPlay show that TGuide preserves generation quality while achieving denoising speedups of up to $1.89\times$ over the original 4-step generators. On Self Forcing, TGuide generalizes from 81-frame training videos to 333-frame generation, approximately four times the training length, while exceeding the original model's VBench score.

AI.tldr: 提出TGuide框架，利用视频块间相同去噪时间步特征的强相关性，通过轻量级Anchor-Transport-Correct（ATC）预测器加速自回归视频扩散，在仅剩4步去噪的场景下实现最高1.89倍加速并保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散在仅剩4步去噪时难以进一步加速：现有特征缓存方法因去噪时间步之间特征变化剧烈，导致直接复用与轻量预测器均失效。作者观察到视频块（chunk）在相同去噪时间步上的特征仍保持强相关性，可作为补充的引导信息。
AI.method: 提出TGuide框架，核心为轻量级Anchor-Transport-Correct（ATC）预测器，由历史采样轨迹引导。ATC融合两类互补参考：当前块的前一步特征（保留空间结构）与上一块相同时间步特征（提供目标去噪阶段信息）；通过空间检索（spatial retrieval）与自适应校正（adaptive correction）整合参考，提升大步长下的速度预测精度。为缓解去噪步与视频块两维度的误差累积，预测器在自身自回归rollout上训练以适配自身预测形成的状态；另提供置信度感知调度器调节质量-效率权衡。
AI.result: 在Self Forcing、Causal Forcing与HY-WorldPlay上，TGuide在保持生成质量的同时，相比原始4步生成器实现最高1.89倍的去噪加速。在Self Forcing上，TGuide可从81帧训练视频泛化至333帧生成（约为训练长度的4倍），且VBench分数超过原始模型。
AI.conclusion: 跨视频块相同去噪时间步的特征相关性可作为有效引导信号，据此设计的ATC预测器能在极少去噪步下显著加速自回归视频扩散，并具备良好的长度泛化能力与质量保持性。

title: TETRIS-4DGS: Efficient Post-Training Compression of 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has emerged as a powerful dynamic scene representation, supporting real-time high quality rendering but suffers from prohibitive storage overhead. Existing methods typically attempt to solve this by treating compression as a per-scene optimization problem, limiting generalizability and applicability where low-latency compression is required. In this work, we leverage existing image and video codecs and propose a generalized post-training compression framework for 4DGS to address these issues. Specifically, we apply importance-based adaptive quantization to Gaussians according to their importance levels, effectively refining bitrate allocation while remaining fully compatible with existing codecs. To further improve compression efficiency, we utilize the statistical properties of 4DGS and propose motion- and importance-aware packing to reorganize attributes into codec-friendly 2D maps. Our approach can achieve over 40x compression rate in seconds while maintaining high quality, facilitating the practical deployment of 4DGS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向4DGS的通用后训练压缩框架，利用现成编解码器，通过重要性自适应量化与运动/重要性感知打包，在数秒内实现40倍以上压缩且保持高质量。
AI.motivation: 4DGS支持实时高质量动态场景渲染，但存储开销极大。现有压缩方法将其视为逐场景优化问题，泛化性差，难以满足低延迟压缩需求，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 基于现有图像与视频编解码器构建通用后训练压缩框架：对高斯按重要性进行自适应量化以优化比特分配，并保持与现有编解码器完全兼容；利用4DGS统计特性，提出运动与重要性感知的打包策略，将属性重排为编解码友好的2D图。
AI.result: 在数秒内即可实现超过40倍的压缩率，同时保持高质量渲染，显著提升4DGS的实用部署能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过后训练、编解码器兼容的量化与打包设计，兼顾泛化性与低延迟压缩，为4DGS的高效存储提供了可行方案。

title: SPARE: Shared Perception and Adaptive Retrieval of Evidence for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions from the observed video, with evidence drawn from recent observations or earlier events. Historical context can improve recall but may interfere with judgments based on recent frames. Its usefulness depends on both when it is introduced and which clips are selected, while relevance alone does not guarantee sufficient evidence for an answer. We propose SPARE, a framework that combines adaptive historical retrieval with visual encoder sharing. A lightweight gate predicts whether recent observations provide sufficient evidence to answer the question. When additional evidence is predicted to be necessary, a multimodal embedding model retrieves relevant historical clips to supplement the current context. LoRA instruction tuning trains the understanding model to use recent observations and retrieved history jointly and abstain when the evidence remains insufficient. To reduce redundant visual parameters, the understanding and retrieval branches share a visual encoder while retaining separate language backbones. Four linear adapters align the shared features with the retrieval model through distillation at the visual token and final retrieval embedding levels. With visual-only inputs, SPARE achieves 77.78% on the evaluated Real-time and Backward task groups of OVO-Bench and 73.31% on StreamingBench. Compared with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluated at 2 fps, SPARE improves accuracy by 20.68 percentage points on OVO-Bench and 14.15 percentage points on StreamingBench.

AI.tldr: SPARE是一个结合自适应历史检索与视觉编码器共享的流式视频理解框架，通过轻量门控判断是否需要检索历史片段，并用LoRA指令微调让模型联合使用近期观测与检索历史，在OVO-Bench和StreamingBench上显著优于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需要根据观测视频回答问题，证据可能来自近期观测或更早事件。历史上下文能提升召回，但也可能干扰基于近期帧的判断，其效用取决于引入时机与片段选择；仅凭相关性不足以确保证据充分。因此需要一个能自适应决定是否检索、何时检索以及如何联合利用历史证据的框架。
AI.method: 提出SPARE框架，包含三部分：（1）自适应历史检索：用轻量门控预测近期观测是否足以回答问题，若不足则用多模态嵌入模型检索相关历史片段补充上下文；（2）LoRA指令微调理解模型，使其联合使用近期观测与检索历史，并在证据仍不足时选择弃答；（3）视觉编码器共享：理解分支与检索分支共享同一视觉编码器但保留独立语言主干，通过蒸馏在视觉token和最终检索嵌入两个层面用四个线性适配器对齐共享特征。
AI.result: 在仅使用视觉输入的设置下，SPARE在OVO-Bench的Real-time和Backward任务组上达到77.78%，在StreamingBench上达到73.31%。与以2 fps评估的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct相比，SPARE在OVO-Bench上准确率提升20.68个百分点，在StreamingBench上提升14.15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应历史检索、门控决策、LoRA指令微调与视觉编码器共享，SPARE有效解决了流式视频理解中历史证据利用与近期证据干扰之间的平衡问题，并在多个流式视频理解基准上取得显著性能提升。

title: Competition Domains Matter: Selective Head Globalization for Training-Free Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Training-free sparse attention is a practical route to efficient video diffusion transformer inference, yet existing methods typically fix the competition domain at each query row for every attention head. Prior work primarily addresses how to estimate token-level importance within this fixed domain; whether the domain itself should adapt to head heterogeneity remains under-specified. We introduce EG-Sparse, a training-free framework that routes low-entropy heads to a grouped cross-head pool while retaining per-row local selection for high-entropy heads, using only scores already materialized by the sparse pipeline. A controlled diagnostic fixes the ranking score and varies only the competition rule: grouped cross-head selection reduces low-entropy-head reconstruction error by 9.8%, whereas forcing high-entropy heads into an all-head global pool increases it by 7.9%. Across four configurations, EG-Sparse achieves higher video quality while reducing attention density and GPU denoising latency compared with strong training-free sparse-attention baselines. Mechanism ablations further show that selective domain adaptation outperforms uniform, random, and fixed domain-assignment policies. These results support competition-domain adaptation as a distinct design axis within centroid-guided training-free sparse attention.

AI.tldr: 提出EG-Sparse：一种免训练稀疏注意力框架，依据注意力头的熵值自适应选择竞争域——低熵头路由至分组跨头池，高熵头保留逐行局部选择，从而提升视频质量并降低注意力密度与GPU去噪延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练稀疏注意力方法在视频扩散Transformer推理中，通常为每个注意力头在每个查询行固定竞争域，主要研究如何在固定域内估计token重要性，而"竞争域本身是否应随头异质性自适应调整"这一问题尚未明确。作者认为竞争域自适应是一个被忽视的独立设计轴。
AI.method: EG-Sparse为免训练框架，仅利用稀疏流水线中已物化的分数进行路由：将低熵头分配到分组跨头池（grouped cross-head pool），高熵头保留逐行局部选择（per-row local selection）。通过受控诊断实验固定排序分数、仅改变竞争规则，并开展机制消融对比选择性域自适应与均匀、随机、固定域分配策略。
AI.result: 受控诊断显示：分组跨头选择使低熵头重构误差降低9.8%，而强制高熵头进入全头全局池使误差上升7.9%。在四种配置下，EG-Sparse相比强基线实现更高视频质量，同时降低注意力密度与GPU去噪延迟。机制消融表明选择性域自适应优于均匀、随机与固定域分配策略。
AI.conclusion: 竞争域自适应是质心引导免训练稀疏注意力中的一个独立设计轴；按头熵值选择性调整竞争域可有效提升视频扩散Transformer推理的效率与质量。

title: CAST-ASD: Causal Attention over Speakers and Time for Online Active Speaker Detection
summary: We present CAST-ASD (Causal Attention over Speakers and Time), a causal joint model for active speaker detection (ASD). Recent ASD models improve performance by jointly processing all faces in a scene, but operate offline, with the full clip available before any frame is labelled. Low-latency causal detectors instead process each face independently. CAST-ASD combines joint face reasoning with fully causal inference. It applies scene-level attention across faces within the current frame and causal temporal attention over each face's history, enabling information sharing across speakers with zero lookahead. Its parameter count does not grow with the number of faces. On MSDWild, where most negative face-frames contain a visible competing speaker, CAST-ASD reduces competing-speaker false alarms by 32% relative to the causal per-face detector it extends, with larger gains as scene occupancy increases. It outperforms all causal baselines on both validation splits while using only one-tenth the inter-speaker parameters of a three-block fixed-roster convolution. Code and models are available at https://github.com/prathamg007/CAST-ASD.

AI.tldr: 提出因果联合主动说话人检测模型CAST-ASD，在零前瞻条件下实现帧内跨人脸场景级注意力与逐人脸因果时序注意力，参数量不随人脸数增长，相比因果逐人脸基线将竞争说话人误报降低32%。
AI.motivation: 现有ASD模型通过联合处理场景中所有人脸提升性能，但需离线获得完整视频片段；低延迟因果检测器虽可实时，却独立处理每张人脸，无法利用说话人间的信息共享。因此需要一种兼顾联合人脸推理与完全因果推理的方法。
AI.method: 提出CAST-ASD（Causal Attention over Speakers and Time）。在当前帧内对所有脸施加场景级注意力，对每张脸的历史施加因果时序注意力，从而在零前瞻下实现跨说话人信息共享；其参数量不随人脸数量增长。
AI.result: 在MSDWild上（多数负样本人脸帧含可见竞争说话人），CAST-ASD相比其所扩展的因果逐人脸检测器将竞争说话人误报降低32%，且随场景占据度提高增益更大；在两个验证划分上均优于所有因果基线，同时仅使用三块固定名册卷积的十分之一跨说话人参数。
AI.conclusion: CAST-ASD证明完全因果的联合人脸推理能在低延迟约束下有效提升ASD性能，尤其在多说话人密集场景中显著抑制竞争说话人误报，并提供开源代码与模型。

title: HumanPhys: A Human-Centric Physical-World Perception Benchmark for Real-World Visual Reasoning
summary: We introduce HumanPhys, a human-centric benchmark for real-world physical perception, and a training corpus emitted by the same pipeline. Each question targets a physically grounded quantity related to people, including depth, inter-person distance, gaze angle, displacement, velocity, heading-step trajectory, blink count, and contact-deformation strength. The rendered probes additionally test illumination inference from body and face cues and camera ego-motion, both with and without a person in the frame. All labels are derived programmatically from sensor calibration, source metadata, or renderer state, rather than written by annotators or produced by estimators on the benchmark frames. HumanPhys systematically probes six dimensions of human-centric physical perception: spatial state, kinematics, blink events, deformation, illumination, and camera pose. To the best of our knowledge, no existing MLLM benchmark-and-training corpus jointly supervises this set of human-centered physical quantities under direct metadata- or renderer-derived labels. The six dimensions appear only partially dissociable across the tested MLLMs. We benchmark a range of open- and closed-source MLLMs on HumanPhys and find that all six capability dimensions remain challenging for current models. We hope HumanPhys will support future research on multimodal systems that perceive and reason about people in the physical world.

AI.tldr: HumanPhys：面向真实世界"人物中心"物理感知的多模态大模型基准与训练语料，标签由传感器标定/元数据/渲染器状态程序化生成，覆盖六个维度，评测显示现有开源与闭源MLLM均表现吃力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型（MLLM）基准缺乏对"人物"这一真实物理世界中核心对象的系统性物理量监督；标注多依赖人工或模型估计器，易引入偏差且难以覆盖深度、运动学、形变等多类量。作者希望提供同时兼具训练语料与评测基准的资源，直接以元数据/渲染器状态导出标签，推动模型对物理世界中人的感知与推理研究。
AI.method: 提出HumanPhys基准及同管线生成的训练语料。问题针对人物相关的物理量：深度、人际距离、注视角度、位移、速度、朝向—步态轨迹、眨眼次数、接触形变强度等；渲染探针还测试基于身体与面部线索的光照推断及相机自运动（有无人物入镜两种情况）。所有标签均由传感器标定、源元数据或渲染器状态程序化导出，而非人工撰写或对基准帧跑估计器得到。评测覆盖空间状态、运动学、眨眼事件、形变、光照、相机位姿六个维度。
AI.result: 据作者所知，尚无既有MLLM基准与训练语料在该组人物中心物理量上以元数据/渲染器标签进行联合监督；六个维度在所测MLLM中仅部分可解耦。对多种开源与闭源MLLM的评测表明，全部六个能力维度对当前模型仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: HumanPhys为"感知并推理物理世界中的人"的多模态系统研究提供了标签可靠、维度系统的基准与训练资源，提示现有MLLM在该方向仍有显著提升空间。

title: A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition
summary: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知混合框架用于印度手语(ISL)词级识别:熵驱动SVD采样提取关键帧,连续双位置编码+距离感知弹性Transformer保留手语节奏,运动学条件自适应GCN建模双手几何;自建120类、9453视频数据集,并引入Physical Node Dropout与ArcFace,取得89.8%准确率。
AI.motivation: ISL识别面临三大挑战:手语速度多变、空间结构复杂;其双手性需要精确建模;且缺乏大规模词汇基准,标准模型难以处理不规则手语速度,导致计算冗余与性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 熵驱动SVD采样器动态提取信息量大的关键帧以减少计算冗余;2) 针对子采样造成的不规则物理时间间隔,采用连续双位置编码(Continuous Dual Positional Encoding)结合距离感知弹性Transformer(Elastic Transformer)保留自然手语节奏;3) 空间上使用运动学条件自适应GCN(Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN),以统一的骨骼-关节特征显式建模双手几何;4) 引入Physical Node Dropout与ArcFace优化抑制被试特异性记忆。
AI.result: 构建了120类、9453个视频的本地ISL数据集;在Physical Node Dropout与ArcFace辅助下,框架达到89.8%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为复杂手语建模建立了强有力的基线,验证了结构感知与时间自适应设计在ISL词级识别中的有效性。

title: Demiurge: Forging Navigable 4D Worlds via Autoregressive Video Rerendering
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Demiurge，一种基于动态4D点云记忆缓存的自回归视频重渲染管线，通过外观视频扩散模型、记忆一致的深度补全、记忆感知双流warping和几何感知视频精修四个组件，提升跨轨迹一致性，实现单视频输入下的新颖视角视频合成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散方法独立处理相机轨迹，缺乏跨轨迹一致性，无法构建连贯、可导航的4D世界，难以支撑世界建模、具身智能与机器人仿真等应用。
AI.method: 构建动态4D点云记忆缓存，并采用自回归视频重渲染框架，包含：(1)以4D记忆为条件的外观视频扩散模型；(2)记忆一致的视频深度补全模型，对齐已知区域深度并补全缺失区域；(3)记忆感知双流warping，提供高保真视觉引导与遮挡线索；(4)几何感知视频精修以提升感知质量。
AI.result: 实验达到SOTA性能，并具备三项关键能力：密集多视角轨迹下的连贯时空晶格构建；大视差视频重渲染（含180度旋转且与输入视角无重叠）；几何忠实的输出，可优化为高质量3D高斯泼溅表示且伪影极少。
AI.conclusion: Demiurge通过4D点云记忆与跨轨迹一致性设计，突破了独立轨迹处理的局限，实现了连贯可导航的4D世界重建，并可直接用于高质量3DGS优化。

title: VoTSpeech: Decoupling Voice Design from Speech Generation in Instruction-Following TTS
summary: Instruction-following text-to-speech (TTS) typically leaves voice design implicit, as conventional speaker embeddings encode reference audio rather than text-driven targets. We propose VoTSpeech, which decouples voice design from speech generation via an explicit intermediate voice latent. Built on a shared language model backbone, VoTSpeech first predicts a continuous voice latent from text instructions using a flow-based module. This latent serves as a shared condition for both the language model and the Acoustic DiT, guiding autoregressive sequence modeling and acoustic latent generation, respectively, before an audio VAE decoder converts the acoustic latents into waveforms. To capture speaker identity and complementary acoustic nuances, the voice latent is jointly supervised by speaker embeddings and temporally pooled audio VAE features. With task-specific adaptation, VoTSpeech performs strongly on InstructTTSEval-ZH, demonstrating competitive capabilities against strong open-source models while maintaining high naturalness. These results confirm that explicit voice latent design and its conditioning interface effectively empower text-driven voice design for controllable speech synthesis. Code, model, and audio samples are available at https://github.com/ywbn/VoTSpeech .

AI.tldr: 提出 VoTSpeech 框架，通过显式中间"语音潜变量"将语音设计从语音生成中解耦，在 InstructTTSEval-ZH 上取得与强开源模型相当的表现。
AI.motivation: 指令跟随式 TTS 通常将音色设计隐含化，因为传统说话人嵌入编码的是参考音频而非文本驱动的目标音色，导致从文本指令控制音色设计的能力受限。作者希望对"语音设计"与"语音生成"进行显式解耦，以实现可控的文本驱动音色设计。
AI.method: VoTSpeech 基于共享语言模型骨干。首先用基于 flow 的模块从文本指令预测一个连续语音潜变量；该潜变量作为共享条件，分别指导语言模型的自回归序列建模与 Acoustic DiT 的声学潜变量生成；最后由音频 VAE 解码器将声学潜变量还原为波形。语音潜变量由说话人嵌入与时间池化的音频 VAE 特征联合监督，以同时捕捉说话人身份与互补的声学细节。并采用任务特定适配。
AI.result: 在 InstructTTSEval-ZH 上，VoTSpeech 通过任务特定适配表现强劲，与强开源模型相比具备竞争力，同时保持高自然度。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实，显式语音潜变量的设计及其条件化接口能够有效赋能文本驱动的音色设计，实现可控语音合成。代码、模型与音频样例已开源。

title: PURE: Refining Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction with Unlabeled Post-training
comment: Accepted by ACMMM 2026. Project Page: https://funnyguy525.github.io/PURE-Page/ Github: https://github.com/jiah-cloud/PURE
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have achieved remarkable progress through large-scale training and strong learned priors. However, they remain fragile when applied to dynamic in-the-wild videos, where non-rigid motion, occlusions, and illumination changes are prevalent. A key limitation lies in their reliance on expensive depth and camera pose annotations, which hinders scaling to diverse real-world dynamic data and restricts generalization. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{PURE}, an unlabeled post-training refinement framework that improves depth and camera estimation without requiring ground-truth supervision. Instead of relying on annotations, PURE elegantly distills robust structural knowledge from state-of-the-art 2D priors into 4D feed-forward architectures. PURE leverages relative depth constraints, affine-invariant geometry distillation, and pose refinement based on feature correspondences to stabilize geometric predictions under challenging dynamic conditions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world dynamic benchmarks demonstrate that PURE delivers consistent improvements across multiple state-of-the-art architectures. Furthermore, our data-efficient paradigm effectively mitigates domain shifts, successfully unlocking the architectural limits of these base models in challenging, in-the-wild dynamic scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出PURE：一种无需标注的后训练精炼框架，通过从2D先验蒸馏结构知识，提升前馈3D重建模型在动态野外视频中的深度与相机估计。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型虽在大规模训练下进展显著，但面对动态野外视频中的非刚性运动、遮挡与光照变化时仍很脆弱。核心瓶颈在于依赖昂贵的深度与相机位姿标注，难以扩展到多样化真实动态数据，泛化受限。
AI.method: PURE后训练精炼框架，不使用真值监督；从最先进2D先验中蒸馏鲁棒结构知识到4D前馈架构。具体包括：相对深度约束、仿射不变几何蒸馏，以及基于特征对应的位姿精炼，以在困难动态条件下稳定几何预测。
AI.result: 在合成与真实动态基准上，PURE对多种最先进架构均带来一致性提升；数据高效范式有效缓解域偏移，在挑战性野外动态场景中释放基础模型的架构潜力。
AI.conclusion: 无标注的后训练精炼可替代昂贵标注，将2D先验知识蒸馏入4D前馈模型，从而提升动态场景下深度与相机估计的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: Towards Merging-conditional Backdoor Unalignment against Large Language Models
summary: Model merging has become widely adopted for enhancing the task-specific performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) without additional training. While the specialized model from third-party platforms may undergo safety audits (e.g., backdoor detection), we reveal a novel and critical threat: One-sided Merging-Conditional Backdoor (OMCB). OMCB remains dormant and undetectable within one standalone model but activates upon merging, triggering safety unalignment. We first theoretically analyze the existence and geometric location of OMCB, revealing that the parameter shift crossing safety decision boundaries is the main cause of backdoor activation. Building upon this insight, we propose SMOKE, a meta-learning-based attack framework. SMOKE implants OMCB via a bi-level optimization strategy: the inner loop synthesizes surrogate meta-vectors through random low-rank initialization and finite-step maximization, while the outer loop optimizes the target model by simulating the merging process. Furthermore, preliminary analysis shows that the injected OMCB has bounded generalization loss under unknown merging configurations. Extensive experiments across diverse model architectures and merging techniques validate the effectiveness of SMOKE and its resistance to existing backdoor detections, highlighting a significant yet previously overlooked vulnerability in the model merging paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示模型合并中的新型后门威胁OMCB：恶意模型单独存在时休眠且不可检测，一旦合并便激活并破坏安全对齐；作者提出基于元学习的攻击框架SMOKE进行验证。
AI.motivation: 模型合并被广泛用于免训练提升LLM任务性能，第三方专用模型通常经过安全审计（如后门检测）。但审计只针对单一模型，忽略了合并这一环节的潜在风险。
AI.method: 作者首先理论分析OMCB的存在性与几何位置，指出参数偏移跨越安全决策边界是后门激活主因；据此提出SMOKE元学习攻击框架，采用双层优化：内环通过随机低秩初始化与有限步最大化合成代理元向量，外环通过模拟合并过程优化目标模型。
AI.result: 初步分析表明注入的OMCB在未知合并配置下具有有界泛化损失；在多种模型架构与合并技术上，SMOKE均有效，并能抵抗现有后门检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了模型合并范式中一个此前被忽视的重要安全漏洞：单侧、合并条件触发的后门可在审计盲区中存活，对LLM供应链与合并实践构成新的关键威胁。

title: Lingdan-V2: Large language models for clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine
summary: Large language models have advanced medical reasoning, but clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) remains challenging because prescription decisions require integrating domain knowledge, syndrome differentiation, treatment principles, herbal prescription composition, and dosage determination. We develop a TCM language model family comprising models with 4 billion, 8 billion, and 14 billion parameters. The artificial intelligence contribution is a staged clinical alignment framework integrating large scale continued pretraining on TCM and clinical records, complementary reasoning supervision, and prescription-centered reinforcement learning (RL). We further formulate herbal prescription generation as a structured RL problem with prescription-level feedback, enabling direct optimization of clinical decision outputs beyond knowledge reproduction and generic instruction following. The engineering application is TCM clinical decision support, particularly herbal prescription recommendation. We evaluate the models on a public benchmark containing 25,620 expert-verified items across 13 TCM knowledge and clinical reasoning tasks and on a private retrospective dataset of 4,348 spleen and stomach disease prescription cases. The 14 billion parameter reinforcement aligned model achieves a prescription generation F1 of 37.0 on the public benchmark, compared with 32.3 for DeepSeek-R1 with 671 billion total parameters, and a herb-level F1 of 52.8 on the clinical dataset with improved dosage agreement. Reinforcement post-training consistently improves prescription recommendation across all scales, while physician-source analysis shows that expert heterogeneity affects reward stability. These findings demonstrate a scalable pathway from domain grounding and reasoning supervision to clinically oriented prescription decision support.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了40亿、80亿、140亿参数的中医语言模型家族，通过分阶段临床对齐框架（持续预训练、推理监督、处方中心强化学习）提升中医处方生成与临床决策支持能力，140亿模型在公开基准上F1达37.0，超过6710亿参数的DeepSeek-R1（32.3）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推动了医学推理的发展，但中医临床落地推理仍具挑战：处方决策需要整合领域知识、辨证、治法、方剂配伍与剂量确定，现有模型难以从知识复现转向临床决策输出。
AI.method: 开发40亿/80亿/140亿参数的中医语言模型家族；提出分阶段临床对齐框架：大规模中医与临床病历持续预训练、互补性推理监督、以处方为中心的强化学习；将中药处方生成形式化为带处方级反馈的结构化强化学习问题，直接优化临床决策输出。
AI.result: 在含13项中医知识与临床推理任务、25,620条专家验证数据的公开基准，以及4,348例脾胃病处方的私有回顾性数据集上评测。140亿强化对齐模型公开基准处方生成F1为37.0（DeepSeek-R1为32.3），临床数据集草药级F1为52.8且剂量一致性提升；强化后训练在各规模上均提升处方推荐；医生来源分析显示专家异质性影响奖励稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明了一条从领域基础构建、推理监督到面向临床的处方决策支持的可扩展路径。

title: How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste
summary: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A ~0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (~0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.

AI.tldr: 提出 TasteBench——一个专家对齐的成对好坏判定基准（视觉/品牌/图书/科技），并配套控制协议以区分"工艺判断"与"测试博弈"，量化并部分修正基准的三类效度威胁。
AI.motivation: 现有"品味"基准容易被测试博弈（而非真实工艺判断）刷分，缺乏对专家金标准与捷径特征的分离机制。作者因此需要一个可控协议，使基准上哪些分数来自真实判断、哪些来自构造性伪影可被测量。
AI.method: 在冻结评分标准下构建成对 good-vs-bad 任务，专家金标准（panel n>=3，百分比一致率>=0.60 为主门限），弱参与标签仅用于训练/分析；采用控制协议：仅专家金标准、弱标签防火墙、构造期 side 随机化（eval_assignment_seed7）、文件名清洗、困难样本过滤。Round-1 试点为 primary_human_expert、三名人类专家、n=250 对，并评测五张 VLM 卡片。
AI.result: 暴露三类效度威胁：(1) 位置偏置——偏好项位于 A 槽的概率 0.956，always_item_a 策略得分 0.956（随机为 0.5）；(2) 词法泄漏——文件名 token 线索得分 0.912；(3) 难度天花板——工艺域人类一致率近天花板（book/brand/tech 均为 1.0），A/B 随机化后五张 VLM 卡片在 craft 上仍均达 1.0，仅 visual 有区分度（约 0.84–0.91；事后困难子集 n=107 下 craft 仍为 1.0）。发布的 side 随机化工具将位置偏置从 0.916 降至 0.495/0.505。
AI.conclusion: 位置偏置与词法泄漏属可测量的构造性伪影且可修正；工艺域天花板是配对难度限制，需在 Round-2 解决。该工作给出了对基准"已测/未测"内容的校准视图。未评估参与度、时代/圈层条件与校准，也不主张任何通用品味 SOTA。

title: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in applications that act on users' long-term behavior histories, from personal assistants to recommendation and advertising systems. These applications demand the user dimension of LLM intelligence: inferring a person's preferences, intent, and likely future actions from weeks to years of behavior data. Yet current models are trained on static text or synthetic data, neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. Real-world behavior records, already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents, offer a natural supervisory signal. We propose user behavior as supervision and introduce Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. From the anonymized behavior records of 100,000 users, Vela generates 100,000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates; difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria retain approximately 75,000 tasks with selected training trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories improves performance over the base model by up to 11.5 points on user-related tasks and by an average of 4 points on general benchmarks. Training on more user behavior data further improves user-related performance, and reinforcement learning after fine-tuning outperforms reinforcement learning from the base model by up to 7.7 points. These gains suggest that real-world user behavior is a scalable source of supervision for both user-centered capabilities and the broader intelligence of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以真实用户行为数据作为监督信号，构建了 Vela 框架，将匿名化用户行为记录转化为可训练任务与轨迹，微调 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 后在用户相关任务上最高提升 11.5 分，通用基准平均提升 4 分。
AI.motivation: LLM 正被广泛用于需要理解用户长期行为的应用（个人助理、推荐与广告系统），这类应用要求模型能够从数周至数年的行为数据中推断用户偏好、意图和未来行为。然而现有模型仅基于静态文本或合成数据训练，无法刻画用户行为随时间的演变；而内容平台和个人助理中已存在大规模真实行为记录，提供了天然的监督信号。因此作者主张将用户行为作为监督来源。
AI.method: 提出 Vela 框架，将真实用户行为数据转换为可训练的任务与轨迹。基于 10 万名用户的匿名行为记录，依据 91 个真实任务模板生成 10 万个任务；通过基于难度的过滤与轨迹接受标准，最终保留约 7.5 万个任务及其筛选后的训练轨迹。使用这些轨迹对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 进行微调，并进一步开展强化学习实验。
AI.result: 在用户相关任务上相较基座模型最高提升 11.5 分，在通用基准上平均提升 4 分；使用更多用户行为数据训练可进一步提升用户相关表现；微调后再进行强化学习，相比从基座模型直接进行强化学习最高提升 7.7 分。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界用户行为是一种可扩展的监督来源，既能提升以用户为中心的能力，也能增强 LLM 的通用智能。

title: PixARG: Pixel-Asynchronous Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion for Fast and Realistic Image Generation
comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26) as a poster presentation
summary: While diffusion models achieve impressive image generation capabilities, they suffer from high computational costs, implausible artifacts, and limited adaptability to dynamic or private data due to static, centralized training. To address these, we propose PixARG, a novel retrieval-augmented generative framework that integrates dynamic real-world image retrieval into the diffusion pipeline to simultaneously enhance efficiency and visual realism. Specifically, PixARG constructs a pixel-level affinity map between the user's text prompt and the retrieved image to guide a heterogeneous noise initialization. By modulating noise intensity across spatial regions, this mechanism preserves semantically relevant structural priors while perturbing less relevant areas, thereby significantly accelerating convergence. To accommodate this spatially non-uniform noise and ensure synchronized generation, we introduce a pixel-wise asynchronous denoising scheduler and a spatiotemporal denoiser conditioned on the affinity map. Furthermore, we derive an affinity-adaptive training objective that elegantly balances deterministic restoration with stochastic regeneration across pixels. Experiments on LAION and COYO datasets across offline, online, and user-specific settings show PixARG enhances realism and semantic alignment while drastically reducing diffusion steps.

AI.tldr: PixARG：将动态真实图像检索融入扩散流程的检索增强生成框架，通过像素级亲和图引导异构噪声初始化与异步去噪调度，兼顾效率与真实感。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型存在三大问题：计算开销高、易产生不合理伪影、因静态集中式训练而对动态或私有数据适应性差。
AI.method: 构建文本提示与检索图像间的像素级亲和图，以引导异构噪声初始化：按空间区域调制噪声强度，保留语义相关的结构先验、扰动弱相关区域以加速收敛；引入像素级异步去噪调度器与以亲和图为条件的时空去噪器；推导亲和自适应训练目标，在像素层面平衡确定性恢复与随机再生成。
AI.result: 在LAION与COYO数据集上，于离线、在线及用户特定三种设置下，增强了真实感与语义对齐，同时大幅减少扩散步数。
AI.conclusion: 通过检索增强与空间非均匀噪声建模，PixARG在效率与生成质量上实现协同提升，并具备适应动态/私有数据的潜力。

title: LightVAE: Towards Compact and Efficient Video Autoencoders
comment: 24 pages, code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE
summary: Latent diffusion models enable high-quality video generation, but video VAE encoding and decoding remain computationally expensive. Existing methods use stage-specific lightweight operators, yet either constrain spatial and temporal computation jointly or remove temporal computation altogether, without distinguishing their compression sensitivities in pretrained Conv3D. To address these limitations, we present LightVAE, a compression framework that exploits redundancy in temporal modeling and network depth. LightVAE exactly reparameterizes eligible causal Conv3D layers into an aggregate spatial response and a difference-driven temporal correction. Based on their distinct compression sensitivities, temporal low-rank compression (TLR) keeps the aggregate spatial kernel dense and applies layer-specific low-rank approximation only to the temporal correction. An algebraically equivalent folded implementation converts the arithmetic savings into practical acceleration. LightVAE further uses width-preserving block pruning to reduce depth and probe-guided feature alignment, guided by feedback from a frozen teacher suffix, to recover quality after compression. The framework also extends to video encoders. Across three video VAE backbones and two GPU platforms, LightVAE consistently accelerates decoding. For the Wan VAE family, it achieves up to $2.24\times$ and $1.11\times$ the decoding throughput of state-of-the-art efficient VAE decoders on NVIDIA H100 and RTX~5090, respectively, with higher DAVIS PSNR and lower LPIPS. On MiniMax-H3, it achieves up to $2.97\times$ the original decoding throughput while retaining 99.51\% of the original model's overall VBench-2.0 score. Our code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE.

AI.tldr: LightVAE是一种针对视频VAE的压缩加速框架，通过区分预训练Conv3D中空间与时间计算的压缩敏感性，采用时间低秩压缩、宽度保持块剪枝与探针引导特征对齐，在多个骨干与GPU平台上实现解码显著加速且质量保持。
AI.motivation: 潜在扩散模型可实现高质量视频生成，但视频VAE的编解码计算代价高昂。现有方法采用分阶段轻量化算子，要么联合约束空间与时间计算，要么完全去除时间计算，未能在预训练Conv3D中区分二者不同的压缩敏感性，因而限制了压缩效率与质量保持。
AI.method: LightVAE利用时间建模与网络深度上的冗余：将符合条件的因果Conv3D层精确重参数化为聚合空间响应与差分驱动的时序修正；基于不同压缩敏感性提出时间低秩压缩（TLR），保持聚合空间核稠密，仅对时序修正做逐层低秩近似；通过代数等价折叠实现将算术节省转化为实际加速；并采用宽度保持块剪枝降低深度，结合由冻结教师后缀反馈引导的探针式特征对齐，恢复压缩后质量；框架亦可扩展至视频编码器。
AI.result: 在三种视频VAE骨干与两种GPU平台上，LightVAE持续加速解码。在Wan VAE系列上，解码吞吐量分别达到当前最优高效VAE解码器的最高2.24倍（NVIDIA H100）与1.11倍（RTX 5090），同时具有更高DAVIS PSNR与更低LPIPS；在MiniMax-H3上达到原始解码吞吐量的最高2.97倍，并保留原模型VBench-2.0总分的99.51%。
AI.conclusion: LightVAE通过区分离散压缩敏感性、时间低秩压缩、等价折叠加速与剪枝对齐相结合，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升视频VAE解码效率，并具备向编码器与多种骨干、硬件平台推广的通用性。代码已开源。

title: Align-VAE: Aligning Attention and Geometry in VecSet VAEs for 3D Reconstruction
summary: Set-based variational autoencoders (VecSet VAEs) represent 3D shapes as compact sets of latent tokens. Although each token originates from a query at a sampled surface location, whether these latents truly align with geometry remains unclear. We investigate this alignment and identify four issues: (i) attention-sink-like tokens that attract queries from across the shape; (ii) spatially periodic repetitions in decoder attention responses; (iii) mismatched normal information in encoder and decoder query features; and (iv) missing supervision of the intrinsic relation between signed distance fields and surface normals. To address these issues, we introduce Align-VAE with four corresponding modifications: (i) a shared bank of learnable decoder tokens provides a workspace for global computation; (ii) distance-biased cross-attention guides retrieval toward nearby predicted spatial anchors; (iii) normal-free encoder queries align the two stages' access to normal information while retaining normals in the encoder keys and values; and (iv) a screened Poisson-inspired regularizer supervises surface values and normal-direction derivatives. These changes align latent retrieval and field prediction with geometry without enlarging the per-shape code. On the ABO dataset, Align-VAE reduces Chamfer distance by 26.6% compared to the standard VecSet VAE.

AI.tldr: Align-VAE通过四项针对性修改解决了VecSet VAE中潜在token与几何不对齐的问题，在不增加编码长度的前提下在ABO数据集上将Chamfer距离降低26.6%。
AI.motivation: 基于集合的变分自编码器（VecSet VAE）将3D形状表示为紧凑的潜在token集合，每个token源自采样表面位置的查询，但这些潜在表征是否真正与几何对齐尚不明确，作者旨在研究并解决这一对齐问题。
AI.method: 作者首先识别出四个对齐问题：(i)类似attention sink的token跨形状吸引查询；(ii)解码器注意力响应存在空间周期性重复；(iii)编码器与解码器查询特征中的法向信息不匹配；(iv)缺少对SDF与表面法向内在关系的监督。相应地提出四项修改：(i)共享可学习解码器token库提供全局计算工作区；(ii)距离偏置的交叉注意力引导检索至附近预测空间锚点；(iii)无归一化的编码器查询对齐两阶段法向信息访问，同时编码器键值保留法向；(iv)受筛选泊松启发的正则项监督表面值与法向方向导数。
AI.result: 在ABO数据集上，与标准VecSet VAE相比，Align-VAE将Chamfer距离降低了26.6%。
AI.conclusion: 这些修改在不增大每形状编码尺寸的情况下，使潜在检索和场预测与几何对齐，显著提升了形状重建质量。

title: Japanese Handwriting Generation Based on Human Preference Feedback Using Direct Preference Optimization
summary: We propose a Japanese handwriting generation framework that integrates human preference feedback using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to align generative models with human cognitive and stylistic preferences. While font generation technologies leveraging Generative Adversarial Networks and diffusion models have advanced significantly, applying these approaches to handwriting generation presents unique challenges. Font generation is a deterministic process yielding consistent styles. Handwriting generation, on the other hand, is inherently non-deterministic. In handwriting, glyph shapes never match exactly even when the same writer writes the same character. We define this shape difference as handwriting variability. Although this variability is essential for conveying the natural quality of human writing, it complicates model training and substantially increases data collection costs to capture diverse distribution patterns. To address these limitations, we incorporate human perceptual feedback into the training loop of handwriting generation. While collecting extensive handwritten data is costly, evaluating pairwise preferences between two generated samples remains very easy for humans. Applying DPO, an efficient RL-free preference optimization method, to our generation model enables high-quality handwriting generation without relying on large-scale dataset collection. Experimental results across four distinct Japanese handwriting styles demonstrate that DPO-based training enhances overall structural accuracy. However, in highly complex styles with significant variability, such as brush pen writing, the model fails to capture style-specific features. These findings highlight a critical challenge in extending DPO to complex handwriting styles.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将人类偏好反馈通过DPO引入日语手写体生成框架，以缓解手写非确定性与数据采集成本高的问题。
AI.motivation: 字体生成已借助GAN与扩散模型取得进展，但手写生成具有非确定性，同一书写者写同一字符的字形形状也不完全一致，作者将这种形状差异定义为手写变异性。该变异性是自然书写质感的关键，却使模型训练复杂化并大幅提高覆盖多样分布的数据采集成本。
AI.method: 将人类感知反馈纳入手写生成训练环路。由于收集大规模手写数据代价高昂，而对两个生成样本进行成对偏好评价对人类而言十分容易，因此采用无强化学习的高效偏好优化方法DPO对生成模型进行训练，从而无需依赖大规模数据集采集即可实现高质量手写生成。
AI.result: 在四种不同日语手写风格上的实验表明，基于DPO的训练提升了整体结构准确度；但在变异性显著的高复杂风格（如毛笔书写）中，模型未能捕捉到风格特有特征。
AI.conclusion: DPO可有效提升手写生成的通用结构准确性并降低对大规模数据采集的依赖，但将其扩展到复杂手写风格仍存在关键挑战，即难以捕获高变异性风格的特有特征。

title: BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly couple video and action experts through dense, layer-wise Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) attention, exposing action prediction to irrelevant visual features while enforcing matched expert depths. This coupling hinders selective visual-feature use and introduces redundant computation. We introduce Bridge-of-Experts (BoE), instantiated as BridgeWAM, which aggregates visual, language, and proprioceptive priors through 32 Latent Bridge Queries (LBQs) into a shared, limited latent space. Joint video-action supervision lets action gradients guide the Video Expert toward representations better suited for action prediction, while the Action Expert learns to selectively retrieve task-relevant information through cross-attention. Decoupling expert depths and reusing LBQs during action denoising yield a 5.06B model with a 30-layer Video Expert and a two-layer Action Expert, achieving 98.25% success on LIBERO and 72.24% pooled success on LIBERO-Plus, demonstrating effective task execution and strong generalization with an ultralight action head. Ablations support joint representation adaptation and unified LBQ conditioning. Relative to Fast-WAM, BridgeWAM reduces single-sample inference FLOPs by 28.72% in simulation profiling and real-robot latency to 77.1 ms (a 2.47-fold speedup). Qualitative experimental results further indicate preferential attention to target objects and task destinations across perturbations.

AI.tldr: BridgeWAM 通过 Bridge-of-Experts 架构，用 32 个潜在桥接查询聚合多模态先验，解耦专家深度，实现高效且泛化性强的视频-动作联合建模。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Models 通过密集的逐层 Mixture-of-Transformers 注意力耦合视频与动作专家，导致动作预测暴露于无关视觉特征，且强制专家深度匹配，阻碍了视觉特征的selective利用并引入冗余计算。
AI.method: 提出 Bridge-of-Experts (BoE)，实例化为 BridgeWAM：通过 32 个 Latent Bridge Queries (LBQs) 将视觉、语言和本体感知先验聚合到共享的有限潜在空间；采用联合视频-动作监督使动作梯度引导 Video Expert 学习更适合动作预测的表示，同时 Action Expert 通过交叉注意力选择性检索任务相关信息；解耦专家深度并在动作去噪过程中复用 LBQs。
AI.result: 构建了 5.06B 模型（30 层 Video Expert + 2 层 Action Expert），在 LIBERO 上达到 98.25% 成功率，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 72.24% 汇聚成功率；相比 Fast-WAM，仿真分析中单样本推理 FLOPs 降低 28.72%，真实机器人延迟降至 77.1 ms（2.47 倍加速）；定性结果显示在扰动下能优先关注目标物体和任务终点。
AI.conclusion: BridgeWAM 以超轻量动作头实现了有效任务执行和强泛化能力；消融实验支持联合表示适配与统一 LBQ 条件化的有效性。

title: Amharic-English Cross-Language Question Answering Using Statistical Machine Translation, Named Entity Recognition, and Semantic Indexing
summary: The predominance of English-language Web content creates an information-access barrier for speakers of low-resource languages such as Amharic. This paper presents the design, imple-mentation, and evaluation of a bidirectional Amharic-English cross-language question answering (CLQA) system that allows a user to formulate a natural-language question in either Amharic or English and retrieve an answer from documents written in the other language. The system integrates a statistical machine translation (SMT) component for query translation, a maximum-entropy named entity recognition (NER) component for Amharic text processing, semantic-based indexing, question analysis, passage retrieval, and answer extraction. A domain-diverse Amharic-English parallel corpus was used to train the SMT component, while monolingual cor-pora supported language modeling. Documents were normalized, tokenized, stemmed, indexed, and semantically enriched before retrieval. The original evaluation used precision and recall as the principal effectiveness measures. For Amharic-to-English retrieval, the system achieved 72% precision and 79% recall; for English-to-Amharic retrieval, it achieved 65% precision and 70% recall. These findings show that a modular translation-and-retrieval architecture can provide useful cross-language access even under low-resource conditions. This revised article preserves the original experimental claims while situating them in the context of subsequent multilingual transformer and Amharic QA research.

AI.tldr: 该论文设计并评估了一个双向阿姆哈拉语-英语跨语言问答（CLQA）系统，通过SMT查询翻译、最大熵NER、语义索引、问题分析与答案抽取等模块，在低资源条件下实现跨语言检索，阿→英检索精确率72%、召回率79%，英→阿精确率65%、召回率70%。
AI.motivation: 英语网络内容占主导地位，为阿姆哈拉语等低资源语言使用者造成信息获取壁垒，因此需要构建跨语言问答系统以打破语言障碍。
AI.method: 系统采用模块化架构，集成统计机器翻译（SMT）进行查询翻译、最大熵命名实体识别（NER）处理阿姆哈拉语文本，并结合语义索引、问题分析、段落检索与答案抽取。使用领域多样化的阿姆哈拉语-英语平行语料训练SMT，单语语料支持语言建模；文档经规范化、分词、词干化、索引与语义增强后用于检索。
AI.result: 原始评估以精确率和召回率为主要指标：阿姆哈拉语→英语检索精确率72%、召回率79%；英语→阿姆哈拉语检索精确率65%、召回率70%。
AI.conclusion: 模块化的“翻译+检索”架构在低资源条件下仍能提供有效的跨语言信息获取能力；修订版文章保留原始实验结论，并将其置于后续多语言Transformer与阿姆哈拉语问答研究的背景下。

title: The Constitution Speaks Nheengatu: An Open MT System and Reproducible Corpus Pipeline for the Amazonian Língua Geral
summary: Nheengatu (yrl), the Amazonian Língua Geral, has 6--10 thousand speakers and is co-official in São Gabriel da Cachoeira (Brazil), yet remains poorly served by evaluated Portuguese--Nheengatu MT resources. We present the largest parallel corpus assembled for the language (14.5k Portuguese--Nheengatu pairs), anchored by the 2023 official translation of the Brazilian Federal Constitution; the first MT evaluation set built from transcribed spontaneous speech; and, to our knowledge, the first open-weight MT models dedicated to bidirectional Portuguese--Nheengatu translation. Three findings organize the paper. First, translation into Nheengatu on held-out constitutional articles plateaus on development data regardless of training length or model size, and much of the remaining error sits in conventional legal terms that the written sources do not attest consistently; a terminology success rate over a frozen lexicon shows that glossary mechanisms at training time and lexical constraints at decoding each raise term realization, the latter at a cost in repetitive output that chrF++ barely registers. Second, a corpus expansion that adds transcribed conversation raises speech chrF++ by 24--27 points while leaving written domains unchanged, a register gap that written-only benchmarks cannot see. Third, a larger NLLB model helps translation into Portuguese but not into Nheengatu on legal or speech text. For Portuguese-to-Nheengatu translation, our final systems reach 31.7--32.8 chrF++ on article-disjoint constitutional text, 64.1--64.5 on the near-domain set (62.1 after removing items with target-side content overlap), and 45.2--47.5 on speech.

AI.tldr: 本文为Nheengatu（yrl）构建了迄今最大规模的葡萄牙语—Nheengatu平行语料（14.5k对）、首个基于转录口语的MT评测集，以及首个开放的专用双向翻译模型；研究揭示了术语实现、语域差异与模型规模的不对称效应。
AI.motivation: Nheengatu是亚马逊地区的通用语，仅有6千至1万名使用者，并在巴西圣加布里埃尔-达卡舒埃拉享有共同官方地位；然而该语言在葡—Nheengatu机器翻译方面长期缺乏经过评测的资源，相关研究几乎空白。
AI.method: 以2023年《巴西联邦宪法》官方译本为锚点，构建14.5k对平行语料；从转录的自发口语构建首个MT评测集；训练首批开放的专用双向葡—Nheengatu模型。实验包括：训练期术语表机制与解码期词汇约束、加入转录对话的语料扩充、以及不同规模NLLB模型的对比。
AI.result: （1）译入Nheengatu在法律条文上随训练长度与模型规模均出现性能平台期，剩余错误多集中于书写来源中不一致见证的传统法律术语；术语表机制与解码约束均提升术语实现率，但后者带来chrF++难以捕捉的重复输出代价。（2）加入转录对话使口语chrF++提升24–27分，而书面域不变，显示书面基准无法察觉的语域鸿沟。（3）更大的NLLB模型有助于译入葡萄牙语，但对译入Nheengatu（法律与口语文本）无益。葡→Nheengatu最终系统在条文不重叠宪法文本上达31.7–32.8 chrF++，近域集为64.1–64.5（去除目标端重叠项后为62.1），口语为45.2–47.5。
AI.conclusion: 该语言的低资源MT瓶颈并非单纯由数据量或模型规模决定，而更多受术语一致性与语域覆盖影响；术语机制与口语语料扩充是更有效的改进方向，模型规模扩展对译入方向存在明显不对称性。

title: CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher model augmented with the corresponding forgetting- and retention-oriented privileged contexts. This design jointly determines what to forget and what to preserve. On MLLMU-Bench, CUSE reduces forget-set ROUGE-L by 33.6% while achieving 1.2% higher retain-set ROUGE-L than the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出CUSE框架，通过反事实引导的在线自蒸馏实现多模态大模型细粒度遗忘，在去除目标信息的同时保留非目标内容。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型可能复现训练数据中的敏感、受版权保护或不安全信息。有效遗忘需在去除目标信息的同时保留非目标内容——即便它们出现在同一回复中。现有方法对完整回复施加统一的遗忘目标，并依赖固定的离线监督，导致token级控制粗糙且与模型当前行为不匹配。
AI.method: CUSE包含两步：1）构造反事实输入（移除目标相关证据），利用由此引起的token概率变化识别哪些token需要更强的遗忘；2）在从当前策略采样的回复上进行token级遗忘与保留目标的蒸馏，以原始模型的冻结副本作为教师模型，并辅以相应的遗忘导向与保留导向的特权上下文。
AI.result: 在MLLMU-Bench上，CUSE将遗忘集ROUGE-L降低33.6%，同时保留集ROUGE-L比最强基线高1.2%。
AI.conclusion: CUSE通过反事实引导与在线自蒸馏的联合设计，实现了token级的细粒度遗忘与保留控制，性能优于现有基线。

title: Who Receives Respect? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Honorific Allocation Bias in Bengali
summary: Bengali has no grammatical gender, but honorificity is obligatory: every third-person reference must choose ordinary or respectful register. English has no such signal, so the system must choose a level of deference that the source never specified. We use this property to measure how large language models (LLMs) allocate respect in English--Bengali translation. Our evaluation set contains 2{,}016 sentences across 72 occupations. Each appears in seven sentence frames under four pronoun conditions. Masculine and feminine versions differ by one word, forming counterfactual pairs. We report a single Honorific Bias Score (HBS) for each model on a 0--100 scale, covering both the gender and occupation axes. A lower score means that respect is allocated more evenly. For the occupation analysis, we compute each occupation's honorific rate across the seven no-pronoun sentence frames. The standard deviation of these 72 occupation-level rates ranges from 17.2 to 35.5 percentage points across models, showing substantial variation in how honorifics are allocated across occupations. Occupation is associated with 3.2\% to 51.5\% of the variance in register choice, compared with at most 1.2\% for gender. Gender effects are much smaller overall: only two of the nine models show significant directional gender gaps, and they favor opposite genders. HBS ranges from 19.9 to 70.1 across the nine models, showing substantial variation in how evenly the models allocate respect.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用孟加拉语中强制性的敬语等级（ordinary/respectful）作为探针，构建包含性别与职业双轴的英语—孟加拉语翻译评测集，提出敬语偏见分数HBS，量化九个LLM在无源语言线索时如何分配尊重。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语没有语法性别，但第三人称指称必须强制选择普通或尊敬语域，而英语不携带该信号。这一“目标语必需、源语缺失”的不对称性，为测量LLM在翻译中如何隐含分配尊重提供了天然实验场，尤其可用于考察模型是否沿性别与职业轴产生系统性偏见。
AI.method: 构建2,016个句子、覆盖72种职业的评测集；每句出现在7种句式框架下，并处于4种代词条件下。阳性与阴性版本仅一词之差，构成反事实对。对无代词框架计算各职业的敬语使用率，并据此定义单一指标HBS（0–100），同时覆盖性别与职业两个轴，对九个模型进行评测与方差分解。
AI.result: 72个职业层面的敬语率标准差在模型间为17.2至35.5个百分点，显示跨职业分配差异显著。职业可解释语域选择方差的3.2%至51.5%，而性别至多解释1.2%。九个模型中仅两个呈现显著的方向性性别差异，且方向相反。HBS在九个模型间跨度达19.9至70.1，表明各模型分配尊重的均匀程度差异很大。
AI.conclusion: LLM在英语—孟加拉语翻译中系统性地依据职业而非性别分配敬语等级，职业是主要偏见轴，性别影响相对微弱且方向不一致。HBS可作为跨模型比较敬语分配均匀性的统一度量，揭示目标语强制范畴下隐含的社会偏见。

title: Training-Free BioNEL-RAG: Advancing Biomedical Entity Linking through Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Model
summary: Biomedical Named Entity Linking (BioNEL) is the task of mapping mentions extracted from biomedical texts to canonical entities or concepts in the standardized knowledge base. Although existing methods have achieved remarkable performance in mapping accuracy, most rely on training with domain-specific datasets, which fundamentally limits their cross-domain adaptability. To address this limitation, we propose BioNEL-RAG, a novel training-free framework that combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with large language models (LLMs). Within this framework, the RAG module focuses on retrieving candidate entities, while the large language model module plays the role of selecting the most appropriate candidate for entity normalization, which is based on the analysis of the mention's context, with the aid of its remarkable text comprehension capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that BioNEL-RAG achieves performance comparable to existing methods without requiring training on subdomain datasets, whereas these methods necessitate fine-tuning on specific subdomains such as genes, diseases, or chemical compounds.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 BioNEL-RAG，结合 RAG 与 LLM 完成生物医学命名实体链接，在无需子领域数据微调的情况下达到与现有方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 BioNEL 方法虽在映射准确率上表现优异，但大多依赖领域特定的数据集进行训练，从根本上限制了跨领域适应能力。
AI.method: BioNEL-RAG 为免训练框架：RAG 模块负责检索候选实体；大语言模型模块借助其文本理解能力，基于提及的上下文分析，从候选中选出最合适的实体以完成规范化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，BioNEL-RAG 在不使用子领域数据集训练的前提下，取得了与现有方法相当的性能；而现有方法需要在基因、疾病、化合物等特定子领域上进行微调。
AI.conclusion: 通过 RAG 与 LLM 的结合，可在免训练条件下实现跨子领域适用的生物医学实体链接，缓解了对领域特定微调数据的依赖。

title: YOUDrive: Driving Style as a Composable Direction for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving policies can achieve strong task performance while offering limited control over their driving style. Driving style describes how a vehicle accelerates, brakes, and maintains distance. Policies trained without explicit preference conditioning lack a direct mechanism for adjusting these behaviors at inference. We propose YOUDrive, a vision--language--action planner for continuous and composable driving-style control. Each teacher's behavior is distilled into a task vector, a learned parameter update that induces a style direction in the planner's representation. These directions can be scaled and combined at inference without retraining the backbone. Conditioned on these directions, a flow-matching decoder models a multimodal trajectory distribution and generates kinematically feasible motion alternatives. We introduce the Style Alignment Score (SAS) to describe human-referenced kinematic behavior after safety and task gating. On NAVSIM navtest, a single coefficient monotonically controls assertiveness across six teacher-derived personas, while PDMS remains above 0.90 across the tested individual and blended configurations, reaching 0.954. Further analyses reveal systematic policy-specific kinematics after controlling for scene context, whereas the evaluated discrete style labels provide limited additional explanatory power. Code, checkpoints, and the metric will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 YOUDrive，一种视觉-语言-动作规划器，通过将教师行为蒸馏为任务向量，实现连续且可组合的驾驶风格控制；在 NAVSIM navtest 上，单一系数可单调调节六种人格的激进程度，PDMS 保持 0.90 以上并最高达 0.954。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略虽任务表现优异，但对驾驶风格（加速、制动、跟车距离等）缺乏显式控制。无偏好条件的策略在推理时没有直接机制调节这些行为，因此需要一种可连续、可组合地控制驾驶风格的方法。
AI.method: 将各教师的行为蒸馏为任务向量（任务向量即一种学习到的参数更新），在规划器表示中诱导风格方向；这些方向可在推理时进行缩放与组合，无需重训练骨干网络。以这些方向为条件，采用流匹配（flow-matching）解码器建模多模态轨迹分布，生成运动学可行的运动备选。同时提出风格对齐分数（SAS）以描述经安全与任务门控后、参照人类运动学的行为。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM navtest 上，单一系数可单调控制来自六种教师人格的激进程度；在测试的单一与混合配置中 PDMS 均高于 0.90，最高达 0.954。进一步分析显示，在控制场景上下文后存在系统性的策略特定运动学，而所评估的离散风格标签提供的额外解释力有限。
AI.conclusion: YOUDrive 实现了连续、可组合的驾驶风格控制，在保持高任务与安全性能的同时提供可解释的风格调节，且无需重训练主干模型。代码、检查点与指标将开源。

title: [Re] Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning
summary: This paper presents a reproducibility study of ``Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning'', published at ICLR 2025, which proposes an unsupervised adversarial fine-tuning (AFT) method with norm regularisation to enhance the visual interpretability of CLIP's image encoder. We attempt to reproduce the key claims regarding improved saliency map quality, increased concept alignment, transferability to out-of-distribution datasets, and the trade-off with zero-shot accuracy. Beyond reproduction, we propose a saliency-guided regularisation extension that introduces an Energy Pointing Game loss, directly supervising the spatial alignment of Simple Gradient saliency maps with target objects. We evaluate our extension across a range of saliency-loss weights and show that explicit saliency supervision \rev{substantially} improves localisation metrics at a modest cost: the reduction in zero-shot accuracy and adversarial robustness is small at the lowest saliency-loss weight ($w_s=0.2$) and moderate at the strongest setting ($w_s=0.6$). We restructure the codebase for configurable, systematic experimentation.

AI.tldr: 本文对ICLR 2025论文《Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning》进行复现，并在此基础上提出基于显著性引导的正则化扩展（Energy Pointing Game损失），以显式监督Simple Gradient显著性图与目标物体的空间对齐。
AI.motivation: 原论文提出无监督对抗微调（AFT）配合范数正则化来提升CLIP图像编码器的视觉可解释性。作者希望验证其关键主张（显著性图质量、概念对齐、分布外迁移性、与零样本精度的权衡），并进一步探索显式显著性监督能否带来额外提升。
AI.method: 复现AFT方法的四项关键主张；扩展部分引入Energy Pointing Game损失，直接监督Simple Gradient显著性图与目标物体的空间对齐，并在不同显著性损失权重下评估；同时重构代码库以支持可配置的系统化实验。
AI.result: 显式显著性监督大幅提升定位（localisation）指标，代价可控：在最低显著性损失权重（w_s=0.2）下零样本精度与对抗鲁棒性下降较小，在最强设置（w_s=0.6）下下降中等。
AI.conclusion: 无监督AFT的可解释性提升可被复现，且通过显著性引导的显式监督（Energy Pointing Game损失）可在有限精度与鲁棒性代价下进一步显著改善定位性能，权重选择提供了精度-可解释性的可控折衷。

title: Towards Privacy-Preserving Thermal Human Perception from Dataset to Deployment
summary: Indoor human perception is the foundation for smart homes and healthcare. However, RGB cameras raise privacy concerns in private indoor environments, while low-resolution thermal cameras provide limited spatial and semantic information. Large-scale indoor thermal datasets and real-world deployments remain limited. Here, we introduce Indoor RGB-T, a large-scale paired RGB--thermal dataset for indoor human perception. The dataset covers 20 indoor rooms and contains 90,576 80x62 thermal frames, 87,016 temporally matched RGB--thermal pairs, and 115,557 annotated human bounding boxes. We establish benchmarks for robust thermal occupant-state detection with 0.75 mAP and occupancy estimation with an accuracy of 0.847 in unseen rooms. We further evaluate RGB-to-thermal and thermal-to-RGB translation, achieving a temperature MAE of 0.654 C and an R2 of 0.923. Finally, we deploy the thermal perception model on a commercial sleep-monitoring system in the real world. Field testing with 100 participants and deployment of approximately 1,000 devices further demonstrate its practical feasibility. We identify practical challenges that motivate future research directions, including environmental thermal interference, sensing range and multi-person occlusion. The code, trained models and partial dataset are available at https://github.com/kailaisun/RGBT and https://huggingface.co/skl24/RGBT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模室内配对RGB-热成像数据集Indoor RGB-T，并建立热成像入住者状态检测、占用估计及跨模态翻译基准，最后在商用睡眠监测系统中完成真实部署验证。
AI.motivation: 室内人类感知是智能家居与医疗健康的基础。但RGB相机在私密室内场景存在隐私隐患，低分辨率热成像相机空间与语义信息有限，且大规模室内热成像数据集与真实部署研究仍十分匮乏。
AI.method: 构建Indoor RGB-T数据集，覆盖20个室内房间，包含90,576帧80x62热成像帧、87,016对时间对齐的RGB-热成像配对数据以及115,557个人体标注框；据此建立鲁棒热成像入住者状态检测与占用估计基准，并评估RGB到热成像、热成像到RGB的双向翻译；最后将热成像感知模型部署于商用睡眠监测系统开展实测。
AI.result: 在未见房间中，热成像入住者状态检测达到0.75 mAP，占用估计准确率为0.847；跨模态翻译温度MAE为0.654°C，R²为0.923；在100名参与者实地测试与约1,000台设备部署中验证了实际可行性，并指出环境热干扰、感知范围与多人遮挡等挑战。
AI.conclusion: Indoor RGB-T为室内热成像人体感知提供了大规模数据与基准支撑，验证了从算法到真实产品部署的可行路径，并为后续研究指明了环境热干扰、感知范围及多人遮挡等关键方向；代码、模型与部分数据已开源。

title: Getting Space Right: Agentic Rewards for Image Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for spatial text-to-image generation, but existing work largely focuses on policy optimization, assuming accurate rewards and effective online rollouts. We observe in-domain gains with out-of-domain degradation, exposing two limitations: unreliable spatial rewards in open-world settings and rollouts lacking basic-to-complex progression. We propose a curriculum-guided RL framework. First, we introduce SpatialCritic, an agentic reward model equipped with a spatial perception harness that combines reusable verification guidance with specialized vision tools. We then construct spatial preference datasets through targeted counterfactual perturbations and perform agent-harness alignment to improve tool selection and evidence integration efficiently. Second, curriculum learning organizes shared foundational capabilities and their compositional dependencies in a capability graph for mastery-guided rollouts, periodic review, and targeted remediation. On SpaRW-Eval, SpatialCritic achieves 95.1% verification accuracy, outperforming 320B GLM-5.3-Flash with a 40x smaller 8B backbone and raising average baseline scores from 78.4 to 83.9 on SD3.5-Medium and 83.2 to 86.5 on BAGEL. Project page: https://xiaofeng-tan.github.io/projects/spatialcritic/

AI.tldr: 该论文针对空间文本到图像生成中强化学习奖励不可靠、在线采样缺乏由简到繁进阶的问题，提出课程引导的强化学习框架：一方面构建具备空间感知工具与验证指导的智能体奖励模型SpatialCritic，另一方面基于能力图组织课程化采样与复习，取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有空间文生图强化学习研究多聚焦策略优化，默认奖励准确、在线采样有效；但实践中出现域内提升、域外退化，暴露出两个局限：开放世界下空间奖励不可靠，以及采样缺乏从基础到复杂的进阶。
AI.method: 提出课程引导的强化学习框架。第一，构建SpatialCritic智能体奖励模型，配备空间感知"工具带"，结合可复用验证指导与专用视觉工具；通过定向反事实扰动构建空间偏好数据集，并做智能体-工具带对齐以提升工具选择与证据整合效率。第二，引入课程学习，用能力图组织共享基础能力及其组合依赖关系，实现掌握度引导的采样、周期复习与定向补强。
AI.result: 在SpaRW-Eval上，SpatialCritic达到95.1%验证准确率，以8B骨干超越320B的GLM-5.3-Flash（小40倍）；并将SD3.5-Medium平均基线分从78.4提升至83.9，BAGEL从83.2提升至86.5。
AI.conclusion: 将可靠奖励建模与课程化采样结合，可有效缓解开放世界空间奖励不可靠与采样进阶缺失的问题，在显著更小模型规模下取得更强空间验证与生成性能。

title: CAST: Real-Time Motion Capture for Any Skeleton Topology
summary: This paper studies the problem of recovering motion from monocular video, even when the target skeleton topology differs from the subject observed in the video. Although previous methods have made efforts to resolve this problem, they remain vulnerable to joint-rotation errors that are coupled across the skeleton and can propagate along its kinematic hierarchy. To mitigate these errors, we present CAST, a topology-aware motion capture framework that combines learned local rotations with geometric correction guided by predicted global bone directions. Our observability analysis characterizes which rotational components can be constrained by outgoing bone directions. Guided by this analysis, GRACE uses reliability-gated alignment to correct composed orientations in parent-to-child order, leaving unconstrained components to the learned rotation predictor. The motion predictor and correction module are trained jointly with motion-derived supervision, using a frozen image encoder.
