This study was conducted by analyzing the data that was related to years from 2000 to 2025 using data visualization techniques. Python related libraries of Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Geopandas were used due to their efficiency and usability in analyzing WRI data. As per the analysis, it was identified that countries of Philippines, Mexico, Indonesia, and India were recorded with high WRI index values that showed these nations should be prepared for natural disasters and situations. Hence, this study has provided insights using data visualization techniques in understanding natural disasters and threats so that necessary measures can be taken

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Python可视化工具（Matplotlib、Seaborn、Geopandas）分析2000—2025年世界风险指数（WRI）数据，识别出菲律宾、墨西哥、印度尼西亚和印度等国WRI值较高，需加强自然灾害防范准备。
AI.motivation: 全球面临资源枯竭、粮食安全、贫困与不平等、城市化、移民及环境问题等多重威胁。世界风险指数（WRI）由人道主义数据交换平台发布，用于衡量各国对自然灾害及相关风险的易感性，可提前识别需重点防范的地区。然而，如何借助可视化手段直观解读长期WRI数据并形成防灾洞察，仍有待探索。
AI.method: 采用数据可视化方法，对2000至2025年的WRI相关数据进行分析。使用Python的Matplotlib、Seaborn和Geopandas库，因其在WRI数据分析中具有高效性和易用性。WRI由易感性、自然灾害脆弱性和应对机制等因素构成。
AI.result: 分析表明，菲律宾、墨西哥、印度尼西亚和印度的WRI指数值较高，说明这些国家应做好自然灾害及相关情形的防范准备。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过数据可视化技术为理解自然灾害与威胁提供了洞察，有助于相关方提前采取必要措施，提升风险防范与应对能力。

title: BrainAid: Efficient Brain Tumor Detection Using Lightweight CNNs and Explainable AI for Resource-Constrained Environments
summary: A brain tumor is an unusual growth of cells in the brain that can be cancerous or not, affecting normal brain function and causing serious risk to health. Existing solutions for brain tumor classification, such as expert manual evaluations of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans, are generally inconsistent as different professionals have different criteria and can be resource-intensive, leading to delayed diagnoses. Additionally, while deep learning models have demonstrated potential, they typically require significant computational resources, motivating the need for more efficient and accessible diagnostic tools that can be deployed in real-time healthcare settings. To address these limitations, this study presents BrainAid, which makes efficient use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) for effective classification of four-class classification of glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no-tumor MRI scans, outperforming all the standard models such as VGG16, Inception-V3, ResNet-50 and so, while integrating Explainable AI (XAI) to improve interpretability. The BrainAid is trained to classify tumors with a high precision of 98%, achieving an F1 score of 98% and an accuracy of 98% using publicly available dataset. The model is deployed on a Raspberry Pi, demonstrating efficiency in low-resource environments. This system shows the feasibility of real-time, edge-based tumor classification, providing quick diagnostic support for medical professionals and enhancing patient care in resource-limited healthcare facilities and underserved areas.

AI.tldr: 提出BrainAid，融合CNN与ViT实现四类脑肿瘤MRI分类，精度98%，并用XAI增强可解释性，最终部署于Raspberry Pi实现低资源实时诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有脑肿瘤分类依赖专家人工判读MRI，存在主观不一致、资源消耗大、诊断延迟等问题；深度学习模型虽有效但计算需求高，难以在实时医疗场景部署，因此需要高效且可及的分类工具。
AI.method: 融合卷积神经网络（CNN）与视觉Transformer（ViT），对胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、垂体瘤及无肿瘤四类MRI进行多分类；集成可解释AI（XAI）提升可解释性；并在Raspberry Pi上进行部署验证。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上达到98%的精确率、98%的F1分数与98%的准确率，优于VGG16、Inception-V3、ResNet-50等标准模型，并在Raspberry Pi上验证了低资源环境下的运行效率。
AI.conclusion: BrainAid验证了实时、边缘端脑肿瘤分类的可行性，可为医疗专业人员提供快速诊断支持，提升资源有限设施及欠发达地区的患者护理水平。

title: Region Aware Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks for Image Segmentation
summary: Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) modules improve convolutional networks by modeling channel-wise dependencies, but global average pooling collapses spatial structure into a single per-channel descriptor, limiting their effectiveness for dense prediction tasks such as image segmentation. We generalize SE by replacing global pooling with spatially guided pooling, enabling region-aware channel recalibration through four modules with complementary cost profiles. BASE formalizes Tiled Squeeze-and-Excite using a regular grid; SPASE pools over SLIC superpixels for image-adaptive regions; MAPSE obtains regions from semantic maps produced by a frozen, general-purpose network; and PLEASE learns soft region assignments end-to-end through a lightweight assignment network. Each channel receives one gate per region, so attention at each pixel reflects its region membership, bridging channel and spatial attention. PLEASE also produces its soft assignments as a byproduct of the forward pass, providing structured spatial interpretability without post-hoc analysis. The modules offer complementary computational tradeoffs: some add essentially no parameters, while others add no measurable latency. Across binary segmentation on CUB, DUTS, and ECSSD, semantic segmentation on PASCAL VOC 2012 and ADE20K, and classification on mini-ImageNet, our modules outperform SE and related spatial-channel attention variants on most benchmarks, achieving the majority of best results.

AI.tldr: 该论文将SE模块的全局池化推广为空间引导池化，提出BASE、SPASE、MAPSE、PLEASE四种区域感知通道重标定模块，在分割与分类任务上大多超越SE及相关注意力变体。
AI.motivation: SE模块通过建模通道依赖提升卷积网络性能，但其全局平均池化将空间结构压缩为单一的逐通道描述符，削弱了其在图像分割等密集预测任务中的有效性。
AI.method: 用空间引导池化替代全局池化，实现区域感知的通道重标定，包含四个互补模块：BASE基于规则网格实现分块SE；SPASE在SLIC超像素上池化以获得图像自适应区域；MAPSE从冻结的通用网络生成的语义图获取区域；PLEASE通过轻量级分配网络端到端学习软区域分配。每个通道在每个区域获得一个门控，使像素级注意力反映其区域归属，从而连接通道注意力与空间注意力；PLEASE还在前向过程中顺带输出软分配，提供结构化空间可解释性。
AI.result: 各模块具有互补的计算开销：部分几乎不增加参数，部分不引入可测量的延迟。在CUB、DUTS、ECSSD的二值分割，PASCAL VOC 2012与ADE20K的语义分割，以及mini-ImageNet分类任务上，多数基准中优于SE及相关空间-通道注意力变体，取得大部分最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 以空间引导池化泛化SE可有效引入区域感知的通道重标定，在多种密集预测与分类任务上普遍优于SE及其变体，并通过PLEASE附带提供结构化空间可解释性。

title: Have You Been Convinced? A Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning Approach to Detecting Persuasiveness in ChangeMyView Discussions
comment: Accepted and to be published in the Proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Knowledge Engineering and Knowledge Management (EKAW 2026)
summary: Argument structures represent how individual arguments interact within a discourse. However, leveraging these structures to infer meaningful knowledge remains challenging, as it requires a formal representation of how argumentative influence propagates across the structure. We propose Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning System (NARS) for performing persuasiveness detection directly from online discussions. The neural component employs retrieval-augmented iterative LLM reasoning to extract bipolar argument structures, while the symbolic component applies gradual argumentation semantics to propagate argumentative influence over the structure. Using the Webis-CMV-20 corpus, we construct CMV2BAS, a dataset of long, multi-threaded ChangeMyView discussions annotated with LLM-derived bipolar argument structures and labeled with delta events (view change vs.\ no change). We investigate whether gradual argumentation semantics can effectively detect persuasiveness, whether augmenting them with argument quality and graph-based centrality improves performance, and whether symbolic reasoning remains necessary in the presence of modern LLMs. NARS achieves F1=0.57 and AUC=0.56 under its best configuration, outperforming zero-shot Qwen3.6:27B and GPT-oss:20B. We identify support-dominant discussions and long argumentative chains as key failure modes limiting attack influence propagation. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of operationalizing formal gradual argumentation semantics over noisy real-world discourse for scalable macro-level persuasion analysis, while highlighting key challenges and directions for future research in neuro-symbolic argumentation reasoning. We release both CMV2BAS dataset and the NARS framework for public use.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出神经符号论证推理系统NARS，结合检索增强的LLM推理与渐进论证语义，从在线讨论中直接进行说服力检测，并发布CMV2BAS数据集。
AI.motivation: 论证结构刻画了话语中个体论点间的交互，但利用这些结构推断有意义的知识仍具挑战，因为它需要对论证影响力如何在结构中传播进行形式化表示。
AI.method: NARS包含两个组件：神经组件采用检索增强的迭代LLM推理提取双极论证结构；符号组件应用渐进论证语义在结构上传播论证影响力。基于Webis-CMV-20语料构建CMV2BAS数据集（含长文本、多线程ChangeMyView讨论，标注LLM导出的双极论证结构和delta事件标签）。研究三个问题：渐进论证语义能否有效检测说服力、加入论证质量与图中心性是否提升性能、现代LLM下符号推理是否仍必要。
AI.result: NARS在最佳配置下达到F1=0.57、AUC=0.56，优于零样本Qwen3.6:27B和GPT-oss:20B。识别出支持主导型讨论和长论证链是限制攻击影响力传播的关键失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明在嘈杂真实话语上操作化形式渐进论证语义、实现可扩展的宏观层面说服分析的可行性，同时指出神经符号论证推理的关键挑战与未来方向，并公开发布CMV2BAS数据集与NARS框架。

title: VLCQ: Post-training quantization for deep neural networks using variable length coding
comment: Published in Future Generation Computer Systems, Volume 166 (2025), Article 107654
summary: Quantization plays a crucial role in efficiently deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained devices. Post-training quantization does not require access to the original dataset or retraining the full model. Current methods that achieve high performance close to baseline results typically require INT8 fixed-point integers. However, achieving higher model compression with lower bit-widths often leads to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose VLCQ, a post-training quantization method that relaxes the fixed-point encoding constraint, enabling more flexible exploration of quantization techniques through variable-length encoding. This approach achieves competitive or improved performance while reducing bit-widths, without requiring access to training data or model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on image classification, segmentation, and object detection demonstrate that VLCQ improves model compression and accuracy compared with state-of-the-art post-training quantization approaches. For per-channel quantization, VLCQ surpasses FP32 accuracy and Piece-Wise Linear Quantization (PWLQ) on most evaluated models, achieving up to 6x compression compared with FP32 and up to 1.7x compared with PWLQ. When prioritizing compression with limited accuracy loss, VLCQ achieves up to 12.25x compression compared with FP32 with less than 4% performance degradation. For per-tensor quantization, VLCQ is competitive with Data-Free Quantization (DFQ), while providing greater flexibility to achieve lower bit rates across different tasks and models.

AI.tldr: 提出VLCQ，一种突破定点编码约束、采用变长编码的训练后量化方法，在无需原始数据和微调的前提下，以更低比特宽度实现更高压缩率与竞争力精度。
AI.motivation: 现有高性能训练后量化方法多依赖INT8定点整数，而追求更低比特以提升压缩率时往往带来显著精度退化，亟需在低比特下兼顾压缩与精度的量化方案。
AI.method: VLCQ放松定点编码约束，通过变长编码（variable-length encoding）更灵活地探索量化空间，且无需访问训练数据或进行模型微调，支持per-channel与per-tensor两种量化设置。
AI.result: 在图像分类、分割和目标检测任务上，VLCQ在压缩率与精度上优于当前最先进训练后量化方法。per-channel量化下，在多数模型上超越FP32精度与PWLQ，相比FP32最高6倍压缩、相比PWLQ最高1.7倍；以压缩优先时相比FP32最高12.25倍压缩且性能下降小于4%。per-tensor量化下与DFQ相当，并具备更大灵活性以实现更低比特率。
AI.conclusion: VLCQ通过变长编码突破定点限制，在不依赖训练数据与微调的情况下，实现了低比特条件下的高压缩率与高精度，为资源受限设备上的模型部署提供了有效方案。

title: TIDE: Trajectory-Informed Skill Distillation for Efficient Text-to-Video Prompt Optimization
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) models are highly sensitive to prompt specificity, while iterative prompt optimization typically improves generation quality only through repeated video generation and vision-language model evaluation at inference time. We propose TIDE, a framework that distills this costly search process into an interpretable and reusable prompt-rewriting Skill. TIDE formulates prompt rewriting as a set of source-conditioned rule modules, each targeting a distinct semantic dimension. Once distilled, the frozen Skill activates the relevant rules and generates both positive and negative prompts in a single LLM call, followed by only one T2V generation, without test-time visual search or backbone fine-tuning. Evolved using only 100 prompts over 14 hours, TIDE achieves prompt-optimization performance comparable to computationally expensive search-based methods. Moreover, when transferred to previously unseen video-generation models, TIDE outperforms existing approaches specifically designed or trained for those models. Code is available at https://github.com/xiningin/TIDE_T2V.

AI.tldr: TIDE将昂贵的测试时提示词搜索过程蒸馏为一个可解释、可复用的提示词重写Skill，单次LLM调用即可生成正负提示词，仅需一次T2V生成。
AI.motivation: T2V模型对提示词特异性高度敏感，而迭代式提示词优化通常依赖推理时反复生成视频并用视觉语言模型评估，计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 将提示词重写建模为一组源条件驱动的规则模块，每个模块针对一个独立语义维度；蒸馏后得到冻结的Skill，可激活相关规则并在单次LLM调用中生成正、负提示词，随后仅进行一次T2V生成，无需测试时视觉搜索或骨干微调。
AI.result: 仅用100条提示词、14小时完成进化，即达到与高成本搜索类方法相当的提示词优化性能；迁移到未见过的视频生成模型时，优于专门为该模型设计或训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: TIDE把测试时的提示词搜索蒸馏为可解释、可复用的重写规则，实现了高效且具备跨模型泛化能力的T2V提示词优化。

title: RegExtract: A Benchmark for PFAS Regulatory Information Extraction with LLMs
comment: Accepted to the AI for Law Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
summary: Extracting structured information from regulatory documents is a critical but challenging task. Relevant facts are scattered across long, legally dense texts, and traceability of extracted facts to their source is essential for verification. With increasing awareness of the environmental and health impacts of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), regulatory documents have expanded significantly, varying in scope and product relevance, making interpretation challenging for manufacturers and policymakers. We introduce RegExtract, a benchmark for structured information extraction from PFAS regulatory documents, comprising 488 human-annotated field instances across 20 US state documents and 46 regulations. Each field instance includes a value and a provenance entry, yielding 976 entries in total. We define a typed, multi-field schema targeting key elements such as material definitions, permitted uses, and product exemptions, and propose provenance-aware evaluation metrics tailored to regulatory text. Through experiments with open- and closed-source LLMs across prompting strategies, document condensing methods, and schema partitioning approaches, we find that document identification fields remain challenging, and that field-specific few-shot examples improve extraction. This work lays the groundwork for AI tools for hazardous substance identification, question answering, and compliance monitoring. The code and data are available at https://github.com/IBM/PFAS-regulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RegExtract，一个面向PFAS监管文档结构化信息抽取的基准，包含488个人工标注字段实例与976条来源条目，并给出溯源感知评测指标。
AI.motivation: PFAS相关监管文档数量激增、文本冗长且法律用语密集，关键事实分散，且抽取结果需可溯源核验，制造商与政策制定者难以解读，缺乏专门基准与评测方法。
AI.method: 构建覆盖20份美国州级文档、46项法规的标注数据，定义包含物料定义、允许用途、产品豁免等类型化多字段模式；每个字段实例含值与其溯源条目；提出面向监管文本的溯源感知评测指标；在开源与闭源LLM上比较多种提示策略、文档压缩方法与模式划分方式。
AI.result: 文档识别类字段仍具挑战性；采用字段特定的少样本示例可提升抽取效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为危险物质识别、问答与合规监测的AI工具奠定基础，代码与数据已公开。

title: Generative Quantum Machine Learning Methods for Cancer Detection using Augmented Datasets
summary: Cancer detection using AI methods and image databases faces several challenges, including limited and imbalanced image datasets, long algorithm training times, and high-complexity feature generation. In particular, many cancer image datasets contain very few malignant examples compared to benign ones, limiting the amount of minority-class data available for training. Although classical AI and especially deep learning methods have had some success in providing cancer diagnostics, Quantum Machine Learning (QML) methods may offer advantages through high-dimensional feature representations, generative data augmentation, and the exploitation of feature correlations through quantum properties such as entanglement. In this paper, we propose using a generative QML method on the compressed breast ultrasound image dataset (BUSI) to generate synthetic images and hence augmented datasets for classifier training. In particular, we train a convolutional neural network with real, synthetic, and a combination of real and synthetic images. We test the algorithm on real images and provide comparative results for all three training cases. Our results show that the classifier trained entirely on synthetic images achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.802 (80.2%), compared with 0.760 (76.0%) for the real-data baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出一种生成式量子机器学习方法，用其在压缩乳腺超声图像数据集（BUSI）上生成合成图像以扩充训练集，并训练CNN分类器；仅用合成图训练的分类器AUC-ROC达0.802，优于真实数据基线的0.760。
AI.motivation: 癌症AI检测面临数据集规模有限且类别不平衡（恶性样本远少于良性）、算法训练时间长、特征生成复杂度高等问题。QML有望借助高维特征表示、生成式数据增强以及纠缠等量子特性对特征相关性的利用来缓解这些困难。
AI.method: 在压缩的乳腺超声图像数据集BUSI上应用生成式量子机器学习方法生成合成图像，构建增强数据集；随后分别用真实图像、合成图像及二者混合三种方式训练卷积神经网络，并在真实图像上进行测试与对比。
AI.result: 完全基于合成图像训练的分类器取得AUC-ROC 0.802（80.2%），而真实数据基线为0.760（76.0%），合成数据训练方案表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 生成式量子机器学习可为癌症图像提供有效的合成数据增强，在类别不平衡条件下提升分类性能，表明合成数据训练是缓解医学影像数据稀缺的可行途径。

title: Drive3R: Block-wise Streaming Geometric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://silence-ai423.github.io/Drive3R/
summary: High-fidelity closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving increasingly relies on dense multi-view 3D reconstruction. While recent feed-forward geometric foundation models have revolutionized per-scene optimization, applying them to continuous, long-horizon driving sequences is computationally intractable due to GPU memory limits and the quadratic complexity of global attention. Existing scaling strategies are fundamentally limited, as causal streaming suffers from compounding scale drift and trajectory deviation, while rigid "chunk-then-align" heuristics fragment global context and produce trajectory discontinuities. To address these limitations, we introduce Drive3R, a block-wise streaming geometric foundation model. Its block-wise causal attention resolves the scalability bottleneck of fully bidirectional attention while avoiding the loss of local future context in purely causal streaming. Its confidence-aware re-anchoring further mitigates long-range drift by detecting unreliable streaming states, re-initializing the KV cache, and stitching refreshed segments through SE(3) alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Drive3R establishes a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo. Specifically, on nuScenes, it improves over the recent DVGT-2 baseline from 0.1806 to 0.1081 in AbsRel, from 0.6750 to 0.5344 in point-cloud Accuracy, and from 1.5812 to 0.9092 in ATE.

AI.tldr: Drive3R 是一种分块流式几何基础模型，通过分块因果注意力与置信度感知重锚定，实现长时序、多视角自动驾驶场景的高效稠密三维重建。
AI.motivation: 闭环仿真需要稠密多视角三维重建，但现有前馈几何基础模型难以处理连续长时序驾驶序列：GPU 显存受限、全局注意力二次复杂度高；因果流式存在尺度漂移与轨迹偏移的累积，而"先分块再对齐"的启发式方法会割裂全局上下文，造成轨迹不连续。
AI.method: 提出 Drive3R 分块流式几何基础模型：采用分块因果注意力，在缓解全双向注意力可扩展性瓶颈的同时避免纯因果流式丢失局部未来上下文；引入置信度感知重锚定，通过检测不可靠的流式状态、重初始化 KV 缓存，并借助 SE(3) 对齐拼接刷新后的片段，缓解长程漂移。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes、KITTI、Waymo 上取得新的最优结果。nuScenes 上相对 DVGT-2 基线，AbsRel 从 0.1806 降至 0.1081，点云 Accuracy 从 0.6750 提升至 0.5344，ATE 从 1.5812 降至 0.9092。
AI.conclusion: Drive3R 通过分块因果注意力与置信度感知重锚定，有效解决了长时序多视角重建的可扩展性与漂移问题，在多个基准上达到领先性能，为高保真闭环自动驾驶仿真提供了可行方案。

title: RIECNN: Real-Time Image Enhanced CNN for Traffic Sign Recognition
comment: Published in Neural Computing and Applications, Volume 34, pages 6085-6096 (2022)
summary: Traffic sign recognition plays a crucial role in the development of autonomous cars to reduce the accident rate and promote road safety. It has been a necessity to address traffic signs that are affected significantly by the environment as well as poor real-time performance for deep-learning state-of-the-art algorithms. In this paper, we introduce Real-Time Image Enhanced CNN ({\our}) for Traffic Sign Recognition. {\our} is a real-time, novel approach that tackles multiple, diverse traffic sign datasets, and out-performs the state-of-the-art architectures in terms of recognition rate and execution time. Experiments are conducted using the German Traffic Sign Benchmark (GTSRB), the Belgium Traffic Sign Classification (BTSC), and the Croatian Traffic Sign (rMASTIF) benchmark. Experimental results show that our approach has achieved the highest recognition rate for all Benchmarks, achieving a recognition accuracy of 99.75\% for GTSRB, 99.25\% for BTSC and 99.55\% for rMASTIF. In terms of latency and meeting the real-time constraint, the pre-processing time and inference time together do not exceed 1.3 ms per image. Not only have our proposed approach achieved remarkably high accuracy with real-time performance, but it also demonstrated robustness against traffic sign recognition challenges such as brightness and contrast variations in the environment.

AI.tldr: 提出实时图像增强CNN（RIE-CNN），同时实现多数据集交通标志高精度识别与毫秒级实时性能。
AI.motivation: 交通标志识别对自动驾驶降低事故率、提升道路安全至关重要，但现有深度学习算法易受环境（如亮度、对比度变化）显著影响，且实时性较差，因此需要兼顾精度与实时性的方法。
AI.method: 提出Real-Time Image Enhanced CNN（RIE-CNN），一种实时图像增强卷积神经网络方法，可处理多个不同交通标志数据集，并在识别率与执行时间上超越现有先进架构；在德国GTSRB、比利时BTSC和克罗地亚rMASTIF基准上进行实验。
AI.result: 在所有基准上取得最高识别率：GTSRB 99.75%、BTSC 99.25%、rMASTIF 99.55%；预处理与推理时间合计每张图像不超过1.3 ms，满足实时约束；并对亮度与对比度变化等环境挑战表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在保持实时性能的同时实现了显著高精度，并验证了其对交通标志识别中环境变化挑战的鲁棒性，适用于自动驾驶场景。

title: Lumen-bench: Cross-Lingual Safety Gaps and the Say-Do Problem in Tool-Calling Large Language Models
summary: When a large language model refuses an unethical request, what does refusal mean? In conversation, refusal is bounded by what the model says; once the model is equipped with executable tools, what it does can diverge from what it says, a failure mode that English-only evaluations cannot fully reveal. We introduce Lumen-bench, a behavioral benchmark of tool-calling ethics spanning 30 models, five languages (Portuguese, English, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi), 108 Portuguese-authored scenarios, six social-pressure conditions, two system prompts (ethical and neutral), and 21 generic tools. The evaluation comprises 194,400 trials. Judgments come from a reasoning-model judge (o4-mini), calibrated against one Portuguese-speaking author ($n=83$; harmful/non-harmful $κ=0.78$), compared with two other provider judges (Fleiss' $κ=0.78$, $n=607$), and complemented by retrospective sandbox replay. Four findings emerge. (i) Within-model comparisons support higher harmful-action rates in Hindi and Portuguese than English under the ethical prompt, and Hindi and Spanish under the neutral prompt, after multiple-testing correction. (ii) Premium models have lower median violation rates, although price does not guarantee safety or competence. (iii) Replacing the ethical system prompt with a neutral one raises pooled violation rates from 2.76\% to 13.64\%. (iv) In 8.57\% of substantive-call cases, refusal or ethical objection accompanies a harmful tool call: the judges consistently identify the say-do gap, although they differ in how many responses they assign to this category. Matched benign controls demonstrate legitimate task completion in 82.8\% of 3,300 trials. Code and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/TropicAI-Research/lumen.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Lumen-bench，一个覆盖30个模型、5种语言、108个场景、6种社会压力条件、2种系统提示与21个通用工具的工具调用伦理行为基准，共194,400次试验，并揭示"言行不一"（say-do gap）等四类关键发现。
AI.motivation: 现有伦理评估多为纯文本或仅英文，无法揭示模型在具备可执行工具时"说的"与"做的"之间的背离。当模型拒绝不道德请求时，拒绝的边界仅由文本界定；一旦配备可执行工具，其行为可能与所言分离，而英语单语评估难以充分暴露这一失效模式。
AI.method: 构建 Lumen-bench 行为基准：覆盖30个模型、5种语言（葡、英、西、中、印地）、108个葡语作者撰写的场景、6种社会压力条件、2种系统提示（伦理型与中性）及21个通用工具。共194,400次试验。评判由推理模型裁判（o4-mini）完成，并针对一名葡语母语作者进行校准（n=83；有害/无害 κ=0.78），与其他两个供应商裁判对比（Fleiss' κ=0.78，n=607），辅以回溯性沙箱回放。
AI.result: 四项发现：(i) 模型内比较显示，在伦理提示下印地语与葡萄牙语的有害行动率高于英语，在中性提示下印地语与西班牙语更高（经多重检验校正）。(ii) 高端模型的中位违规率更低，但价格并不保证安全或能力。(iii) 将伦理系统提示替换为中性提示，使汇总违规率从2.76%升至13.64%。(iv) 在8.57%的实质调用案例中，拒绝或伦理异议与有害工具调用同时出现，裁判一致识别出该言行差距，但在归入该类的响应数量上存在差异。匹配的良性对照在3,300次试验中82.8%完成合法任务。
AI.conclusion: 工具调用伦理存在显著的语言差异与提示依赖性，模型存在可被裁判一致识别的"言行不一"失效模式；价格并非安全或能力的保证。基准与复现脚本已开源，为多语言工具调用伦理评估提供可复现的行为学框架。

title: Compute-Optimal Scaling Laws for Spiking Language Models
comment: Accepted to AXIOM: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning (NeurIPS 2026 workshop). 4 pages + appendix, 4 figures, 5 tables
summary: Spiking neural networks target energy-efficient language modeling through sparse, binary activations, but the efficiency-accuracy tradeoff of spiking language models is uncharacterized at scale. We present the first Chinchilla-style IsoFLOP scaling study of a spiking language model, sweeping SpikeGPT-family models (RWKV backbone) from width 384 to 1536 across compute budgets from $3\times10^{17}$ to $10^{19}$ FLOPs on FineWeb-EDU. We report two findings. First, the compute-optimal frontier is $N_{opt} \propto C^{0.56}$, close to the 0.50 that Hoffmann et al. report for dense Transformers, so spiking does not change how parameters and data should be traded off under a compute budget. Second, against non-spiking RWKV and Transformer baselines trained the same way, the loss gap splits into a backbone cost of about 0.16 nats that does not change with compute and a spiking cost that falls from 0.34 to about 0.23 nats and then levels off. These results give the first compute-optimal recipe for spiking language models and quantify the accuracy cost of their sparsity.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次对脉冲语言模型（SpikeGPT/RWKV骨干）进行了Chinchilla风格IsoFLOP缩放研究，发现其计算最优前沿N_opt ∝ C^0.56，并量化了脉冲稀疏性带来的精度代价。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络旨在通过稀疏二值激活实现能效高的语言建模，但脉冲语言模型的效率-精度权衡在大规模下尚未被刻画。作者希望填补这一空白，确定脉冲语言模型的计算最优配方并量化其稀疏性的精度代价。
AI.method: 在FineWeb-EDU数据集上，对SpikeGPT家族模型（RWKV骨干）进行首次Chinchilla风格IsoFLOP缩放研究，宽度从384扫到1536，计算预算从3×10^17到10^19 FLOPs，并与相同训练方式的非脉冲RWKV和Transformer基线进行比较。
AI.result: 1) 计算最优前沿为N_opt ∝ C^0.56，接近Hoffmann等人报道的稠密Transformer的0.50，说明脉冲不改变计算预算下参数与数据的权衡方式。2) 与基线相比，损失差距分为两部分：约0.16 nats的骨干代价（不随计算变化）和从0.34降至约0.23 nats后趋于平稳的脉冲代价。
AI.conclusion: 该研究给出了脉冲语言模型的首个计算最优配方，并量化了其稀疏性带来的精度代价，表明脉冲机制不改变缩放律的参数-数据权衡，但引入了稳定的骨干代价和随计算先降后稳的脉冲代价。

title: Where Did We Go Wrong? Localizing Errors to Repair Multi-Turn Conversations
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants are increasingly used in multi-turn conversations, where the user's intent is often unclear at first and revealed only gradually over time. The assistant must therefore interpret each exchange and form inferences about the user's intent, using them to update its working state. These updates usually refine the assistant's understanding, but a misinterpretation can instead corrupt its working state by ruling out the true intent, influencing subsequent turns and ultimately causing the conversation to fail. Efficient recovery then requires locating and revising the misinterpretation without discarding information that remains valid. We introduce Loci (Localization Of Corrupted Inferences), a framework for probabilistically localizing misinterpretations and selectively repairing the assistant's working state. Given an observed failure, Loci reasons over possible user intents and assigns each update a probability of having excluded the true intent. These probabilities rank suspected updates and quantify the model's confidence in the localization of the underlying misinterpretations. Loci then uses this information in a repair policy that decides whether to retain, verify, or remove suspected updates, enabling recovery from corrupted inferences while preserving useful information. To evaluate Loci's ability to identify misinterpretations, we first test it in a controlled setup with injected errors. We find that Loci improves localization over the baselines, with its advantage becoming larger when multiple errors occur. We then evaluate it in free-form conversations, where misinterpretations arise naturally, and measure the interactions needed to complete the task after an initial failure. Using localization confidence to guide repair, Loci reduces mean recovery cost by 46-79% relative to the strongest baseline across multiple domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Loci框架，用于在多轮对话中概率化地定位并选择性修复LLM助手工作状态中被污染的错误推断，从而以更低成本实现对话恢复。
AI.motivation: 多轮对话中用户意图往往逐步显现，助手需逐轮推断意图并更新工作状态。若某次推断误解了意图，会排除真实意图、污染状态，进而导致后续轮次失败。恢复的关键在于定位并修正误解，同时不丢弃仍然有效的信息。
AI.method: Loci（Localization Of Corrupted Inferences）在观察到失败后，对可能的用户意图进行推理，为每个状态更新赋予"排除真实意图"的概率；据此对可疑更新排序并量化定位置信度。随后用修复策略决定对可疑更新是保留、验证还是删除，在修复污染推断的同时保留有用信息。
AI.result: 在注入错误的受控实验中，Loci的定位优于基线，且错误越多优势越明显；在自然产生误解的自由对话中，以定位置信度指导修复，Loci在多个领域将平均恢复成本相对最强基线降低46%–79%。
AI.conclusion: 通过概率化定位误解并选择性修复工作状态，Loci能高效恢复对话失败，兼顾定位准确性与恢复效率，在受控与自由对话场景中均验证有效。

title: RootSLAM: Square Root Bundle Adjustment for Visual-Inertial SLAM
summary: Efficient perception is a prerequisite for the small, low-power devices targeted by robotics, mixed reality, autonomous driving, and drone applications, all of which rely on Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) to estimate their motion within their surroundings. Learning-based SLAM systems achieve state-of-the-art accuracy but are demanding in compute, whereas classical geometry-based methods retain a strong efficiency advantage with little to no loss in accuracy. In this work we present RootSLAM, a fully-featured visual-inertial SLAM system for multi-camera setups built on Basalt. RootSLAM achieves accuracy competitive with the state of the art while running up to 20 times faster, facilitating the deployment of perception systems in resource constrained environments. We adapt the square-root bundle adjustment formulation from structure from motion into the multi-camera visual-inertial SLAM setting through a novel reformulation that leverages the system's pose-graph, letting the global optimizer run in single-precision floating point, thus doubling its performance. We provide a thorough benchmark against the state of the art together with an ablation study of our contributions. Our new implementation, including its map management and loop detection module, pose-graph optimizer, and global mapping components, will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RootSLAM，一个基于Basalt的多相机视觉惯性SLAM系统，通过将平方根束调整引入多相机VIO框架，使全局优化器可单精度运行，速度提升最高20倍且精度与SOTA相当。
AI.motivation: 小型低功耗设备（机器人、混合现实、自动驾驶、无人机）依赖SLAM估计运动，需要高效感知。学习型SLAM精度高但算力需求大，经典几何方法效率高但需在精度上做出妥协，难以兼顾精度与效率。
AI.method: 构建于Basalt之上，实现功能完整的多相机视觉惯性SLAM系统。将structure from motion中的平方根束调整（square-root bundle adjustment）适配到多相机视觉惯性SLAM场景，通过利用系统位姿图的新颖重构，使全局优化器可在单精度浮点下运行，从而性能翻倍。系统包含地图管理、回环检测、位姿图优化与全局建图模块。
AI.result: 精度与当前最优方法具有竞争力，同时运行速度最高提升20倍；单精度全局优化使性能翻倍。论文提供了与SOTA的全面基准对比以及针对自身贡献的消融实验。
AI.conclusion: RootSLAM在保持SOTA级精度的同时显著提升效率，适用于资源受限环境下的感知系统部署，相关实现将开源。

title: Learning Proposition-Level Links from Sentence-Level Supervision for Neuro-Symbolic NLI
summary: We study neuro-symbolic natural language inference (NLI) with independently translated propositional representations of the premise and hypothesis. Before symbolic reasoning, the system must infer semantic links between their proposition-level units (atoms). Existing systems based on Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) and Boolean satisfiability (SAT) identify these links using fixed embedding-based source selection and pretrained sentence-level NLI models not trained for atom-level linking. We introduce a trainable atom linker that jointly predicts link existence, source selection, and relation type. Without atom-pair training annotations, we treat cross-formula link structures as latent and train the linker from sentence-level NLI labels, keeping the translator and SAT reasoner fixed. We evaluate on the full public test splits of Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) and Sentences Involving Compositional Knowledge (SICK), and the matched and mismatched validation splits of Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MNLI). Our system improves accuracy by 11.40-27.09 percentage points over a baseline applying sentence-trained NLI models unchanged to atom pairs within the same SAT pipeline. It also improves over the prior fixed-linker AMR-to-SAT system by 8.14-26.32 percentage points on SNLI and both MNLI splits, with a smaller gain on SICK.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可训练的原子链接器，从句子级NLI标签中隐式学习公式间链接结构，联合预测链接存在性、源选择与关系类型，显著提升神经符号NLI推理性能。
AI.motivation: 神经符号NLI在独立翻译的前提和假设命题表示上进行符号推理前，需推断两者命题单元（原子）间的语义链接。现有基于AMR与SAT的系统使用固定嵌入式源选择和未针对原子级链接训练的句级NLI模型，导致链接质量受限。
AI.method: 提出可训练的原子链接器，联合预测链接存在性、源选择与关系类型。在缺乏原子对训练标注的情况下，将跨公式链接结构视为隐变量，仅用句子级NLI标签进行训练，同时保持翻译器与SAT推理器固定。
AI.result: 在SNLI与SICK全公开测试集及MNLI匹配和不匹配验证集上评估。较将句级NLI模型直接用于原子对的基线，准确率提升11.40–27.09个百分点；较先前固定链接器的AMR-to-SAT系统，在SNLI和两个MNLI划分上提升8.14–26.32个百分点，SICK上增益较小。
AI.conclusion: 可训练原子链接器能有效利用弱监督信号学习隐式链接结构，无需原子级标注即显著优于固定链接器与句级迁移方法，验证了链接建模对神经符号NLI推理的关键作用。

title: Sanzaru: Benchmarking Protocol Formation under Epistemic & Communication Asymmetry
summary: A language model's ability to solve a task individually does not ensure that a team can solve it under unequal access to information and communication. SANZARU examines this gap through cooperative bomb-defusal puzzles adapted from BOMBANANA! (Lefto Studio, 2026). Task information and action authority are divided among three agents: one cannot hear, another cannot speak, and the third cannot see. The benchmark contains 120 puzzle instances across seven families, each targeting a distinct coordination ability. Across 1512 episodes, 7 models achieve an overall success rate of 49%, ranging from 20% to 86% under the evaluated configurations. Teams develop or adopt diverse communication protocols, from simple gesture codes to Morse and encodings of entire manuals. Yet trace analysis attributes about 60% of 771 team losses to communication, and agents attempt to use channels unavailable to their teammates despite explicit role instructions. Together, task outcomes and interaction traces enable evaluation of both collaborative performance and perspective taking throughout cooperation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/markli404/sanzaru-benchmark.

AI.tldr: SANZARU 基准通过三人信息不对称的拆弹协作谜题，评测大模型团队的协作表现与视角采择能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型单独解题能力不等于团队在不平等信息与沟通条件下的协作能力，需专门基准揭示这一差距。
AI.method: 基于 BOMBANANA! 改造协作拆弹任务，将任务信息与行动权限分给三名代理：一人听不见、一人说不出、一人看不见；含 7 类共 120 个谜题实例，各针对一种协作能力；共 1512 局、7 个模型参与评测，并结合交互轨迹分析。
AI.result: 整体成功率 49%，不同配置下为 20%–86%；团队自发形成从手势代码到摩尔斯码、整本手册编码等多样通信协议；约 60% 的 771 次团队失败归因于沟通，且代理常使用队友不可用的信道，尽管角色说明已明确限制。
AI.conclusion: 任务结果与交互轨迹结合，可同时评测协作性能与合作过程中的视角采择；基准已开源。

title: TRIG: Toward Measuring Texture Realism in Image Generation
summary: This paper studies the backbone used by metrics for evaluating the quality of generated images. Although generative models have advanced rapidly, some outputs still exhibit unrealistic texture characteristics, and these differences are difficult to measure. Widely used evaluation metrics provide limited insight into texture realism, since they often rely on a backbone trained for another objective, such as image classification or image-text alignment. Such objectives typically encourage invariance to low-level variations that carry texture, so the resulting features primarily encode semantic and global structure. As a result, texture-specific discrepancies may not be explicitly captured. We propose TRIG, a metric directed at the texture realism of generated images. Its backbone is instead the discriminator of a generative adversarial network pre-trained on a texture dataset, which provides a learned prior for the local statistics of natural textures. A plausibility head is fine-tuned to identify local texture degradations, while preserving natural defocus and sensor noise as positive cases. On the features of this backbone, we compute a standard distributional distance between a reference set of real images and a set of generated ones. We apply TRIG to several generative models and observe closer agreement with human realness ratings than baseline metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TRIG，一种面向生成图像纹理真实性的评价指标。其骨干网络为在纹理数据集上预训练的 GAN 判别器，并微调一个合理性头以区分局部纹理退化与自然失焦/传感器噪声，随后在特征上计算真实集与生成集之间的分布距离。TRIG 在多个生成模型上与人类真实感评分的吻合度优于基线指标。
AI.motivation: 现有生成图像质量评价指标所用骨干网络通常为图像分类或图文对齐等其它目标而训练，这些目标鼓励对承载纹理的低层变化保持不变性，使特征主要编码语义与全局结构，因而难以显式捕捉纹理真实性方面的差异；同时生成模型的部分输出仍存在不真实的纹理特性且难以度量。
AI.method: TRIG 以在纹理数据集上预训练的 GAN 判别器作为骨干，为自然纹理的局部统计提供学习到的先验；在此基础上微调一个合理性头（plausibility head），用于识别局部纹理退化，同时将自然失焦与传感器噪声保留为正例；最后在该骨干特征上，计算参考真实图像集与生成图像集之间的标准分布距离。
AI.result: 将 TRIG 应用于多个生成模型，其评价结果与人类真实感评分的吻合度优于基线指标。
AI.conclusion: 面向纹理真实性的评价需要采用匹配该目标的骨干先验，而非语义导向的通用骨干；以纹理 GAN 判别器为骨干并结合合理性微调的分布距离度量，可更有效地捕捉纹理层面的差异，并更贴合人类对真实感的判断。

title: Active Learning for Finding a Needle in a Haystack
summary: Training a classifier to find a rare class of documents, such as hate speech directed at a particular religious group, requires labelled examples that are expensive to obtain when the class makes up only a small fraction of a corpus. Active learning reduces this cost, but it must start from an initial labelled set that contains examples of the target class. Random sampling cannot supply these at reasonable cost, so they must be selected in some other way, such as keyword search, and any such selection biases the initial set towards part of the target class. We evaluate whether active learning can correct this bias. On AG News and Measuring Hate Speech, at a prevalence of around 1%, we compare random sampling with eight active learning strategies, starting from initial sets that cover or omit known subgroups of the target class, and measure recall on the omitted subgroups as well as F1. On AG News, almost every strategy recovers the omitted subgroup. On Measuring Hate Speech, uncertainty-based strategies recover less of the omitted subgroups than random sampling, whereas discriminative active learning recovers 55% of them without a significant loss of F1. Aggregate metrics conceal these differences.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究主动学习能否纠正因初始种子集采用关键词搜索等非随机选择而引入的子群偏差。在AG News和Measuring Hate Speech（约1% prevalence）上，比较随机采样与八种主动学习策略，并测量被遗漏子群的召回率与整体F1。结果显示：AG News上几乎所有策略都能恢复被遗漏子群；Measuring Hate Speech上基于不确定性的策略恢复效果不如随机采样，而判别式主动学习可恢复55%的被遗漏子群且F1无显著损失，说明聚合指标会掩盖子群差异。
AI.motivation: 训练稀有类（如针对特定宗教群体的仇恨言论）分类器需要标注样本，但该类在语料中占比极小，标注成本高昂。主动学习可降低成本，却依赖包含目标类样本的初始标注集；随机采样难以低成本获得这些样本，只能用关键词搜索等方式选取，从而把初始集偏向目标类的某一子群。论文因此关注主动学习能否纠正这种子群偏差。
AI.method: 在AG News与Measuring Hate Speech两个数据集上，目标类prevalence约为1%。构造覆盖或遗漏已知目标类子群的初始集，比较随机采样与八种主动学习策略，分别测量被遗漏子群的recall以及整体F1。
AI.result: 在AG News上，几乎所有策略都能恢复被遗漏的子群。在Measuring Hate Speech上，基于不确定性的策略对被遗漏子群的恢复不如随机采样；判别式主动学习策略可恢复55%的被遗漏子群，且F1没有显著损失。
AI.conclusion: 主动学习纠正初始种子集子群偏差的能力因策略与数据集而异：整体F1等聚合指标会掩盖子群恢复上的差异，评估稀有类主动学习时应同时报告被遗漏子群的召回率。

title: ExeWorldBench: Benchmarking Code-Based Executable 3D World Modeling
summary: Coding agents are increasingly evolving beyond reproducing what a world looks like toward constructing executable worlds that capture how a world works. This shift calls for executable world modeling, which integrates two core capabilities: world understanding, reasoning about the underlying structural, mechanical, and causal principles of a world, and executable realization, translating that understanding into a code-based system whose behavior emerges from physical interactions. However, existing benchmarks provide only fragmented evaluations centered on physical reasoning, visual fidelity, or behavioral correctness, leaving the integration of these capabilities insufficiently assessed. To bridge this gap, we introduce ExeWorldBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark to comprehensively evaluate world understanding and executable realization through code-based 3D world construction. ExeWorldBench comprises three progressively challenging tasks: Mechanism Executability, which evaluates the realization of individual mechanisms from visual observations; Compositional Executability, which extends to multi-stage systems with spatial, mechanical, and causal dependencies; and Intent-Driven Executable World Synthesis, which requires constructing executable worlds from high-level goals and physical requirements. Extensive experiments on frontier models reveal substantial limitations in executable world modeling, offering insights into the development of more physically grounded and causally coherent world construction systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ExeWorldBench，首个通过代码化 3D 世界构建来综合评估"世界理解"与"可执行实现"能力的基准，包含机制可执行性、组合可执行性、意图驱动可执行世界合成三个递进任务。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体正从复现世界外观转向构建可执行世界，即捕捉世界运行机制，这需要"可执行世界建模"，融合世界理解（推理结构、机械与因果原理）与可执行实现（转化为代码系统）。然而现有基准仅提供围绕物理推理、视觉保真或行为正确性的碎片化评估，未能充分衡量二者的整合能力。
AI.method: 引入 ExeWorldBench 基准，通过基于代码的 3D 世界构建来综合评估世界理解与可执行实现，设计三个递进难度的任务：机制可执行性（从视觉观察实现单个机制）、组合可执行性（扩展至具有空间、机械与因果依赖的多阶段系统）、意图驱动可执行世界合成（从高层目标与物理需求构建可执行世界）。
AI.result: 在前沿模型上的大量实验揭示了可执行世界建模存在显著局限。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为开发更具物理基础与因果连贯性的世界构建系统提供了洞见。

title: UDHRBench: Benchmarking Human Rights in Large Language Models
comment: Alak Raad and Noreldin Morssy contributed equally to this work
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in contexts requiring adherence to ethical and legal norms, yet their alignment with internationally recognized human rights standards remains underexplored. We introduce UDHRBench, a large-scale benchmark for operationalising the evaluation of large language model compliance with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. The dataset comprises 1,124 human rights confronting questions covering all 30 articles and 4,496 responses from four large language models (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, and Fanar), manually annotated by experts for alignment, with high inter-annotator agreement ($κ= 0.801$). Our analysis reveals systematic and non-trivial misalignments, showing that violations typically arise through seemingly rational reasoning: appeals to efficiency, risk management, or scientific neutrality, rather than explicit rejection of rights. We further propose an LLM-as-a-Judge framework for automated evaluation using zero-shot and few-shot prompting, achieving 89.8\% weighted F1-score in detecting human-rights misalignment, alongside a novel Alignment Leniency Score that quantifies how judge models resolve ambiguous cases. The dataset, annotations, and code will be released as open-source resources (https://sina.birzeit.edu/UDHRBench).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出UDHRBench，一个评估大语言模型与《世界人权宣言》对齐程度的大规模基准，包含1,124个人权相关问题和4,496个模型回答，由专家人工标注。分析发现模型违规往往源于看似理性的推理（如效率、风险管理、科学中立），而非直接否定权利。作者进一步提出LLM-as-a-Judge自动评估框架，达到89.8%加权F1，并引入Alignment Leniency Score量化判定模型在模糊案例中的倾向。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益应用于需遵守伦理与法律规范的场景，但其与国际公认人权标准的对齐程度尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统化、可操作的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建UDHRBench基准：覆盖《世界人权宣言》全部30条条款的1,124个人权对照问题，采集四个大模型（ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini、Fanar）共4,496条回答，由专家人工标注对齐情况（标注者间一致性κ=0.801）。并提出基于零样本与少样本提示的LLM-as-a-Judge自动评估框架，以及Alignment Leniency Score指标。
AI.result: 发现模型存在系统性且非平凡的对齐偏差；违规通常以看似合理的推理形式出现（援引效率、风险管理或科学中立），而非明确拒绝权利。自动评估框架在检测人权偏差方面达到89.8%加权F1。
AI.conclusion: UDHRBench为评估大模型人权合规性提供了首个大规模可操作基准，揭示了对齐问题的隐蔽性，并提供可自动化的评估方法；数据集、标注与代码将开源发布。

title: Word-Aligned Prosody Reflects Speaker Differences More Than Depression or PTSD Severity
summary: Word-aligned prosody is increasingly used to detect depression and posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), yet the stability and clinical relevance of these measurements remain unclear. We examine stability at two levels. At the word level, we ask whether a speaker produces the same word in a similar speaker-specific way across different utterance contexts. At the speaker level, we ask whether averaging prosody across many words produces consistent speaker scores across separate recordings. Drawing on principles of psychological measurement, we compare these representations in four corpora spanning acted, spontaneous, and clinical speech. Word-specific deviations show little cross-context recurrence (0.01-0.16), whereas speaker summaries are highly consistent, reaching 0.997 in ESD, 0.73-0.90 in MSP-Podcast, and 0.84-0.996 in DAIC-WOZ and PTSD-STOP. Despite this consistency, associations with depression or PTSD severity do not exceed 0.15; equivalence tests exclude effects of 0.30 in all analyses and 0.20 in DAIC-WOZ, while within-person associations with daily PTSD symptoms are near zero ($|ρ|\leq0.04$). Thus, aggregation yields stable speaker-level prosodic measures, but these measures do not detectably track depression or PTSD severity in the studied corpora. Code is available at https://github.com/jen900704/word-aligned-prosody.

AI.tldr: 词对齐韵律在抑郁/PTSD检测中日益应用，但其测量稳定性与临床相关性存疑。研究在词级与说话人级两个层面评估稳定性，并检验与症状严重度的关联。结果显示：说话人级韵律汇总高度稳定，但与抑郁/PTSD严重度的关联极弱，未通过等效性检验的效应界限。
AI.motivation: 词对齐韵律测量被广泛用于抑郁和创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）检测，但其测量稳定性（信度）与临床相关性（效度）尚不明确，缺乏基于心理测量学原则的系统检验。
AI.method: 依据心理测量学原则，在四个语料库（涵盖表演式、自发式和临床语音：ESD、MSP-Podcast、DAIC-WOZ、PTSD-STOP）中比较两种表征：词级——同一说话人在不同话语语境中对同一词的发音是否相似（跨语境重现性）；说话人级——跨多个词平均后的韵律得分在不同录音间是否一致。并进一步检验这些表征与抑郁/PTSD严重度（含日常PTSD症状）的关联，采用等效性检验设定效应界限。
AI.result: 词特异偏差的跨语境重现性很低（0.01–0.16）；说话人级汇总高度一致，ESD 达 0.997，MSP-Podcast 为 0.73–0.90，DAIC-WOZ 与 PTSD-STOP 为 0.84–0.996。与抑郁或PTSD严重度的关联不超过 0.15；等效性检验在所有分析中排除 0.30 的效应、在 DAIC-WOZ 中排除 0.20 的效应；个体内与日常PTSD症状的关联接近零（|ρ|≤0.04）。
AI.conclusion: 聚合可得到稳定的说话人级韵律测量，但所研究的语料库中这些测量未能可检测地追踪抑郁或PTSD严重度，提示其临床效度有限。代码已开源。

title: SAFE-KV: Causal Suffix Repair for Behavior-Preserving Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in RAG
comment: Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026. 36 pages, 5 figures, 33 tables. Code: https://github.com/XingjianZhang-dev/safe-kv
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reuses the same documents across many requests, making non-prefix KV-cache reuse attractive. Yet a cached document state is not reusable text: it is a context-conditioned causal state whose keys and values depend on the prefix, position, and preceding documents under which it was computed. We formulate non-prefix KV reuse as a behavior-preservation problem with full prefill on the exact prompt as the reference, and introduce SAFE-KV, which repairs a composed cache by re-encoding the causal suffix from a selected start document. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, prefix-conditioned composition preserves only 47.2% of HotpotQA-500 and 37.8% of 2Wiki-500 full-prefill answers; SAFE-KV with risk-guided K2 selection restores 99.8%/98.4% (donor-copy protocol) and 100.0%/98.4% with actual suffix forwarding. Document-only and fixed-window repairs recover far less, because the document states after the repaired region keep histories that omit it. Reuse without repair is exact up to four documents and degrades at sixteen, where suffix repair recovers 98-100%. Faithful repair re-encodes most of the context, so in a single-request L40S study SAFE-KV's operating rule serves every workload by full prefill. SAFE-KV thus establishes the causal-state contract for non-prefix reuse and a validated repair mechanism that meets it.

AI.tldr: 该论文将非前缀KV缓存复用形式化为行为保持问题，提出SAFE-KV通过重编码因果后缀修复组合缓存，在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上把非前缀复用的答案保持率从47.2%/37.8%恢复到99.8%/98.4%（甚至100.0%/98.4%），并指出忠实修复代价高，最终运行规则对单请求工作负载仍回退到全prefill。
AI.motivation: RAG在不同请求间复用相同文档，使非前缀KV缓存复用颇具吸引力；但缓存文档状态并非可复用文本，而是依赖前缀、位置与前序文档的上下文条件因果状态，直接组合会破坏与全prefill行为的一致性，因此需要一个明确的复用契约与修复机制。
AI.method: 把非前缀KV复用定义为以“对精确提示做全prefill”为参照的行为保持问题；提出SAFE-KV，通过对选定起始文档起的因果后缀进行重编码来修复组合缓存，并采用风险引导的K2选择策略；对比文档级修复与固定窗口修复，并考察复用文档数量（4 vs 16）的影响。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，前缀条件组合仅保留HotpotQA-500的47.2%、2Wiki-500的37.8%全prefill答案；SAFE-KV（风险引导K2选择）恢复到99.8%/98.4%（donor-copy协议）和100.0%/98.4%（实际后缀前向）。仅文档级与固定窗口修复恢复率远低，因被修复区域之后的文档状态仍缺失该段历史。无修复复用在前四篇文档时精确，在16篇时退化，此时后缀修复恢复到98-100%。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-KV建立了非前缀KV复用的“因果状态契约”，并给出一套经验证的契约满足性修复机制；但由于忠实修复需要重编码大部分上下文，在单请求L40S研究中，其运行规则对每种工作负载都选择全prefill。

title: Do LLMs differentiate linguistic traits internally?: A layer-wise analysis
summary: Large language models often produce judgments that resemble human responses, but it remains unclear whether they internally capture linguistic nuances such as conventional versus idiomatic meaning. A layer-wise representational analysis was conducted on two equal-sized pre-trained models, Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma-3-1B-PT, to examine whether and where these models differentiate linguistic traits from input. The analysis combined layer-wise probing with geometric distance measures, using the top embedding dimensions ranked by principal component loadings for each layer. The results show that even with equal capacity, models organize linguistic information in fundamentally different ways, suggesting the need to analyze internal representational geometry, examining not just behavioral outputs but semantic space alignment when evaluating how closely human and model language interpretation correspond.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过逐层表征分析对比 Llama-3.2-1B 与 Gemma-3-1B-PT，发现同等参数规模下两模型对语言特征（如常规义与习语义）的组织方式存在本质差异，主张评估应超越行为输出，关注内部表征几何。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常输出类人判断，但其内部是否真正编码了语言细微差别（如常规含义与习语含义）尚不明确，需要探究模型在何处、以何种方式区分语言特征。
AI.method: 对两个参数量相同的预训练模型（Llama-3.2-1B 和 Gemma-3-1B-PT）进行逐层表征分析，结合逐层探针（layer-wise probing）与几何距离度量，并使用按主成分载荷排序的各层顶部嵌入维度。
AI.result: 即便模型容量相同，两个模型仍以根本不同的方式组织语言信息。
AI.conclusion: 评估人类与模型语言解释的对应程度时，不应仅看行为输出，而需分析内部表征几何与语义空间对齐。

title: Exploring Jailbreak Vulnerability Across Depth-Based Dynamic Inference in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to be computationally expensive and vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, in which adversarial prompts bypass safety alignment and induce harmful responses. To address this inefficiency, a range of techniques have been proposed to enable efficient LLM inference. Depth-based dynamic inference has demonstrated promising results by enabling outputs to be generated from intermediate layers. It offers the flexibility to adjust model behavior based on the available resource budget. However, how this flexibility affects the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks remains unexplored. In this paper, we address this gap via a comprehensive investigation into the impact of depth-based dynamic inference on the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks. Specifically, we make the following key observations: 1) Shallow exits are consistently more robust to jailbreak attacks than deeper ones; 2) Exit depth affects how easily the adversarial suffix can be optimized, with deeper exits reaching lower attack loss; and 3) Adversarial suffixes affect utility uniformly across exit depths. These insights can help design dynamic inference methodologies that are more robust to jailbreak attacks. Code is available at https://github.com/LassNajmuldeen/balcony-jailbreaking

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了基于深度的动态推理对LLM越狱攻击鲁棒性的影响，发现浅层出口比深层出口更鲁棒，出口深度影响对抗后缀优化难度，且对抗后缀对效用影响在各深度上一致。
AI.motivation: LLM计算开销大且易受越狱攻击（对抗提示绕过安全对齐并诱导有害回复）。基于深度的动态推理可实现高效推理，允许从中间层生成输出并根据资源预算调整模型行为。然而，这种灵活性对LLM抵御越狱攻击鲁棒性的影响尚属空白。
AI.method: 针对上述空白，对基于深度的动态推理对LLM越狱攻击鲁棒性的影响展开全面研究，通过实验分析不同出口深度下的鲁棒性表现、对抗后缀优化难度及效用变化。
AI.result: 1）浅层出口始终比深层出口对越狱攻击更鲁棒；2）出口深度影响对抗后缀的优化难易程度，深层出口能达到更低的攻击损失；3）对抗后缀对各出口深度的效用影响是均匀的。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现有助于设计对越狱攻击更具鲁棒性的动态推理方法。代码已开源。

title: PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces
comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. 37 pages, 1 figure, 22 tables. M. Yigit Turali and Shreyas Rajesh contributed equally
summary: Deep research requires connecting multiple steps of search, reasoning, and computation, with intermediate findings guiding what to investigate next. As investigations grow, agents must maintain research state across model calls and check findings before errors propagate into subsequent work. We introduce PANINI-DR, a multi-agent harness that separates coordination of the overall investigation from the research and verification of individual subquestions. A shared workspace, built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation, records subquestions, their dependencies, findings, and supporting evidence. Researchers investigate individual subquestions, while a separate verification agent checks proposed answers against those subquestions and their evidence. Verification feedback guides further investigation, and recorded findings inform subsequent assignments. We evaluate PANINI-DR on BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES, and MoNaCo against seven state-of-the-art deep-research harnesses, all using a shared language-model backbone and frozen corpora. PANINI-DR achieves the strongest average performance across the three benchmarks. On BrowseComp-Plus, it achieves 73.3% accuracy, outperforming the next-best harness by 16.0 points. Its advantage is strongest on hard questions, where it answers nearly twice as many as the next-best harness. Ablations further show that structured planning and persistent state improve performance, as does checking each finding against its cited evidence before it is reused. Because a model can answer correctly from memory alone, we also analyze the evidence retained by each harness. PANINI-DR achieves the highest answer recoverability from saved evidence on all three benchmarks, while complementary claim-support audits show stronger evidence-backed answers. Accounting for this evidence changes how harnesses compare and further strengthens PANINI-DR's advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PANINI-DR，一种多智能体深度研究框架，将整体调查协调与单个子问题的研究与验证分离，并基于生成语义工作区构建共享工作区记录子问题、依赖、发现与证据，在 BrowseComp-Plus、FRAMES、MoNaCo 三个基准上取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 深度研究需要串联多步搜索、推理与计算，中间发现会指导后续调查方向。随着调查规模扩大，智能体必须跨模型调用维护研究状态，并在错误传播到后续工作前对发现进行核验，现有方法在这方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出 PANINI-DR 多智能体框架：将整体调查协调与各子问题的研究、验证相分离；构建基于 Generative Semantic Workspace 表示的共享工作区，记录子问题、依赖关系、发现及支撑证据；由研究员智能体调查各子问题，独立的验证智能体依据子问题及其证据检查候选答案；验证反馈指导后续调查，已记录的发现用于指导后续任务分配。
AI.result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus、FRAMES、MoNaCo 上，与七个最先进深度研究框架（共享同一语言模型骨干与冻结语料）对比，PANINI-DR 平均性能最强；BrowseComp-Plus 准确率 73.3%，超出次优框架 16.0 个百分点，在难题上优势最大，解得数量约为次优框架的两倍。消融实验表明结构化规划、持久状态以及对每条发现复用前进行证据核验均能提升性能。此外，PANINI-DR 在三个基准上从保存证据中恢复答案的可恢复性最高，互补的主张-支持审计显示其答案具有更强的证据支撑；纳入证据因素后进一步强化了其优势。
AI.conclusion: PANINI-DR 通过协调与验证分离、结构化规划、持久共享状态及发现级证据核验，在深度研究任务上显著优于现有框架，且其保存的证据质量更高，考虑证据可恢复性后优势进一步增强。
